analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0是CMB宇宙学的核心派生参数，也是Planck与局域距离阶梯张力的焦点；若中微子距离阶梯可行，它将提供一种几乎不受电磁传播消光、吸收和散射影响的独立宇宙学距离探针，可与CMB和传统光子距离指标交叉检验。
key_points: 提出用高能天体中微子点源作为可标准化烛光测量H0。
样本为12个X射线选取的Seyfert星系，并用NGC 1068的非红移距离作锚定。
摘要报告H0不确定度很大，但与Planck和SH0ES在1σ内一致。
methods: 中微子-X射线光度关系 L_ν=κ L_X^β
NGC 1068的Cepheid + TRGB非红移距离锚定
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对IceCube逐源中微子超额的统计定义、12个Seyfert样本选择函数、L_ν-L_X关系的内禀散布与系统误差，以及NGC 1068距离锚定如何传播到H0后验。

papers.title: Nelson-Barr Inflation
papers.abstract: The Nelson-Barr mechanism solves the strong CP problem through spontaneous CP violation, but the resulting CP-conjugate vacua generically lead to stable domain walls. We propose that the Nelson-Barr scalar itself drives hilltop inflation. A CP-symmetric double-well potential for its imaginary component forms two CP-breaking valleys, with inflation proceeding along one of them. Since the lowest CP-invariant ridge is generically much higher than the energy available after inflation, transitions between the two branches are energetically inaccessible, and the domain walls cannot be regenerated after inflation. A small CP-preserving linear deformation raises the scalar spectral index of quartic hilltop inflation and yields CMB-compatible parameter regions. The Nelson-Barr sector necessarily provides a portal to visible-sector reheating. When coupled to right-handed neutrinos, it can also transmit the spontaneous CP phase to the lepton sector and, in an extension that allows a higher CP-breaking scale, even realize nonthermal leptogenesis. This establishes a unified cosmological realization of the Nelson--Barr mechanism in which the same CP-breaking dynamics solves the strong CP problem, can generate quark and lepton CP violation, drives inflation and reheating, and enables baryogenesis, while simultaneously eliminating the associated domain-wall problem.

analysis.title_zh: Nelson-Barr暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出由Nelson-Barr标量本身驱动hilltop暴胀，使同一套自发CP破缺动力学同时处理强CP问题、畴壁问题、再加热以及可能的轻子/重子生成。摘要称，一个小的CP守恒线性形变可提高四次hilltop暴胀的标量谱指数，并产生与CMB相容的参数区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接涉及暴胀模型与CMB可观测量，尤其是标量谱指数等对早期宇宙势能形状的约束；它也把粒子物理中的CP破缺、畴壁和重子生成问题与CMB检验的暴胀动力学联系起来。
key_points: 提出Nelson-Barr标量同时承担自发CP破缺和hilltop暴胀。
机制旨在避免Nelson-Barr模型通常伴随的稳定畴壁再生问题。
小的CP守恒线性形变可改善四次hilltop暴胀的标量谱指数并给出CMB兼容参数区。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对所谓“CMB兼容参数区”使用了哪些观测约束，以及线性形变、再加热、畴壁不可再生和轻子生成之间是否存在相互冲突的参数要求。

papers.title: Fibre Inflation Beyond BHP: Constraints and a BHP-Free Regime
papers.abstract: We study a restricted fibre-dependent $α'$-loop sector in Type IIB Large Volume Scenario fibre inflation beyond the conventional Berg-Haack-Pajer (BHP) parametrisation. Motivated by effective-field-theory corrections in K3-fibred Calabi--Yau orientifolds, we analyse BHP-complete, partially BHP-driven and BHP-free configurations. For BHP-driven cases, the additional corrections act as effective deformations of the standard fibre potential and are bounded at the percent level relative to the corresponding BHP structures, with logarithmic terms typically more restricted due to their effects on the slope and curvature. At the effective-field-theory level, we identify a BHP-free fibre-inflation regime, referred to as $α'$-loop inflation, in which the conventional KK- and winding-type BHP channels vanish while the generalized loop sector stabilises the fibre modulus and supports slow-roll inflation. This regime exhibits a characteristic hierarchy between fibre-dependent loop structures controlled by the large-volume suppression and satisfies CMB, Kähler-cone, large-volume and heavy-modulus constraints. Our results show that fibre inflation is sensitive to the orientifold and brane configurations, and that corrections beyond the BHP ansatz can generate new controlled inflationary regimes.

analysis.title_zh: 超越 BHP 的纤维暴胀：约束与无 BHP 区域
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 Type IIB 大体积情景纤维暴胀中受限的纤维依赖 α′-loop 修正，超出传统 Berg-Haack-Pajer 参数化，并比较 BHP-complete、部分 BHP 驱动和 BHP-free 构型。摘要报告称，BHP 驱动情形下额外修正被限制在相对 BHP 结构的百分比水平，并在有效场论层面识别出一种由广义 loop 部门稳定纤维模并支持慢滚的 BHP-free α′-loop inflation 区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接涉及暴胀模型构造及其 CMB 约束可行性。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于其是否给出受控的弦论暴胀势形，从而影响可观测的标量谱、张量扰动和慢滚参数解释；但摘要未给出具体可观测量数值。
key_points: 研究 Type IIB 大体积情景中超出传统 BHP 参数化的纤维暴胀修正。
摘要称在 BHP 驱动情形中，额外修正相对 BHP 结构受百分比水平约束。
提出有效场论层面的 BHP-free “α′-loop inflation” 区域，并称其满足 CMB 与模稳定等约束。
methods: Type IIB Large Volume Scenario 纤维暴胀分析
K3 纤维 Calabi-Yau orientifold 中的有效场论修正动机
CMB、Kähler cone、大体积、重模约束检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对所谓 BHP-free 区域的有效场论控制条件、模稳定机制与慢滚条件是否同时成立，以及 CMB 约束是如何映射到模型参数空间的。

papers.title: Spin-1 Ultralight Dark Matter under Cosmological Scrutiny: Mass Constraints from CMB and Distance Probes
papers.abstract: We present cosmological constraints on spin-1 ultralight dark matter, described by a vector field (VFDM) with mass $m_{\rm A}$, using Planck CMB data and geometrical probes from BAO and SNIa. A key theoretical result is the derivation of the full CMB temperature covariance matrix, including both diagonal and off-diagonal anisotropic contributions induced by the preferred direction of the background vector field. We first constrain the model using the diagonal part of the covariance, together with CMB lensing; the off-diagonal terms, which couple multipoles with $Δ\ell\in\{2,4\}$, could bias lensing reconstruction, but only at very low multipoles ($L=\{2,4\}$) not included in the Planck likelihood. We consider both a pure VFDM scenario and a mixed VFDM+CDM scenario, characterized by the fraction $f=Ω_{\rm A}/(Ω_{\rm A}+Ω_{\rm cdm})$, obtaining $\log_{10}(m_{\rm A}/\mathrm{eV})>-24.07$ (95\% C.L.) in the pure case, and a clear correlation between $f$ and $m_{\rm A}$ in the mixed case, with smaller fractions allowing lighter masses; standard cosmological parameters remain fully consistent with $Λ$CDM. For the off-diagonal contributions, we derive the corresponding Bipolar Spherical Harmonic (BipoSH) coefficients and predict their amplitude using our best-fit and bounds. While the anisotropic signal is difficult to detect in the pure VFDM scenario with current Planck data, mixed VFDM+CDM models can produce signals at, or above, Planck sensitivity over a range of multipoles, motivating dedicated searches for this characteristic signature.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙学检验下的自旋 1 超轻暗物质：来自 CMB 和距离探针的质量约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck CMB、CMB lensing、BAO 和 SNIa 几何探针约束由矢量场描述的自旋 1 超轻暗物质，并推导含优选方向所致对角与非对角各向异性贡献的完整 CMB 温度协方差矩阵。摘要报告纯 VFDM 情形得到 log10(mA/eV)>-24.07 的 95% 置信下限，混合 VFDM+CDM 中暗物质分数 f 与质量相关，且标准宇宙学参数与 ΛCDM 保持一致；非对角 BipoSH 信号在混合模型中可能达到 Planck 灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接使用 Planck CMB 和 CMB lensing 约束暗物质微观性质，并讨论矢量背景导致的统计各向异性和非对角协方差；这关系到 CMB likelihood 的建模、透镜重建偏差以及用 BipoSH 搜索超出 ΛCDM 的特征信号。
key_points: 研究自旋 1 超轻暗物质的 CMB 与距离探针约束。
推导包含背景矢量场优选方向导致的对角与非对角各向异性项的 CMB 温度协方差矩阵。
混合 VFDM+CDM 情形可能产生达到或超过 Planck 灵敏度的 BipoSH 各向异性信号。
methods: CMB 温度协方差矩阵推导
纯 VFDM 与混合 VFDM+CDM 模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 CMB 温度协方差矩阵和 BipoSH 系数推导、非对角项对 Planck lensing 重建的影响为何只限于未纳入 likelihood 的低 L、多极耦合 Δℓ={2,4} 的可观测性，以及质量下限对数据组合和先验的依赖。

papers.title: Design and Performance of 220 and 270 GHz Bandpass Filters for BICEP Array
papers.abstract: The BICEP Array (BA) is the latest in the BICEP/ Keck series of experiments that aim to measure the polarization of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) with small aperture polarimeters located at the South Pole. To constrain the frequency response of these receivers, each detector is serially coupled to a band-pass filter (BPF). The electric circuits of these BPFs utilize series and shunt capacitors as well as series inductors, but critically do not include shunt inductors which simplifies fabrication. The filters are designed and simulated with Sonnet, and optimized for noise by considering loading from the atmosphere and the CMB. Multiple 220 GHz detector modules have had their frequency response measured at the South Pole. The 270 GHz detector modules have recently begun testing in a lab setting, and their performance in a BA receiver will be measured this winter.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Applied Superconductivity ( Volume: 36, Issue: 6, September 2026)

analysis.title_zh: BICEP Array 220 和 270 GHz 带通滤波器的设计与性能
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 BICEP Array 220 和 270 GHz 接收机中每个探测器串联耦合的带通滤波器设计与性能。摘要称滤波器用 Sonnet 设计仿真并结合大气和 CMB loading 优化噪声，多个 220 GHz 模块已在南极测得频率响应，270 GHz 模块则刚开始实验室测试。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BICEP Array 的目标是测量 CMB 偏振，尤其与原初 B 模式搜寻相关；220/270 GHz 频段对尘埃前景刻画很重要。带通滤波器的频率响应直接影响波段定义、前景分离、光学负载和系统误差控制，因此这篇仪器论文对 CMB 实验分析具有直接相关性。
key_points: 面向 BICEP Array 的 220 和 270 GHz 探测器模块设计带通滤波器。
滤波器电路使用串/并联电容和串联电感，不含并联电感以简化加工。
220 GHz 模块已在南极测量频率响应，270 GHz 模块开始实验室测试。
methods: BICEP Array 小口径 CMB 偏振接收机
串联耦合到每个探测器的带通滤波器
考虑大气和 CMB loading 的噪声优化
南极 220 GHz 探测器模块频率响应测量
270 GHz 探测器模块实验室测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对滤波器实测频带、带外泄漏、模块间一致性和噪声优化假设，尤其这些性能如何进入 BICEP Array 的前景分离与系统误差预算。

papers.title: A Review of How Supermassive Black Hole Binaries Can Be Detected and Characterized through Gravitational Lensing of Background Stars
papers.abstract: Supermassive black hole binaries are an inevitable outcome of hierarchical galaxy mergers, but their sub-parsec evolutionary phase between the kpc separations resolvable by direct imaging and the millihertz gravitational-wave regime targeted by LISA remains observationally elusive. Gravitational lensing of background stars by SMBH binaries has emerged as a powerful complement to periodic variability searches, periodic Doppler-boost signals, and circumbinary accretion hydrodynamic models. Two distinct lensing channels are reviewed: (i) the gravitational lensing of Milky Way bulge stars by the central Sgr A-star binary, whose secondary image is now within reach of ELT-class instruments; and (ii) the recently introduced Quasi-Periodic Lensing of Starlight (QPLS) mechanism, in which the rotation of caustics produced by a non-active SMBH binary magnifies individual bright stars in its host galaxy on the orbital period of the binary. The QPLS framework predicts 1-50 (190-5000) binaries per cubic parsec with periods below 10 yr and redshift z less than 0.3, opening a multimessenger window onto pulsar timing array sources and LISA-band events. After outlining the theoretical foundation, microlensing formalism, observational status, and the synergy with pulsar timing arrays and LISA, we identify outstanding challenges and project the field into the LSST era.

analysis.title_zh: 综述：如何通过背景恒星的引力透镜探测和刻画超大质量黑洞双星
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇综述，讨论如何通过背景恒星的引力透镜效应探测并刻画亚秒差距尺度的超大质量黑洞双星。摘要回顾了银河系中心 Sgr A-star 双星透镜和 QPLS 两类通道，并讨论其理论基础、观测状态以及与 PTA、LISA 的协同。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于星系天体物理、引力波和时域透镜方向，与 CMB 本身联系较弱。其宇宙学相关性在于多信使黑洞双星源群、星系并合历史和未来大规模巡天背景，但不是 CMB 数据分析或早期宇宙参数约束的核心文献。
key_points: 综述用背景恒星引力透镜探测和刻画超大质量黑洞双星的方法。
讨论银河系核区 Sgr A-star 双星透镜与 QPLS 两类通道。
强调与脉冲星计时阵和 LISA 的多信使协同。
methods: 银河系 bulge 恒星被 Sgr A-star 双星透镜化
与 pulsar timing arrays 和 LISA 的协同讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 QPLS 事件率预测的假设来源、透镜信号与恒星变源/AGN 活动的可区分性，以及这些通道与 PTA/LISA 源群之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Directional Anisotropic Sensitivity Curves for Pulsar Timing Arrays
papers.abstract: After two decades of observations, pulsar timing array collaborations have reported strong evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background, most likely sourced by an inspiraling population of supermassive black hole binaries. Because that population is finite, anisotropy in the background is inevitable, producing hotspots on the sky that track the loudest binaries. Building on the Fisher formalism for anisotropic backgrounds, we recast the directional Fisher information as effective sensitivity curves on the sky, distinguishing the radiometer and full-Fisher estimators, along with a sky-weighted curve that reduces the anisotropic sky to a single spectrum and recovers the standard isotropic curve in the isotropic limit. We implement five sky-decomposition bases: pixel, spherical harmonic, square-root spherical harmonic, radiometer, and principal-map. We demonstrate the framework on an IPTA-like pulsar timing array: characterizing the angular response, analyzing the Fisher structure, recovering injected anisotropic hotspots, and forecasting future-array sensitivity. The framework is released as an extension to the sensitivity software package hasasia.

analysis.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列的方向各向异性灵敏度曲线
analysis.summary_zh: 论文针对脉冲星计时阵列中随机引力波背景不可避免的天空各向异性，将方向 Fisher 信息表述为天空上的有效灵敏度曲线，并比较 radiometer 与 full-Fisher 估计。摘要报告该框架在 IPTA-like 阵列上可用于刻画角响应、恢复注入的各向异性热点并预报未来阵列灵敏度，且作为 hasasia 扩展发布。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作不直接研究 CMB，但其处理随机背景各向异性、天空分解和 Fisher 信息的方法与 CMB 各向异性分析在统计结构上相通。对 CMB 读者而言，它也提供了多信使宇宙学中随机背景成图和灵敏度表征的类比框架，尤其适用于理解 PTA 引力波背景与早期宇宙或大尺度结构相关信号的可观测性。
key_points: 将 PTA 随机引力波背景的各向异性 Fisher 信息改写为天空方向上的有效灵敏度曲线。
区分 radiometer 与 full-Fisher 估计量，并定义可回到各向同性极限的天空加权曲线。
在 IPTA-like 阵列上演示角响应、Fisher 结构、各向异性热点恢复与未来灵敏度预报。
methods: 各向异性背景的 Fisher 形式主义
方向 Fisher 信息与有效灵敏度曲线
pixel、spherical harmonic、square-root spherical harmonic、radiometer、principal-map 五种天空分解基
IPTA-like pulsar timing array 模拟/演示
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对不同天空基与估计量下 Fisher 矩阵的归一化、正则化和可逆性处理，以及“天空加权曲线”在各向同性极限恢复标准灵敏度曲线的推导条件。

papers.title: An upgraded frequency-selectable laser source (FLS) calibrator for CMB bandpass characterization
papers.abstract: One of the biggest challenges for Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) experiments comes from the uncertainty in instrument bandpass calibration. Uncertainties in bandpass can limit foreground removal and spectral fitting, which are critical for inflationary and galaxy cluster measurements. CMB experiments currently use Fourier Transform Spectrometers (FTSes) to measure instrument bandpasses. However, FTS systems are currently systematics-limited, so significant improvements in bandpass measurements require novel calibrators. To this end, we developed a Frequency-selectable Laser Source (FLS) calibrator, which uses a laser with adjustable frequency coupled to a system that allows for laser power attenuation. Following initial testing with the first FLS prototype, we developed an upgraded version of the calibrator with improved performance. We present the upgrades to the FLS calibrator, the characterization of the upgraded calibrator and new laser source, and plans for testing with microwave instruments in the field.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, submitted to Proc. SPIE

analysis.title_zh: 用于 CMB 带通表征的升级版频率可选激光源（FLS）校准器
analysis.summary_zh: 论文聚焦 CMB 实验中 bandpass 标定不确定性对前景去除和谱拟合的限制，提出升级版频率可选激光源 FLS 校准器作为现有 FTS 系统受系统误差限制时的替代或补充方案。摘要报告作者介绍了 FLS 升级、升级后校准器和新激光源的表征，并给出在微波仪器外场测试的计划。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: bandpass 误差会把前景建模、谱畸变/谱拟合、暴胀 B 模式和星系团 SZ 测量中的系统误差直接带入宇宙学参数推断。若 FLS 能提供比 FTS 更可控的带通标定，它将影响下一代 CMB 实验的前景去除精度和系统误差预算。
key_points: CMB 仪器 bandpass 不确定性会限制前景去除和谱拟合。
作者开发并升级了频率可选激光源 FLS 校准器。
摘要报告了升级内容、校准器与新激光源表征，以及未来外场测试计划。
methods: 与现有 Fourier Transform Spectrometers 的背景比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对升级版 FLS 的频率覆盖、频率精度/稳定性、功率控制、杂散光或系统误差预算，以及这些指标相对 FTS 是否足以改善 CMB bandpass 标定。

papers.title: Evidence for a thermal pressure deficit in galaxy groups from the tSZ effect and weak lensing
papers.abstract: Measurements of the thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (tSZ) effect have yet to form a consistent picture of the thermodynamic state of the gas in the intracluster medium: their interpretation is complicated by foreground contamination and uncertain halo masses. We present new measurements of the tSZ effect around the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Luminous Red Galaxy (LRG) sample, together with galaxy-galaxy lensing (GGL) measurements that enable a like-with-like comparison to state-of-the-art hydrodynamical simulations. We robustly isolate the tSZ signal by directly modeling the dust and radio emission of the target galaxies using the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) single-channel temperature maps, substantially reducing uncertainties from astrophysical foregrounds. Across halo masses $M_{500}=10^{13}-10^{14}~M_\odot$ and redshifts $0.4<z<1$, we find that the fiducial 1 Gpc$^3$ FLAMINGO simulation significantly overpredicts the observed tSZ signal at $\lesssim3'$ (i.e., $\lesssim 4\,R_{500}$ at $z=0.7$). Even the simulation with the strongest gas expulsion---which successfully reproduces the gas density inferred from kinetic SZ measurements of the same galaxy sample---overpredicts the thermal pressure. Because the strongest feedback model already reproduces the observed gas density, the remaining discrepancy is difficult to explain with additional gas depletion alone. Instead, current hydrodynamical simulations appear to overpredict the thermal pressure of galaxy groups by a factor of two, pointing toward missing non-thermal pressure support or significant departures from hydrostatic equilibrium.

analysis.title_zh: 来自 tSZ 效应和弱引力透镜的星系群热压力亏缺证据
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用 DESI LRG 样本周围的 tSZ 信号和 galaxy-galaxy lensing 质量信息，与 FLAMINGO 等流体模拟进行同类比较，并通过 ACT 单频温度图直接建模尘埃和射电前景以稳健隔离 tSZ。摘要报告在 $M_{500}=10^{13}-10^{14}~M_\odot$、$0.4<z<1$ 的星系群中，模拟在小角尺度上过预测观测到的 tSZ 信号，作者据此认为当前模拟可能将热压力高估约两倍，暗示非热压力支撑或偏离静水平衡。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: tSZ 是 CMB 次级各向异性的核心成分，也是用 CMB 数据研究星系团/星系群气体热力学和宇宙学参数的重要探针。该结果若成立，会影响基于 tSZ 的星系团质量校准、反馈模型、重子分布建模，以及 CMB 小尺度温度功率谱和交叉相关分析中的气体压力模板。
key_points: 结合 DESI LRG 周围的 tSZ 测量与 galaxy-galaxy lensing 进行同类比较。
使用 ACT 单频温度图直接建模目标星系尘埃和射电发射，以隔离 tSZ 信号。
摘要称 FLAMINGO 流体模拟在星系群尺度上过预测 tSZ/热压力，可能需要非热压力支撑或偏离静水平衡。
methods: 直接建模尘埃和射电发射
与 FLAMINGO hydrodynamical simulations 比较
与 kinetic SZ 推断的气体密度结果对照
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 ACT 单频图中尘埃/射电前景模型如何与 tSZ 退相干、GGL 质量标定与模拟选择函数是否真正 like-with-like，以及“热压力少一半”的结论对反馈模型、径向范围和质量红移分箱的敏感性。

papers.title: Penumbral Inflation from Calabi-Yau Boundaries
papers.abstract: Mapping Calabi-Yau geometry to early Universe cosmology remains a primary goal in string phenomenology. We present an inflationary mechanism where flux stationarity shifts the field dynamics, driving inflation along the volume-controlling saxion direction near a Hodge boundary. In this region, the internal geometry strictly dictates the scalar potential. This setup stabilizes the field against heavy moduli corrections without consuming extra flux tadpoles. As a result, the properties of the geometric boundary translate directly into primordial tensor perturbations, creating a clear physical link from string compactifications to measurable data. The resulting geometric predictions match current cosmic microwave background limits and provide specific, testable targets for upcoming LiteBIRD and CMB-S4 observations.
papers.comment: any suggestions and comments are highly welcomed and appreciated

analysis.title_zh: 来自 Calabi-Yau 边界的半影暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文尝试把 Calabi-Yau 几何边界与早期宇宙暴胀联系起来，提出通量驻定性改变场动力学、使暴胀沿 Hodge 边界附近控制体积的 saxion 方向发生的机制。摘要称该机制能抑制重模量修正，并使几何边界性质转化为原初张量扰动预测，且与当前 CMB 限制相容、可由 LiteBIRD 和 CMB-S4 检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 对 CMB 研究而言，核心关联在于原初张量扰动及其可能的 B 模偏振信号；若摘要所称的几何预测足够稳健，它可为 LiteBIRD、CMB-S4 等实验的张量模式搜索提供来自弦紧化的具体理论目标。
key_points: 提出在 Calabi-Yau Hodge 边界附近沿控制体积的 saxion 方向实现暴胀。
摘要声称几何边界性质可直接映射到原初张量扰动。
结果被描述为符合当前 CMB 限制，并给出 LiteBIRD 与 CMB-S4 可检验目标。
methods: 弦紧化中的 Calabi-Yau 几何构造
通量驻定性对场动力学的影响
Hodge 边界附近的标量势分析
与当前 CMB 限制及 LiteBIRD、CMB-S4 预期观测目标比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其“几何边界直接决定标量势”和“无需额外消耗 flux tadpoles 稳定重模量修正”的条件是否充分，以及给出的原初张量扰动预测是否依赖未在摘要中说明的模型选择。

papers.title: Cosmological constraining power of the redshifts, heights, and angular clustering of weak gravitational lensing peaks
papers.abstract: Weak gravitational lensing (WL) peaks probe non-Gaussian information of the large-scale distribution of matter that is not captured by two-point lensing statistics. We study the cosmological potential of the height distribution, redshift distribution, and angular clustering of high-valued WL peaks using a Bayesian inference approach that mimics a $\textit{Euclid}$ analysis. We use a forthcoming dark-matter-only hypercube, which varies cosmology in a ten-dimensional space, including evolving dark energy, neutrino mass, decaying dark matter, and the running of the scalar spectral index. We find the individual WL peak statistics to be complementary, as the redshift distribution best constrains the matter density, $Ω_\mathrm{m}$, and the dark energy equation-of-state parameters, $w_0$, and $w_a$; the height distribution and angular clustering are most sensitive to the amplitude of the primordial power spectrum, $\ln(10^{10}A_\mathrm{s})$; while combining the three statistics allows us to also probe the baryon density, $Ω_\mathrm{b}$, and the Hubble parameter, $h$. A comparison to the shear two-point correlation function demonstrates that WL peaks alone outperform the commonly used statistics, while even tighter constraints are obtained when combining all. Considering the 2-dimensional $Ω_\mathrm{m}-\ln(10^{10}A_\mathrm{s})$ and $w_0-w_a$ parameter planes, we find that the redshift distribution outperforms the angular clustering and peak-height distributions. We study the impact of the smoothing scale and find that, typically, the smallest scales yield the best results and the figure of merit improves by a factor $\approx2$ when combining multiple scales.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 12 figures (including appendices), submitted to MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: 弱引力透镜峰的红移、高度和角聚类的宇宙学约束能力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估高信噪弱透镜峰的高度分布、红移分布和角聚类对宇宙学参数的约束能力，采用模拟 Euclid 分析的贝叶斯推断和十维宇宙学参数空间的仅暗物质模拟。摘要报告三类峰统计彼此互补，联合后可约束更多参数，并且与剪切二点相关函数相比，透镜峰单独表现更强、联合所有统计时约束进一步收紧。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接分析 CMB，但与 CMB 宇宙学高度互补：弱透镜峰提供非高斯的大尺度结构信息，可帮助约束 Ω_m、A_s、暗能量参数、中微子质量等与 CMB 参数推断存在简并的量，并检验从早期宇宙初始涨落到晚期结构增长的一致性。
key_points: 研究弱引力透镜峰的高度分布、红移分布和角聚类。
使用模拟 Euclid 分析的贝叶斯推断，并在十维宇宙学参数空间中变化模型。
摘要称透镜峰统计与剪切二点相关函数互补，联合后约束更强。
methods: 峰高度分布、红移分布、角聚类
仅暗物质 hypercube 模拟
十维宇宙学参数空间，包括演化暗能量、中微子质量、衰变暗物质、标量谱指数 running
与剪切二点相关函数比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对仅暗物质模拟如何处理重子效应、测光红移和选择函数等 Euclid 实际系统误差，以及“WL peaks alone outperform”这一比较是否在相同先验、尺度切割和协方差假设下成立。

papers.title: Direct shear $\times$ kSZ correlation: controlling baryons without modeling galaxies
papers.abstract: Baryonic feedback redistributes gas within and around dark matter haloes, suppressing the small-scale matter power spectrum at a level that is now the leading systematic for upcoming weak-lensing surveys. The kinetic Sunyaev-Zeldovich (kSZ) effect directly probes this redistributed gas, but existing measurements around galaxies are either tied to the properties of the chosen galaxy sample or are susceptible to biases from other extragalactic foregrounds. We address both by cross-correlating a kSZ template constructed from the tomographic weak-lensing convergence maps and the radial velocity maps reconstructed from galaxy surveys via the continuity equation, with the observed CMB temperature. We forecast the detectability for Rubin LSST Y10 and Roman kinematic lensing samples combined with ACT, SO, and CMB-HD, finding signal-to-noise ratios of $\sim$ 5-15 for current and upcoming CMB data and $\gtrsim 100$ for CMB-HD, corresponding to few-per-cent and sub-per-cent constraints, respectively, on the baryonic suppression of the matter power spectrum. This method should thus achieve sufficient statistical precision to model baryonic feedback effects for Rubin, without the systematic challenge of modeling any galaxy-matter connection.

analysis.title_zh: 直接剪切 × kSZ 相关：无需星系建模地控制重子效应
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对重子反馈对小尺度物质功率谱的抑制这一弱透镜主要系统误差，提出将由层析弱透镜汇聚图和星系巡天径向速度图构造的 kSZ 模板与观测 CMB 温度做交叉相关。摘要预报 Rubin LSST Y10、Roman 与 ACT、SO、CMB-HD 组合可达到从当前/近期 CMB 数据的中等显著探测到 CMB-HD 的高信噪探测，并相应约束重子抑制幅度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇与 CMB 次级各向异性和弱透镜系统误差直接相关：kSZ 信号可追踪暗物质晕内外被反馈重新分布的气体，从而为未来 CMB 与大尺度结构联合分析中的重子反馈建模提供数据驱动约束，尤其影响 Rubin 等弱透镜巡天的小尺度宇宙学利用。
key_points: 提出直接交叉关联剪切构造的 kSZ 模板与观测 CMB 温度。
目标是约束重子反馈导致的小尺度物质功率谱抑制。
摘要给出 Rubin LSST、Roman 与 ACT、SO、CMB-HD 组合的可探测性预报。
methods: 由层析弱透镜汇聚图构造 kSZ 模板
由星系巡天通过连续性方程重建径向速度图
与观测 CMB 温度交叉相关
Rubin LSST Y10 与 Roman kinematic lensing 样本
ACT、Simons Observatory、CMB-HD 数据组合的信噪比预报
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 kSZ 模板构造中速度重建、透镜层析误差和 CMB 前景残留如何进入协方差与偏差预算，以及“不建模星系-物质连接”是否仍隐含星系巡天选择或速度重建假设。

papers.title: A Sequentially-Valid Reanalysis of DESI's Dynamical Dark Energy Signal
papers.abstract: Surveys such as DESI release data in stages, and each release invites a fresh assessment of whether dark energy is consistent with a cosmological constant. Standard Wilks-based $σ$ values are interpreted as if the test were performed only once, yet revisiting the same question at DR1, DR2, DR3, and beyond inflates the chance of an apparently significant fluctuation. We reanalyse the DESI BAO evidence for dynamical dark energy using an e-process, a likelihood-ratio-based measure of evidence that remains valid under repeated looks at accumulating data: it controls the false-detection probability under continued testing across releases with no trials-factor penalty. Applied to the DESI DR1$\to$DR2 BAO sequence, the result depends strongly on which departures from $Λ$CDM the test is designed to detect. For a pre-specified alternative aligned with the DR2-preferred direction, the running evidence reaches $M_{DR2} = 33.97$, crossing an illustrative 5% threshold of 20. The evidence is concentrated almost entirely in the LRG2 redshift bin, and removing that bin reduces the running e-value to $M = 0.49$, mildly favouring $Λ$CDM. When allowing any of the seven bins to have produced the excess, the signal does not survive a look-elsewhere correction. Other physically agnostic alternatives also fail to reject $Λ$CDM, while a physically motivated thawing-quintessence alternative rejects more strongly than any agnostic choice. The concentration of evidence in LRG2 specifically is difficult to reconcile with a smoothly evolving equation of state. The data therefore points to a fragile, single-bin, specification-dependent signal rather than robust evidence for dynamical dark energy. We recommend that future DESI, Euclid, Roman, and LSST data releases report an anytime-valid e-process value with its test specification stated alongside conventional $σ$ significances.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to JCAP. Code: https://github.com/jinyoungkim927/desi-evalue-paper

analysis.title_zh: 对 DESI 动力学暗能量信号的序贯有效重新分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新评估 DESI BAO 数据中动力学暗能量信号在分阶段发布、重复检验情形下的统计稳健性，采用基于似然比且 anytime-valid 的 e-process。摘要报告，若预设替代模型与 DR2 偏好方向一致，证据可跨过示例阈值，但证据几乎集中在 LRG2 红移 bin；移除该 bin 或考虑任一 bin 可能产生过量后的 look-elsewhere 修正时，信号不再构成稳健的 ΛCDM 排斥。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: DESI BAO 是 CMB 联合宇宙学分析中约束晚期膨胀史和暗能量方程状态的核心数据之一。该文直接关系到如何解释 CMB+BAO 中对 ΛCDM 或动力学暗能量的偏离：如果 DESI 的暗能量迹象主要来自单个红移 bin 且依赖检验设定，那么 CMB 读者在使用这些数据评估暗能量、H0 张力或参数扩展模型时需要更谨慎。
key_points: 重新分析 DESI DR1 到 DR2 BAO 对动力学暗能量的证据。
使用在重复数据发布中仍有效的 e-process，而不是只按单次检验解释 Wilks σ。
摘要称信号高度依赖检验设定，并集中在 LRG2 单个红移 bin。
methods: 基于似然比的证据度量
重复查看累积数据下的 anytime-valid 检验
按七个 BAO bin 的检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对 e-process 的检验规格如何预先定义、替代模型是否在看到 DR2 偏好后选择，以及 LRG2 bin 的数据处理、协方差和系统误差是否可能主导结论；还需区分摘要中“示例 5% 阈值”和常规 σ 显著性的统计含义。

papers.title: Natural Phantom Crossing from Axion-WIMP Interactions
papers.abstract: We construct a technically natural model in which thermal dark matter (DM) interacts with axion dark energy (DE) and produces an apparent late-time crossing of the phantom divide. A direct axion coupling to weakly-interacting massive particles (WIMPs) would ordinarily radiatively destabilize the ultralight axion potential. We avoid this issue through $N$ fermion species related by a cyclic $\mathbb{Z}_N$ symmetry, which projects the leading Coleman-Weinberg potential onto the exponentially suppressed $N$th harmonic. Although the microscopic theory preserves $\mathbb{Z}_N$, the axion-dependent WIMP masses generate unequal equilibrium abundances that freeze-out imprints on the cosmological relic state, thereby breaking the symmetry spontaneously. The resulting relic distribution retains a memory of the initial axion value and generates an unsuppressed finite-density potential that holds the field fixed at early times. As the WIMP density dilutes, the axion rolls toward the minimum of its confining potential, transferring energy from DE to DM at late times. An observer assuming separately conserved components then infers an effective equation of state that crosses below $-1$, without ghosts or violation of the null-energy condition. We present an illustrative cosmological solution with a DESI-like phantom crossing and percent-level suppression of structure growth, and discuss the implications of the WIMP multiplicity and relic distribution for DM searches.

analysis.title_zh: 由轴子-WIMP 相互作用自然产生的幻影跨越
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一个热暗物质与轴子暗能量相互作用的技术自然模型，通过循环 \(\mathbb{Z}_N\) 对称性抑制直接耦合带来的 Coleman-Weinberg 辐射不稳定。摘要报告称，冻结后的不等 WIMP 遗迹丰度会自发打破对称性并产生有限密度势，使晚期暗能量向暗物质转移，从而让假定两组分分别守恒的观测者推断出有效状态方程跨越 \(-1\)。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要关联晚期宇宙学、暗能量与暗物质相互作用，而非直接的 CMB 数据分析。对 CMB 研究者的意义在于：这类相互作用会改变晚期膨胀史和结构增长，可能影响 CMB 透镜、ISW 效应以及与 DESI 等低红移巡天联合拟合时对暗能量状态方程的解释。
key_points: 构造轴子暗能量与热 WIMP 暗物质相互作用的技术自然模型。
循环 \(\mathbb{Z}_N\) 对称性用于抑制辐射修正对超轻轴子势的破坏。
摘要称晚期能量从暗能量转移到暗物质，可被误判为有效状态方程跨越 \(-1\)。
methods: 轴子-WIMP 相互作用模型构造
\(N\) 个费米子种与循环 \(\mathbb{Z}_N\) 对称性
Coleman-Weinberg 势的高次谐波抑制
热冻结遗迹丰度与有限密度势
与 DESI 类 phantom crossing 对比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：有限密度势如何从冻结后的不等丰度定量产生、技术自然性是否在完整参数空间内成立，以及“DESI-like”跨越与结构增长抑制是否依赖特定初始条件或 WIMP 多重数选择。

papers.title: Single Frequency CMB Foreground Removal with Inter-scale Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Accurate measurements of Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) B-mode polarization, a key probe of inflationary physics, are hindered by complex Galactic dust foregrounds. Traditional foreground removal with Internal Linear Combination (ILC) fully preserves the primordial signal but requires multi-frequency data and is limited to two-point statistics. We present a novel way to estimate and remove foregrounds at single frequency using signal-preserving machine learning that leverages inter-scale correlations. Using the DustFilaments simulations, we train CNNs to reconstruct large-scale foregrounds ($\ell < 200$) from small-scales ($\ell > 200$). We quantify the effectiveness of foreground removal with the residual foreground power, $f_{\rm{resid}}$, which gives the fraction of foreground power remaining after removal. Predictions using only small-scale $B$-modes achieve $f_{\rm{resid}}\simeq 0.704$, while adding temperature and $E$-modes decreases it to $f_{\rm{resid}} \simeq 0.376$. These results are still higher than the spatial ILC, which leverages multi-frequency data at Simons-Observatory-like frequencies. However, a hybrid network that uses both multi-frequency and inter-scale correlations attains $f_{\rm{resid}}=4.71\times10^{-4}$ when using $B$-mode inputs alone, and $3.62\times10^{-4}$ when using temperature and $E/B$-mode inputs. This network achieves a residual power of $\sim 7\times$ lower than ILC, while inheriting ILC's signal-preserving property. This is $\sim 2$--$3\times$ lower than a network that only uses multi-frequency inputs, demonstrating that correlations across scale are not redundant with correlations across frequency and that our techniques are complementary to multi-frequency foreground removal. However, this is achieved only for DustFilments and network generalization across simulations remains a key challenge for robust ML-based foreground removal. (abridged)
papers.comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, accepted to ICML 2026 conference (Ai4Physics workshop)

analysis.title_zh: 利用跨尺度机器学习进行单频 CMB 前景去除
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 CMB B 模偏振的银河尘埃前景，提出利用跨尺度相关性的保信号机器学习方法，在单频或混合多频设置下从小尺度信息重建并去除大尺度前景。摘要报告称，单频网络仍弱于多频 ILC，而结合多频与跨尺度相关性的混合网络在 DustFilaments 模拟上达到低于 ILC 的残余前景功率，但作者明确指出跨模拟泛化仍是核心挑战。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是直接面向 CMB B 模前景去除的论文，与原初引力波和暴胀约束高度相关。若跨尺度信息能在保证 CMB 信号不被偏置的前提下补充多频清洗，将影响未来 Simons Observatory 类实验对尘埃残差、张量标量比和非高斯前景系统误差的处理。
key_points: 目标是用单频数据和跨尺度相关性估计并去除 CMB B 模中的尘埃前景。
CNN 在 DustFilaments 模拟上从小尺度重建大尺度前景，并报告残余前景功率指标。
混合网络结合多频与跨尺度信息，在该模拟上优于空间 ILC，但泛化能力仍是关键挑战。
methods: 从小尺度 \(\ell>200\) 重建大尺度 \(\ell<200\) 前景
温度与 E/B 模输入
空间 Internal Linear Combination, ILC
多频与跨尺度相关性的混合网络
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对：所谓 signal-preserving 的机器学习结构如何严格保证不去除原初 CMB 信号，训练和测试是否存在模拟同源性导致的乐观评估，以及在非 DustFilaments 尘埃模型、真实噪声和系统误差下的泛化表现。

papers.title: Axion Inflation with a Massive Abelian Gauge Field
papers.abstract: An axial coupling between an inflaton and an Abelian gauge field can trigger the tachyonic amplification of one gauge-field helicity. For a massless vector, modes with physical momentum $k/a\sim |ξ|H$ are enhanced by approximately $\exp(π|ξ|)$, and sufficiently efficient production can provide substantial friction for the homogeneous inflaton. We extend this mechanism to a vector of mass $m$. The instability is present only for $|ξ|>\bar m\equiv m/H$, and in the heavy regime the mode amplitude scales as $\exp[π(|ξ|-\bar m)]$. Because the amplified modes remain well inside the Hubble radius when $\bar m\gg1$, their contribution to long-wavelength curvature perturbations is power-law suppressed at fixed background backreaction. In the weak-backreaction regime we obtain ${\cal P}^{\rm id}_ζ \propto \bar m^{-2}$, while including the gauge-induced friction of scalar perturbations gives the scaling ${\cal P}^{\rm id}_ζ\propto \bar{m}^{-3}$. These estimates indicate that ${\cal P}^{\rm id}_ζ\lesssim 10^{-9}$ on CMB scales should be compatible with gauge field backreaction for $\bar{m}$ larger than order a few hundred. We test the analytical mode functions and backreaction estimates with the first lattice simulations based on a massive-vector extension of the \texttt{Pencil Code}, including simulations in the strongly backreacting regime.

analysis.title_zh: 具有有质量 Abelian 规范场的轴子暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把轴子暴胀中轴向耦合导致的 Abelian 规范场快子放大机制推广到有质量矢量场，推导不稳定性条件、重质量区的模振幅标度以及诱导曲率扰动的质量依赖。摘要报告称，当 \(m/H\) 足够大时，放大模仍在哈勃半径内而长波曲率扰动受幂律抑制，并用 massive-vector 版 \texttt{Pencil Code} 的首批格点模拟检验解析模函数和反作用估计。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接涉及暴胀期粒子产生、反作用和 CMB 尺度曲率扰动，是 CMB 初始条件与非标准暴胀机制研究的相关工作。其关键意义在于探讨如何在规范场产生显著影响暴胀背景的同时，避免在 CMB 尺度产生过大的标量扰动。
key_points: 研究轴子暴胀中轴向耦合有质量 Abelian 规范场的粒子产生。
有质量情形下不稳定性条件为 \(|ξ|>m/H\)，重质量区振幅按 \(\exp[π(|ξ|-m/H)]\) 标度。
摘要称在较大 \(m/H\) 下，规范场反作用可与 CMB 尺度曲率扰动受抑相容，并用格点模拟检验估计。
methods: 有质量 Abelian 规范场
轴向耦合导致的螺旋度快子放大
曲率扰动功率谱标度分析
基于 massive-vector 扩展的 \texttt{Pencil Code} 格点模拟
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：有质量矢量场的规范一致性和质量来源假设、曲率扰动功率谱抑制标度的适用条件、CMB 尺度 \({\cal P}^{\rm id}_ζ\lesssim10^{-9}\) 的推断是否依赖弱/强反作用近似，以及格点模拟如何处理约束方程和纵向模。

papers.title: Inflation, Open Universes, and Dark Energy
papers.abstract: We study the impact of spatial curvature ($Ω_k$) and dynamical dark energy (parametrized by $w_0$ and $w_a$) on the spectral index $n_s$ using a combination of cosmic microwave background datasets (Planck, SPT, and ACT), and spectroscopic galaxy samples from DESI, including both BAO and full-shape clustering measurements. We show that a small negative curvature, $Ω_k\simeq 3\times 10^{-3}$, lowers the value of $n_s$, bringing it closer to predictions of the Starobinsky, Higgs, and simplest $α$-attractor inflationary models. In particular, we find $n_s= 0.9667\pm0.0041$ (using Planck and DESI data) or $n_s= 0.9692\pm0.0035$ (adding ACT and SPT). Allowing for time-evolving dark energy also reduces the spectral index, leading to $n_s=0.9716\pm0.0032$ (from the combined dataset), or $n_s=0.9694\pm0.0035$ in combination with a small negative curvature. Our results demonstrate that the tension between current observational data and the Starobinsky, Higgs, and simplest $α$-attractor models holds only for $Λ$CDM, and can be mitigated in extended cosmological models. We discuss implications of these findings for inflationary models in an open universe and/or with dynamical dark energy, including scenarios with quantum tunneling and non-standard topology. Furthermore, we briefly describe a special class of $α$-attractor models, where one can make $n_s$ arbitrarily large, and we describe the $α$-attractor quintessence model. Such models may be of particular relevance when future data from DESI, as well as DESI-II, SPHEREx, Euclid, Rubin, and Roman, becomes available.

analysis.title_zh: 暴胀、开放宇宙与暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究空间曲率 Ω_k 和以 w_0、w_a 参数化的动力学暗能量如何影响标量谱指数 n_s，使用 Planck、SPT、ACT 等 CMB 数据与 DESI 的 BAO 和全形状聚类测量。摘要报告，小的负曲率或允许暗能量随时间演化都会降低 n_s，使其更接近 Starobinsky、Higgs 和最简单 α-attractor 暴胀模型的预言，并认为相关张力只在 ΛCDM 框架下成立。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: n_s 是 CMB 原初扰动谱的核心参数，也是连接 CMB 观测与暴胀模型的关键量；该文直接讨论 Planck/ACT/SPT 与 DESI 联合约束下，曲率和暗能量模型假设如何改变对暴胀模型的判读。
key_points: 联合 Planck、SPT、ACT 与 DESI BAO/全形状聚类约束扩展宇宙学模型。
摘要称小的负曲率或演化暗能量会降低标量谱指数 n_s。
作者认为与 Starobinsky、Higgs 和最简单 α-attractor 暴胀模型的张力依赖于 ΛCDM 假设。
methods: 含空间曲率 Ω_k 与 CPL 型动力学暗能量参数 w_0、w_a 的扩展模型分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者对 Ω_k 符号和“负曲率/开放宇宙”的约定、数据组合之间的一致性、曲率与 w_0-w_a 对 n_s 的退化关系，以及所称暴胀模型张力缓解是否主要由模型自由度增加驱动。

papers.title: Growth, geometry, and early-universe split of the matter density parameter $Ω_{\rm m}$
papers.abstract: While the $Λ$ cold dark matter ($Λ$CDM) model can successfully reproduce the measurements of many cosmological probes, some discrepancies have recently emerged. Therefore, it is necessary to test the standard cosmological model for consistency. An important stress test is to separate the influence of different cosmological regimes on the parameter inference. We treat three regimes separately here: geometry, growth, and the early universe. The geometrical regime concerns the expansion and curvature history, while the growth regime governs structure formation and the early-universe regime affects physics prior to recombination. Previous analyses have performed the split between geometry and growth, whereas we also consider the early universe influence separately. We perform this split for the present day matter density parameter $Ω_{\rm m}$ using multiple cosmological observables. The used data are galaxy clustering and weak lensing statistics (3x2pt) from the Dark Energy Survey (DES), cosmic microwave background (CMB) data from Planck, spectroscopic baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), type-Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) samples from Pantheon+, and redshift-space distortions (RSD) from a collection of galaxy surveys. For each of these probes, we introduce a phenomenological split into these three regimes. This work shows a strong correlation between the geometric and the early regime for the matter density, but no strong correlation between the growth regime and the others. All regimes are compatible in the posterior distribution, however the difference between the geometry and the early regimes, $ΔΩ_{\rm m}^{\rm geo,early}$, is 2$σ$ apart from 0.

analysis.title_zh: 物质密度参数 Ω_m 的增长、几何与早期宇宙拆分
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把当今物质密度参数 Ω_m 的推断按几何、结构增长和早期宇宙三个机制域进行现象学拆分，用 DES、Planck、DESI、Pantheon+ 与 RSD 等多探针检验 ΛCDM 的内部一致性。摘要报告几何域与早期宇宙域的 Ω_m 强相关、增长域与其他域相关不强，三个域后验相容，但几何与早期域的差值相对 0 有 2σ 偏离。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对 Ω_m 的约束同时依赖重组前物理、距离几何和晚期增长假设；这种拆分有助于判断 CMB 与低红移巡天之间的不一致究竟来自早期宇宙、距离标尺还是结构增长。
key_points: 将 Ω_m 的影响分为几何、增长和早期宇宙三个机制域。
使用 DES 3x2pt、Planck CMB、DESI BAO、Pantheon+ 超新星和 RSD 数据。
摘要称三个域的后验总体相容，但几何与早期宇宙的 Ω_m 差异距 0 为 2σ。
methods: 几何、增长、早期宇宙三域的现象学参数拆分
DES 星系聚类与弱透镜 3x2pt 统计
Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星样本
多星系巡天的红移空间畸变 RSD
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对三域 Ω_m 拆分的具体参数化、各探针对几何/增长/早期物理的映射是否引入先验相关，以及 2σ 偏离在不同数据组合和协方差处理下是否稳定。

papers.title: Unified dark sector approaches to cosmological tensions
papers.abstract: We present an analytical study of minimal mass-varying dark matter models, in which a single scalar field controls the dark matter mass, focusing on their utility in simultaneously addressing multiple cosmological tensions. We show that such minimal models can naturally become relevant at two critical epochs in the history of the Universe; matter-radiation equality and the present day, generating an early dark energy-like energy injection, as motivated by the Hubble tension, and an apparent phantom crossing, as suggested by baryon acoustic oscillation data from the DESI project. Crucially, the characteristic timing of these effects is tied to the cosmological background evolution itself, rather than specific energy scales. In addition, the intermediate evolution reduces the clustering matter density and can therefore lower $S_8$, in the direction preferred by data, while avoiding new long-range interactions. We derive analytic arguments to understand the conditions for these effects to arise in the same model and assess whether they can occur without introducing additional fine-tuning. This provides a simple framework for identifying which potentials and couplings to dark matter can simultaneously affect early- and late-time cosmological tensions.

analysis.title_zh: 通向宇宙学张力的统一暗部门方案
analysis.summary_zh: 本文解析研究一类最小质量变化暗物质模型，其中单一标量场控制暗物质质量，考察其是否能同时缓解多种宇宙学张力。摘要称该模型可在物质-辐射相等附近产生类似早期暗能量的能量注入、在当前表现出类似 phantom crossing 的行为，并通过中间演化降低成团物质密度从而使 S_8 朝数据偏好的方向移动。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然摘要未列出具体 CMB 数据分析，但早期暗能量式注入会直接影响 CMB 声学尺度、阻尼尾和重组前背景演化；同时 H_0 与 S_8 张力是当前 CMB 与低红移观测联合解释中的核心问题。
key_points: 研究由单一标量场控制暗物质质量的最小质量变化暗物质模型。
同一框架可在物质-辐射相等和当前宇宙两个时期产生相关效应。
摘要称该类模型可能同时影响 Hubble 张力、DESI BAO 暗能量迹象和 S_8 偏低方向。
methods: 最小质量变化暗物质模型
单一标量场控制暗物质质量
势函数与暗物质耦合条件的解析推导
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“无需额外精细调节”的论证条件、模型如何避免新的长程相互作用、早期能量注入是否满足 CMB 重组前约束，以及晚期 phantom crossing 与 DESI BAO 解释是否依赖特定势函数或耦合形式。

papers.title: Spectator Axions in String Inflation and Primordial Black Holes
papers.abstract: We study the impact of light spectator axions on the seeding of primordial black holes (PBHs) during inflation in string theory. Primordial black holes exhibit unique and novel phenomenology, and may constitute the observed dark matter. Cosmic inflation provides a mechanism for producing them, but such inflation models typically feature Planckian field excursions, necessitating an ultraviolet completion into quantum gravity. String theory provides a natural framework for doing so, and indeed Fibre Inflation has been shown to produce PBHs while satisfying constraints from cosmic microwave background data. In this work we study the dynamics of axions during Fibre Inflation, and find a diverse and rich set of possibilities, including turns in field space and enhancement of primordial perturbations. We find that across most of parameter space, notably an axion with a far sub-Planckian decay constant $f\ll M_{\rm Pl}$, there is a negligible impact on the power spectrum of curvature perturbations, indicating an overall robustness of the model. On the other hand, an axion with a larger but still sub-Planckian decay constant, $f\gtrsim {\cal O}(0.1) M_{\rm Pl}$, and an exponentially small prefactor of its non-perturbative potential, can enhance the growth of perturbations, making it easier to achieve the amplification needed to seed PBHs, effectively realizing axion-assisted PBHs in string theory.

analysis.title_zh: 弦暴胀中的旁观者轴子与原初黑洞
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究弦论 Fibre Inflation 中轻旁观者轴子是否会改变暴胀期间原初黑洞的播种机制。摘要称，多数参数空间下轴子对曲率扰动功率谱影响很小，但当轴子衰变常数较大但仍亚普朗克且非微扰势前因子指数小时时，可增强扰动增长，从而更易达到播种 PBH 所需的放大。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接连接 CMB 约束下的暴胀模型、小尺度曲率扰动放大、PBH 暗物质候选以及弦论紫外完备性。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于模型是否在保持 CMB 尺度功率谱可接受的同时，在小尺度产生足够增强。
key_points: 研究弦论 Fibre Inflation 中轻旁观者轴子对 PBH 播种的影响。
多数参数空间，尤其远小于普朗克尺度的衰变常数，对曲率扰动功率谱影响可忽略。
较大的亚普朗克衰变常数并伴随非微扰势的指数小前因子时，可增强扰动增长。
methods: 弦论中的 Fibre Inflation 模型
轻旁观者轴子动力学分析
场空间转弯与曲率扰动功率谱增强分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对轴子势参数、衰变常数范围与非微扰前因子的假设如何进入功率谱增强计算，以及这些增强是否同时满足 CMB 约束和 PBH 丰度相关约束。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves as a Source of Large-Scale White Noise: New Constraints
papers.abstract: A stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background sources a shear in the flow of cosmic fluid which, through non-linear mode coupling, generates large-scale white noise (LSWN) in the kurvature density field. Building on the LSWN framework of our previous work, we derive the amplitude of this GW-induced LSWN and translate the observational non-detection of LSWN into bounds on the production redshift and density of gravity waves. In particular, a minimal constraint on gravity waves with $z=0$ density parameter $Ω_\mathrm{GW0}^*$ in frequency band $f_*$ generated at redshift $z_*$ must satisfy ${z_*}^2\,Ω_\mathrm{GW0}^*<5\times10^7\,(f_*/\mathrm{nHz})^{3/2}$. This, for example, precludes the gravity waves recently detected by pulsar timing arrays \cite{NANOGrav:2023hvm} from being present before $z_*\sim10^8$, long after the quark hadron phase transition. While orders of magnitude stronger than other constraints on gravity waves, this is a minimal LSWN constraint as realistic modeling of early universe gravity wave production, including the granularity of the gravity-wave sources and the LSWN produced by the associated acoustic waves would probably tighten this constraint by orders of magnitude.

analysis.title_zh: 引力波作为大尺度白噪声来源：新的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究随机引力波背景如何通过宇宙流体剪切和非线性模耦合，在曲率密度场中产生大尺度白噪声，并把 LSWN 的观测非探测转化为对引力波产生红移和能量密度的限制。摘要给出一个最小约束，并指出这会限制 PTA 近期探测到的纳赫兹引力波在很早期宇宙中已存在的可能性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然主题不是 CMB 各向异性本身，但它涉及原初扰动、随机引力波背景和大尺度结构统计量之间的联系。对宇宙学读者而言，这类约束可与 CMB、PTA 和未来引力波观测共同限定早期宇宙相变或其他引力波产生机制。
key_points: 随机引力波背景可通过非线性模耦合在曲率密度场中产生大尺度白噪声。
利用 LSWN 的非探测给出引力波产生红移和能量密度的约束。
摘要称该约束可限制 PTA 探测到的纳赫兹引力波若在早期宇宙中已存在的情形。
methods: 大尺度白噪声 LSWN 框架
随机引力波背景诱导剪切的非线性模耦合计算
将 LSWN 观测非探测转化为引力波产生红移与密度约束
脉冲星计时阵列相关纳赫兹频段引力波作为示例
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 LSWN 振幅推导中关于非线性模耦合、引力波源连续性或颗粒性、以及观测非探测阈值的假设；还需确认摘要中给出的约束适用的频段、红移定义和密度参数定义。

papers.title: Non-Minimally Coupled Chain Inflation at High Scales
papers.abstract: Chain inflation offers an alternative to standard slow-roll dynamics, with accelerated expansion proceeding through a sequence of rapid quantum tunneling events between metastable vacua. At the high energy scales relevant for the early Universe, scalar fields are generically expected to couple non-minimally to gravity via operators like $ξRφ^2$, allowed by symmetry and required as counterterms for interacting theories in curved spacetime. We study the dynamical and observational consequences of this coupling for chain inflation. We find the modifications to the model for arbitrary $ξ$ and focus on interesting phenomenology for $ξ={\cal O}( 10)$. We show that, in the Einstein frame, the non-minimal coupling induces a field-dependent amplification of the Euclidean bounce action, thus modifying the tunneling rate across the chain. We develop an analytic framework connecting this modified tunneling dynamics to the scalar spectral index, its running, the primordial curvature power spectrum, and the stochastic gravitational wave background from bubble collisions. As one consequence, the non-minimal coupling breaks the rigid relation between the scalar tilt and inflationary scale that drives the minimally coupled pure tilted cosine model to very low energies ($V_*^{1/4}\lesssim 3\,\rm{GeV}$, where $V_*$ is the value of the inflationary potential when the CMB-relevant modes exit the horizon), allowing for viable high-scale chain inflation with $V_*^{1/4}\sim 10^{11}\,\rm{GeV}$. Furthermore, non-minimally coupled chain inflation at high scales produces a peaked stochastic gravitational wave signal in the dHz-kHz bands, accessible to upcoming interferometers such as the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer. Finally, the model predicts a distinct running of the spectral index that will be testable by the Simons Observatory, making it a prime target for multi-messenger cosmology.

analysis.title_zh: 高能标下的非最小耦合链式暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究高尺度链式暴胀中 ξRφ² 型非最小引力耦合对隧穿动力学和观测量的影响。摘要称该耦合会在 Einstein frame 中引入场依赖的 Euclidean bounce action 放大，打破最小耦合模型中标量倾斜与暴胀能标的刚性关系，使高尺度链式暴胀可行，并产生可由未来 CMB 与引力波观测检验的信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇与 CMB 暴胀检验高度相关，因为它直接讨论标量谱指数、running、原初曲率功率谱以及 CMB 相关模出视界时的暴胀能标。摘要还把 Simons Observatory 对 running 的检验与未来引力波干涉仪信号结合起来，属于多信使早期宇宙模型。
key_points: 研究高能标链式暴胀中标量场与引力的非最小耦合。
非最小耦合在 Einstein frame 中改变 Euclidean bounce action，从而改变隧穿率。
模型可允许高尺度链式暴胀，并预言可由 Simons Observatory 检验的谱指数 running 以及未来干涉仪可探测的随机引力波信号。
methods: Euclidean bounce action 与量子隧穿率分析
解析框架连接隧穿动力学、标量谱指数、running、原初曲率功率谱和泡碰撞随机引力波背景
Simons Observatory、Einstein Telescope、Cosmic Explorer 可检验性讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对从非最小耦合到 bounce action 放大的推导、隧穿率与标量谱指数及 running 的解析关系，以及高尺度可行区域是否真正满足 CMB 约束、泡碰撞引力波限制和链式暴胀的完成条件。

papers.title: Shear-kSZ: A New Estimator for the Matter-Electron Power Spectrum from kSZ Tomography and Weak Lensing
papers.abstract: We propose a new estimator for the ionized gas--matter power spectrum, which correlates the kinematic Sunyaev--Zel'dovich (kSZ) field with the line-of-sight velocity field and the weak-lensing convergence map. Analogously to the standard stacked kSZ estimator, this estimator factorizes into a calibratable velocity kernel multiplying the matter--electron cross-power spectrum, $P_{me}(k)$. Because the estimator accesses $P_{me}(k)$ for the full matter distribution rather than around a specific biased tracer as is the case with the standard stacked kSZ estimator, it allows us to determine the baryonic suppression of the matter power spectrum, $S(k)$, one of the dominant astrophysical systematics for Stage-IV cosmic shear. We derive and validate an analytical expression for the estimator against simulations, finding percent-level agreement. Due to its parity structure, contributions from cosmic microwave background (CMB) foregrounds cancel. Using a realistic CMB temperature map with Simons Observatory-like noise and beam, a smoothed velocity field as obtained via linear velocity reconstruction applied to DESI-like luminous red galaxies (LRGs), and LSST-like sources at high redshifts, which suppresses the effect of intrinsic alignments and boost factors, we forecast a $16σ$ measurement over $f_{\rm sky}=0.2$ (corresponding to 1\% measurement of $S(k)$), establishing our estimator as a readily measurable target for current surveys, e.g., LSST and \textit{Euclid}. Because the signal-to-noise is dominated by CMB noise rather than lensing depth, we expect a detection already at $\sim10σ$ with early LSST data releases. Substantial (factor of 2) gains in signal-to-noise are expected with Advanced Simons Observatory. While here we focus on DESI-like LRGs as the foreground sample, lower-redshift samples provide an even wider array of source samples in the background.

analysis.title_zh: Shear-kSZ：一种由 kSZ 层析和弱透镜测量物质-电子功率谱的新估计量
analysis.summary_zh: 论文提出一种“shear-kSZ”估计量，把 kSZ 场、视线速度场和弱透镜会聚图相关起来，以测量电离气体-物质功率谱 P_me(k)。摘要称解析表达式经模拟验证达到百分比级一致，并在 SO-like、DESI-like LRG 与 LSST-like 源样本组合下预期可高信噪测量重子抑制 S(k)。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作直接连接 CMB 次级各向异性中的 kSZ 信号与弱透镜宇宙学，目标是校准 Stage-IV cosmic shear 的主要天体物理系统误差之一，即重子反馈对物质功率谱的抑制。若摘要中的前景抵消和测量预测成立，它可成为 CMB-S4/Simons Observatory 与 LSST、Euclid、DESI 联合分析中的重要交叉探针。
key_points: 提出将 kSZ 场、视线速度场与弱透镜会聚图相关的新估计量。
摘要称该估计量可直接访问全物质分布的物质-电子交叉功率谱，并用于约束重子反馈导致的物质功率谱抑制。
由于宇称结构，摘要报告 CMB 前景贡献会抵消，并给出对 SO、DESI、LSST 等巡天组合的可测性预测。
methods: Simons Observatory-like CMB temperature map with noise and beam
linear velocity reconstruction applied to DESI-like LRGs
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对估计量中速度核的可校准性、前景抵消依赖的宇称假设是否在真实掩膜和系统误差下成立，以及从 P_me(k) 推断 S(k) 时对重子物理和透镜系统误差的建模。

papers.title: An efficient one-loop EFTofLSS framework for Vainshtein-screened Horndeski gravity
papers.abstract: We present an extension of \texttt{PyBird} for one-loop large-scale structure analyses of modified gravity models. We implement support for quasi-static, Vainshtein-screened luminal Horndeski models (in EFTofDE and covariant formalisms) and nDGP, and replace the Green's function approach with a direct ODE method for computing the exact time-dependent functions entering the perturbation kernels. The new implementation improves computational efficiency while maintaining numerical consistency with the standard approach, and we validate the resulting one-loop matter power spectrum against $N$-body simulations for the $α_i\proptoΩ_{\rm DE}$ parametrization. We apply this framework to constrain the $α_i \propto a^3$ and $α_i \propto Ω_{\rm DE}$ parametrizations using Planck CMB, BOSS full-shape, and DESI DR2 BAO data, finding that full-shape information significantly tightens the constraints. We further showcase the pipeline for the cubic Galileon and nDGP models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the phenomenological amplitude parametrizations to covariant modified-gravity theories. Finally, we assess the impact of the Einstein--de Sitter approximation and find that exact time dependence can be retained at modest computational cost, which may become relevant for future large-scale structure surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 用于 Vainshtein 筛选 Horndeski 引力的一种高效一环 EFTofLSS 框架
analysis.summary_zh: 论文介绍了 PyBird 的扩展框架，用于 Vainshtein 筛选的 Horndeski 与 nDGP 等修改引力模型的一环大尺度结构分析，并以直接 ODE 方法保留精确时间依赖。摘要报告该实现提高效率、与标准方法数值一致，并用 Planck CMB、BOSS full-shape 和 DESI DR2 BAO 数据展示参数约束，其中全形状信息显著收紧约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要服务于大尺度结构和修改引力检验，但使用 Planck CMB 与 BAO/full-shape 数据联合约束，因而与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙基准和引力理论一致性检验相关。对 CMB 读者而言，它提供了把 CMB 约束与晚期结构增长、修改引力参数化相结合的分析工具背景。
key_points: 扩展 PyBird，使其支持一环 EFTofLSS 下的若干修改引力模型。
用直接 ODE 方法替代 Green 函数方法来计算扰动核中的精确时间依赖函数。
结合 Planck CMB、BOSS full-shape 和 DESI DR2 BAO 数据约束 Horndeski 参数化，并展示 cubic Galileon 与 nDGP 应用。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对一环功率谱与 N 体模拟比较的尺度范围和误差标准、准静态与 Vainshtein 筛选假设的适用域，以及 Planck+BOSS+DESI 组合中先验、协方差和全形状信息如何收紧约束。

papers.title: Characterisation at the HL-LHC of Long-lived Heavy Neutrinos in Gauge Extensions of the Standard Model
papers.abstract: We show how signals of heavy neutrinos with displaced decays can be detected at the Large Hadron Collider in two theoretical setups, both exploiting extended gauge sectors as portals to such new physics, the Left-Right Symmetric Model and $U(1)_{B-L}$. Further, owing to the reduced contamination from backgrounds away from the interaction point, we illustrate how the properties of the heavy neutrinos (mass, width and quantum numbers) can neatly be accessed at the High-Luminosity upgrade of the CERN machine.

analysis.title_zh: 在标准模型规范扩展中于 HL-LHC 表征长寿命重中微子
analysis.summary_zh: 论文讨论在标准模型规范扩展中，通过扩展规范扇区产生的长寿命重中微子如何在 HL-LHC 以位移衰变信号被探测。摘要称在 Left-Right Symmetric Model 与 U(1)_{B-L} 两类模型中，低背景的位移顶点可帮助测定重中微子的质量、宽度和量子数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于对撞机唯象学，不直接使用或预测 CMB 观测量。它与宇宙学的联系在于重中微子和规范扩展可能关联早期宇宙粒子物理、轻子数生成或中微子质量起源，但这些联系在摘要中没有展开。
key_points: 研究 HL-LHC 中长寿命重中微子的位移衰变信号。
理论场景包括 Left-Right Symmetric Model 和 U(1)_{B-L}。
摘要称远离相互作用点的背景污染较低，有助于获取重中微子的质量、宽度和量子数。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 若从宇宙学角度精读，应核对这些重中微子参数空间是否与轻子数生成、暗辐射或宇宙学中微子质量约束发生直接联系；摘要本身未给出与 CMB 数据的明确交叉。

papers.title: No way ou$τ$: Epoch of Reionization Observations Do not Support Large Values of the Optical Depth to Reionization
papers.abstract: Recent cosmological analyses combining high-redshift cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements with low-redshift baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) data have reported a preference for dynamical dark energy, with the cosmological constant scenario ($Λ$CDM) disfavored at the $\sim 3σ$ level. These analyses, however, typically rely on large-scale CMB polarization measurements to constrain the optical depth to reionization $τ_{\rm reio}\sim 0.06$, raising the question of whether potential systematics in this dataset could influence the inferred cosmological preference. Excluding large-scale polarization data substantially weakens the tension with $Λ$CDM to the $\lesssim 2σ$ level, nevertheless at a price of increasing $τ_{\rm reio}$ significantly to $\sim 0.09$. Here, we use a physically motivated Gompertzian reionization framework to perform a self-consistent Bayesian analysis combining CMB (excluding large-scale polarization data), BAO, and independent measurements of the neutral hydrogen fraction evolution from quasar damping wing observations and dark pixel constraints. We derive $τ_{\rm reio} = 0.067 \pm 0.011$ (dynamical dark energy scenario) in good agreement with cosmological analyses that would include large-scale CMB polarization data, while the inferred reionization history is consistent with multiple observational constraints. Our analysis recovers a preference for dynamical dark energy at the $\gtrapprox2σ$ level. These results demonstrate that astrophysical probes of reionization independently recover the optical depth required by CMB polarization measurements, suggesting that potential systematics in large-scale polarization alone are unlikely to fully explain the emerging preference for dynamical dark energy.
papers.comment: Comments welcome! 8 pages, 5 figures. New version replaces the LambdaT model for the main model used in Ref. [5]

analysis.title_zh: 没有出路 τ：再电离时代观测并不支持较大的再电离光深度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验大尺度 CMB 偏振系统误差是否可能通过改变再电离光深度 τ_reio 来影响对动力学暗能量的偏好。作者在排除大尺度偏振的 CMB+BAO 基础上加入类星体阻尼翼和 dark pixel 的中性氢分数约束，摘要报告 τ_reio=0.067±0.011，并恢复了约大于 2σ 的动力学暗能量偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: τ_reio 是 CMB 温度、偏振与物质涨落幅度推断中的关键退化参数，尤其影响大尺度 E 模偏振和 A_s 的约束。该工作用非 CMB 大尺度偏振的再电离天体物理观测交叉检验 τ_reio，有助于判断近期 CMB+BAO 暗能量结论是否由偏振系统误差驱动。
key_points: 讨论去掉大尺度 CMB 偏振后，较高再电离光深度是否会影响动力学暗能量偏好。
用独立再电离观测约束后，摘要报告的光深度与包含大尺度偏振的 CMB 分析相符。
结果认为大尺度偏振系统误差不太可能单独解释动力学暗能量偏好。
methods: CMB 数据但排除大尺度偏振
类星体阻尼翼中性氢分数观测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Gompertzian 再电离参数化对 τ_reio 后验的先验依赖，以及排除大尺度偏振后 CMB+BAO 与中性氢观测之间是否存在数据集张力。

papers.title: Cosmology beyond standard sirens: cross-correlation of gravitational waves and neutral hydrogen intensity mapping
papers.abstract: We explore the potential of cross-correlation between gravitational wave (GW) events and neutral hydrogen (HI) intensity mapping surveys to serve as an independent cosmological probe. Focusing on the ET and the SKAO, and assuming that binary black hole mergers and HI emission are biased tracers of the underlying dark matter distribution, we use their angular auto- and cross-correlation spectra to constrain cosmological parameters. We test three different GW detector networks: ET alone, both in its $Δ$ and 2L configuration, and ET-2L together with Cosmic Explorer. We show that the cross-correlation method, by naturally mitigating tracer-specific systematics, yields robust cosmological bounds, allowing for a sub-percent ($\sim 0.5\%$) precision on the Hubble constant $H_\mathrm{0}$. Furthermore, this approach robustly constrains the cosmic expansion history throughout the post-reionization era of the Universe and, unlike conventional standard sirens, simultaneously probes the large scale distribution of matter perturbations, achieving relative uncertainties of approximately 1.3% on the total matter density $Ω_\mathrm{m}$ and 1.6% on the late-time clustering amplitude $σ_8$.

analysis.title_zh: 超越标准汽笛的宇宙学：引力波与中性氢强度映射的互相关
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究引力波事件与中性氢强度映射巡天的互相关能否作为独立宇宙学探针。基于 ET、SKAO 以及 Cosmic Explorer 的未来配置，作者使用角向自相关和互相关谱，摘要报告可给出亚百分比级 H0 精度，并约束后再电离时期膨胀史、Ωm 与 σ8。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接分析 CMB，但其目标参数 H0、Ωm 和 σ8 与 CMB 推断及晚期宇宙张力密切相关。HI 强度映射覆盖后再电离宇宙，若与引力波互相关成熟，可为 CMB 约束提供独立的低红移大尺度结构和膨胀史交叉检验。
key_points: 提出用引力波事件与 HI 强度映射的角向自相关和互相关作为宇宙学探针。
聚焦 ET、SKAO，并比较 ET 单独及与 Cosmic Explorer 联合的探测器网络。
摘要称该方法可同时约束 H0、Ωm、σ8 和后再电离时期的膨胀历史。

papers.title: $Λ$XCDM: a running vacuum strategy for crossing the phantom divide
papers.abstract: Composite dynamical dark energy (DDE) has recently been explored as an efficient way to help cure cosmological tensions through the so-called $w$XCDM model (Gomez-Valent & Solà Peracaula 2024; 2025), a toy-model version of the $Λ$XCDM model (Grande et al., 2006). The latter is a composite running vacuum model (RVM) that involves a DE component $X$ (`cosmon') of generic nature. We compute the effective equation of state of $Λ$XCDM and use state-of-the-art techniques to fit this model to two standard sets of cosmological data, one involving SNIa from Pantheon$+$ and the other SNIa from DES-Dovekie, in addition to BAO data from DESI DR2 and the CMB data from Planck PR4. We do not use large scale structure formation data for this analysis nor the SH0ES calibration of $H_0$. We find that $Λ$XCDM naturally performs the crossing of the phantom divide as observed by DESI near $z\simeq 0.4$ using the $w_0w_a$CDM parameterization, a feature well favored by existing model-agnostic analyzes of the same data (González-Fuentes & Gómez-Valent:2025; 2026). It turns out that the cosmon $X$ behaves as `phantom matter' (PM) near the present, which in contrast to usual phantom DE satisfies the strong energy condition (as ordinary matter) and furnishes positive pressure ($P_X>-ρ_X>0$) at the expense of negative energy density ($ρ_X<0$). $Λ$XCDM provides a better fit than $w_0w_a$CDM and, as a bonus, alleviates the cosmic coincidence problem. Given that PM appears in stringy versions of the RVM (Mavromatos & Solà Peracaula 2021 a,b) , the $Λ$XCDM appears to be a composite DDE model with a good chance of explaining the crossing of the phantom divide from first principles, therefore providing theoretical support to the DESI observations inferred from generic parameterizations of the DE.

papers.title: No preference for generalized emergent dark energy from current cosmological data
papers.abstract: In this work, we revisit the generalized emergent dark energy model by confronting it with DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation measurements, in combination with joint CMB data from ACT, SPT, and Planck, as well as Type Ia supernova samples including Pantheon$^+$, DES-Dovekie, and Union3. We find that the GEDE model remains compatible with the $Λ$CDM paradigm, with no statistically significant preference for deviations when all datasets are combined. In particular, the key model parameter $Δ$ is consistent with the $Λ$CDM value $Δ= 0$ within $2σ$ once SNe Ia data are included. Despite this overall agreement, the GEDE model does not exhibit the phantom crossing suggested by DESI DR2. Instead, the evolution of the dark energy equation of state $w(z)$ indicates that the model behaves either as a full phantom ($w < -1$) or quintessence ($w > -1$), depending on the dataset combination, without a clear transition across $w = -1$. When Pantheon$^+$ data are included, the model converges closely to $Λ$CDM with $w \simeq -1$. The GEDE model does not alleviate the existing cosmological tensions. The inferred values of $H_0$ remain in the range $67.9$-$69.8\ \mathrm{km,s^{-1},Mpc^{-1}}$, while the sound horizon $r_d$ and clustering parameter $S_8$ remain consistent with $Λ$CDM, failing to resolve the $H_0$ and $S_8$ tensions. Finally, both Gaussian significance levels ($<2σ$) and Bayesian evidence ($\ln B_{i,j} < 1$) indicate no statistically significant preference for GEDE over $Λ$CDM. We conclude that, although DESI DR2 hints at dynamical dark energy, the GEDE model remains observationally indistinguishable from $Λ$CDM and does not support the Quintom-B-type behavior suggested by DESI DR2.

analysis.title_zh: 当前宇宙学数据不偏好广义涌现暗能量

ACT、SPT、Planck 联合 CMB 数据

papers.title: Early- and late-time constraints on Wald-Gauss-Bonnet topological dark energy and implications for the $H_0$ and $S_8$ tensions
papers.abstract: The persistent $H_0$ and $S_8$ tensions motivate the search for new dark-energy mechanisms capable of modifying the late-time expansion history while preserving the successful early-Universe predictions of $Λ$CDM scenario. Wald-Gauss-Bonnet (WGB) topological dark energy provides a physically motivated realization of this possibility, where the effective dark-energy sector emerges from cosmic horizon thermodynamics and the black-hole formation and merger history. We present the first early- and late-Universe analysis of WGB cosmology, implementing the model as an effective fluid in a modified \texttt{CLASS} solver and constraining it against CMB data from \textit{Planck}, ACT~DR6 and SPT-3G, DESI~DR2 BAO, and Pantheon+ supernovae. While late-time data alone are consistent with $Λ$CDM, the full dataset prefers a non-zero WGB contribution, $\Cn=0.435^{+0.150}_{-0.132}$, corresponding to a $\sim3σ$ phantom-like deviation and an improved fit. The preferred solution raises $H_0$ from $68.5$ to $69.8~\kmsmpc$, reducing the Hubble tension by $\sim0.9σ$, at the cost of a mild increase in $S_8$. The reconstructed cosmological observables show that WGB leaves the primary CMB almost unchanged while enhancing lensing and small-scale clustering, revealing a characteristic $H_0$-$S_8$ trade-off. WGB dark energy therefore emerges as a physically motivated and observationally viable late-time mechanism for partially alleviating the Hubble tension without introducing new early-Universe physics.

analysis.title_zh: Wald-Gauss-Bonnet 拓扑暗能量的早期与晚期约束及其对 H0 和 S8 张力的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 Wald-Gauss-Bonnet（WGB）拓扑暗能量在早期和晚期宇宙数据下的约束，将模型作为有效流体加入修改版 CLASS，并联合 Planck、ACT DR6、SPT-3G、DESI DR2 BAO 与 Pantheon+。摘要报告称，晚期数据单独与 ΛCDM 相容，而全数据集偏好非零 WGB 贡献，表现为 phantom-like 偏离，并可部分缓解 H0 张力但使 S8 略有增加。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文把新的晚期暗能量机制直接放入 CMB 与低红移联合约束框架中，重点讨论其是否能改变由 CMB 标定的 H0 推断而不破坏早期宇宙成功。摘要还指出模型几乎不改变 primary CMB，但增强 CMB 透镜和小尺度聚类，这对解释 CMB 透镜、S8 与 H0 张力之间的耦合很相关。

摘要称全数据集偏好非零 WGB 贡献，部分降低 H0 张力，但伴随 S8 略升。

papers.title: LiteBIRD Mission Overview after Mission Reformation
papers.abstract: LiteBIRD is a JAXA-led space mission designed to produce all-sky microwave polarization maps. Its primary science goal is to test representative inflationary models by measuring the cosmic microwave background $B$-mode polarization generated by primordial gravitational waves, while also providing new insights into cosmology, particle physics, and astrophysics. The mission concept has been updated following the reformation activities initiated after the Mission Definition Review in 2024. The current concept preserves the central scientific objectives, while simplifying the payload configuration: a single telescope covers 12 frequency bands with band centers spanning 40 to 402~GHz, corresponding to an optical coverage of 34--448~GHz. The telescope is a cross-Dragone reflector with a 500~mm aperture diameter, cooled to approximately 5~K and coupled to transition-edge-sensor bolometer arrays operated at 0.1~K. LiteBIRD will observe from a Lissajous orbit around the Sun--Earth L2 point during a nominal 3-year survey. More specifically, the primary scientific objective is to achieve total uncertainty in the tensor-to-scalar ratio of $δr < 0.002$ (68\% C.L.), including contributions from foreground residuals, statistical uncertainties, instrumental systematics, and margin contingency. The corresponding map-noise requirements are specified separately for the low-, mid-, and high-frequency ranges over the reionization and recombination multipole ranges. This sensitivity makes LiteBIRD unique not only for inflationary science but also for a broad range of scientific investigations probing the history of both the early and late Universe, as well as for astrophysical processes, including Galactic science. This paper summarizes the scientific objectives, updated payload and instrument concepts, observation strategy, and ground segment plans.

papers.title: Cosmological evolution with decaying dark matter: an integral-equation approach
papers.abstract: We present CLASSIER-DDM, an extension of the Boltzmann solver CLASSIER that implements the decaying dark matter (DDM) model via its integral-equation approach. The code handles generic two-body decays of a dark matter particle into two lighter decay products with arbitrary masses, naturally encompassing both massless (dark radiation) and massive (warm) decay products, with their perturbations evaluated via integral equations solved iteratively. We describe the numerical implementation in detail, including the background evolution, the iterative perturbation evolution, and a small-scale analytic approximation. A modest number of iterations is sufficient to achieve sub-$0.1\%$ convergence in the matter power spectrum and the CMB lensing power spectrum across the observationally relevant parameter space. We find that a hundred momentum bins for the decay product perturbations are sufficient to achieve $\mathcal{O}(0.1\%)$ accuracy in the matter power spectrum today up to $k \sim 3\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}$. The code achieves $\mathcal{O}(1\,{\rm min})$ runtimes per evaluation, requiring neither a Boltzmann hierarchy nor any fluid approximation, making parameter estimation with the DDM model numerically tractable. We also discuss the impact of DDM on cosmological observables, focusing on the case of two massive decay products. This work further establishes the integral-equation approach as a versatile and efficient framework for modeling non-cold relics in cosmological perturbation theory.

analysis.title_zh: 含衰变暗物质的宇宙学演化：一种积分方程方法

papers.title: Measuring Cosmic Neutrino Masses Independently of Dark Energy
papers.abstract: Neutrino oscillations establish that neutrinos are massive, providing the only laboratory detection of physics beyond the Standard Model. Direct kinematic experiments bound the electron-neutrino mass to $m_{ν_e} < 0.45$ eV (KATRIN, 90% CL), implying $\sum m_ν\lesssim 1.3$ eV. Conversely, cosmology within $Λ$CDM is highly constraining: Planck CMB, CMB lensing, and DESI DR2 BAO yield $\sum m_ν< 0.056$ eV (95% CL), in 2-3$σ$ tension with the inverted-ordering floor (0.10 eV). However, this bound relies on $Λ$CDM, while data hint at an evolving dark energy. To determine the model dependence of cosmic neutrino mass bounds, we deconstruct each probe's sensitivity to late-time physics and pursue two robust routes to a $\sum m_ν$ bound: (i) The existing dark-energy-marginalized route, retaining all data and marginalizing over $(w_0, w_a)$, is shown to also be immune to flexible binned and cubic $w(a)$ histories, yielding $\sum m_ν< 0.152$ eV, sharpening to $σ(\sum m_ν) \approx 0.043$ eV with Simons Observatory lensing and Spec-S5 BAO. (ii) A new late-Universe-free route combines primary CMB, marginalizing over acoustic-peak smoothing via $A_{\rm lens}$, with the reconstructed lensing spectrum $C_L^{κκ}$, removing late-time expansion dependence by construction. This yields $\sum m_ν< 0.41$ eV today, tightening to 0.31 eV (Simons Observatory) and 0.28 eV (cosmic-variance limit) across all tested dark-energy models. These relaxed bounds trade statistical power for model independence. Interestingly, they land in the sensitivity range targeted by next-generation laboratory experiments like Project 8 ($m_{ν_e} \sim 0.1$ eV), motivating vital synergies between future cosmological and terrestrial neutrino measurements.

analysis.title_zh: 独立于暗能量测量宇宙中微子质量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论宇宙学中微子质量约束对暗能量模型的依赖，拆分各探针对晚期物理的敏感性，并比较暗能量边缘化与不依赖晚期宇宙膨胀的两类约束路线。摘要报告，保留全部数据并边缘化暗能量历史可得较强但模型相关较少的约束，而 primary CMB 结合重建 CMB 透镜谱的路线牺牲统计精度以换取更强的模型独立性。

摘要报告模型独立性增强会放宽当前约束，但与未来实验室中微子质量灵敏度形成互补。
