papers.title: Map Multi-Tool: A Map-Based Approach to Modeling Beam Systematics for Cosmic Microwave Background Experiments
papers.abstract: Cosmic microwave background (CMB) experiments use simulations of instrumental systematic effects to ensure high-fidelity measurements of cosmological parameters. Quantifying the expected magnitude of these effects enables experiments to improve designs, set performance requirements, and understand potential measurement biases from residual systematics. Here we present a new simulation framework, called Map Multi-Tool (MMT), which models beam-related systematics for CMB instruments using a map-based approach. The pipeline convolves simulated sky realizations with distorted intensity and polarization beams, including leakage effects, to produce sky maps and power spectra. These outputs can then be used as inputs for cosmological parameter estimators. this framework enables efficient evaluation of such systematic effects. We demonstrate the capabilities of MMT with examples of non-ideal beams induced by electrical readout crosstalk and detector time constant response. The electrical crosstalk example considers eight different schemes for a time-division multiplexed readout architecture, and shows how they lead to different levels of angular power spectrum leakage for row-switching and inductive crosstalk. The detector time constant example demonstrates how associated uncertainties can alter CMB spectra at high multipoles and bias cosmological parameters. These examples illustrate some of MMT's broad capabilities to inform critical design and calibration decisions to mitigate systematic effects in CMB instruments.

analysis.title_zh: Map Multi-Tool：一种基于地图的宇宙微波背景实验波束系统误差建模方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 Map Multi-Tool，一种面向 CMB 实验的地图域波束系统误差模拟框架，通过将模拟天空与非理想强度和偏振波束卷积来生成地图和功率谱。摘要用电学读出串扰和探测器时间常数响应示例说明，不同硬件非理想性会导致不同程度的角功率谱泄漏，并可能影响高多极谱和宇宙学参数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 下一代 CMB 实验的统计误差不断降低，波束畸变、偏振泄漏、读出串扰和时间响应等仪器系统误差会直接影响温度/偏振功率谱、透镜重建和参数估计。该工具若可靠，可用于实验设计、性能指标制定和标定策略评估。
key_points: 提出 MMT：用地图域模拟 CMB 仪器束相关系统误差。
框架可处理畸变强度束、偏振束和泄漏效应，并输出地图和功率谱。
示例显示读出串扰和探测器时间常数可造成谱泄漏或参数偏差。
methods: 模拟天空实现与畸变强度/偏振波束卷积
包含 leakage effects 的天空图与功率谱生成
电学读出 crosstalk 示例
time-division multiplexed readout architecture 的八种方案
探测器 time constant response 示例
功率谱与宇宙学参数估计器输入
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对地图域近似与真实扫描策略、噪声、偏振角覆盖和束测量误差之间的对应关系，以及示例中的功率谱泄漏如何传播到具体宇宙学参数偏差。

papers.title: Atmosphere mitigation in CMB observations using multi-frequency time-domain component separation
papers.abstract: CMB observations from ground-based observatories are limited in sensitivity by the fluctuating emission from the Earth's atmosphere, mostly due to water vapor inhomogeneities. Even in atmospheric windows, this spurious signal remains the major source of contamination of the data. Traditional mitigation techniques include low-frequency filtering, or for polarization measurements specifically, modulation with a rotating half-wave plate. The first method filters out a significant fraction of the target cosmological signal while the second leaves residuals due to imperfections, temperature to polarization leakage, or polarized atmospheric emission. In this work, we present a new data analysis framework, based on estimation of atmosphere emission templates using a multi-frequency focal plane. The core novelty of this setup is to have detectors dedicated to atmosphere monitoring, allowing for removing atmospheric contamination with time-domain component separation techniques. We introduce a multipole-dependent atmospheric decontamination factor $A^\mathrm{atm}_\ell$ to quantify the relative reduction of the atmospheric contamination angular power spectrum achievable with this approach. We demonstrate that this decontamination factor scales as the inverse of the survey time and that, using that criterion, our component separation pipeline can outperform a classical filter-bin map-making pipeline by a factor of 4000 for $30\le \ell \le 300$.

analysis.title_zh: 利用多频时间域成分分离缓解 CMB 观测中的大气污染
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对地基 CMB 观测中的大气涨落污染，提出用多频焦平面在时间域估计大气发射模板并进行成分分离的分析框架。摘要报告，引入的大气去污染因子随观测时间反比缩放，并且按该指标在 \(30\le \ell \le 300\) 范围内可明显优于经典滤波-分箱制图流程。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 地基 CMB 温度和偏振观测在大角尺度到中等多极范围常受水汽大气发射限制，而过滤会同时损失宇宙学信号。若时间域多频大气模板法有效，它可能改善大尺度偏振、透镜相关分析和其他依赖低/中多极保真度的 CMB 科学目标。
key_points: 提出利用多频焦平面在时间域估计大气发射模板。
引入多极依赖的大气去污染因子 \(A^\mathrm{atm}_\ell\)。
摘要称在 \(30\le \ell \le 300\) 上，该流程按所定义指标可显著优于传统 filter-bin map-making。
methods: 专用于大气监测的探测器
多极依赖大气去污染因子 \(A^\mathrm{atm}_\ell\)
与 classical filter-bin map-making pipeline 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对大气模板与 CMB/前景信号的可分性假设、专用大气监测探测器的频段和噪声设定、\(A^\mathrm{atm}_\ell\) 的定义，以及“优于 4000 倍”这一指标与实际参数约束或地图保真度之间的关系。

papers.title: Dynamical Test of Cosmic Acceleration: $k$-nearest Neighbor Cross Correlation of Cosmic Microwave Background and Cosmic Infrared Background
papers.abstract: The physical origin of cosmic acceleration remains one of the central questions in modern cosmology. The integrated Sachs-Wolfe (ISW) and Rees-Sciama (RS) effects, which arise from the evolution of gravitational potentials, provide a dynamical test of cosmic acceleration. We measure the cross correlation between the Planck temperature map of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) and a foreground-free map of the $100\,μ\mathrm{m}$ cosmic infrared background (CIB) from Y.-K. Chiang (2023), using the $k$-nearest neighbor cumulative distribution function ($k$NN-CDF). As the CIB map is reconstructed from ${\sim}600$ million Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer galaxies extending to $z\approx2.5$, the measurement is equivalent to a galaxy-CMB cross correlation. We find evidence for a positive cross correlation, rejecting the null hypothesis of no correlation at $p=0.02~(2.3σ)$ using the $χ^2$ test. We further quantify its amplitude with $A_{k\mathrm{NN}}$, defined relative to an assumed cosmological model, and obtain $A_{k\mathrm{NN}}=0.95\pm0.20~(4.8σ)$ with respect to $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$ mock data including the ISW and RS effects. The $k$NN-CDF analysis improves the detection significance by ${\sim}20\%$ over the two-point correlation function. We also explore evolving dark energy by constructing two tomographic maps from the full CIB map; the results are consistent with $Λ$CDM. Finer tomographic reconstruction of the CIB, for example from multiband data of SPHEREx, would further tighten constraints on evolving dark energy.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ. 25 pages, 23 figures

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙加速的动力学检验：宇宙微波背景与宇宙红外背景的 k 近邻互相关
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 kNN-CDF 测量 Planck CMB 温度图与去前景 100 μm CIB 图的互相关，以 ISW/RS 效应作为宇宙加速的动力学检验。摘要报告存在正互相关证据，给出相对 ΛCDM mock 的 A_kNN=0.95±0.20，并称层析 CIB 结果与 ΛCDM 一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: ISW/RS 信号直接关联晚期引力势演化，是 CMB 与大尺度结构交叉相关中检验暗能量和引力增长史的重要通道。若 kNN-CDF 确实比传统二点统计更有效，它可能为未来 CIB/星系巡天与 CMB 的交叉分析提供更高灵敏度的非传统统计量。
key_points: 用 kNN-CDF 测量 Planck CMB 温度图与去前景 100 μm CIB 图的互相关。
摘要报告正互相关证据，并称相对二点相关函数探测显著性提高约 20%。
利用 CIB 的两个层析图初步检验演化暗能量，结果与 ΛCDM 一致。
methods: Y.-K. Chiang (2023) foreground-free 100 μm CIB map
约 6 亿个 WISE 星系重建的 CIB 图，延伸至 z≈2.5
ΛCDM mock data including ISW and RS effects
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 kNN-CDF 振幅 A_kNN 对所假定 ΛCDM mock、CIB 去前景质量、掩膜/系统误差和协方差估计的依赖；还要确认所谓 20% 提升是否来自相同数据、相同尺度范围和相同试验因子处理。

papers.title: Modified Cosmology from Mass-to-Horizon Relation: Observational Bounds
papers.abstract: We constrain the class of modified cosmologies derived in Paper I [1] from a generalized mass-to-horizon relation (MHR) that enforces thermodynamic consistency between the Cai-Kim horizon temperature and generalized horizon entropies. The modified Friedmann equations depend on an entropy exponent $m$, an MHR coupling parameter $γ$, and an entanglement-correction amplitude $f_B$, with standard $Λ$CDM recovered in the appropriate limit. Using Pantheon$+$/SH0ES Type~Ia supernovae, cosmic chronometers, DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations, and Planck 2018 CMB distance priors, we constrain eight physically motivated sub-cases via Markov chain Monte Carlo and compare models through the Bayesian log-evidence. The entropy exponent is tightly bounded, $|m-1|\lesssim O(10^{-4})$ when the MHR coupling is fixed ($γ=1$), relaxing to $O(10^{-3})$ along the $m$-$γ$ degeneracy, excluding any macroscopically significant departure from standard horizon thermodynamics. Freeing the MHR coupling parameter or the entanglement amplitude raises the inferred Hubble constant to $h\simeq0.70$-$0.71$, reducing the CMB-SH0ES tension from ${\sim}4σ$ to ${\sim}1.2$-$2.6σ$, but no scenario fully resolves it within a flat universe. The Bayesian log-evidence nevertheless disfavors every extension relative to $Λ$CDM in all dataset combinations ($-16\lesssimΔ\ln Z \lesssim-1$): the improved fits obtained when the SH0ES calibration is included reflect an absorption of the Hubble tension by the additional parameters rather than genuine evidence for modified horizon entropy.

analysis.title_zh: 来自质量-视界关系的修正宇宙学：观测约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文约束一类由广义质量-视界关系和广义视界熵热力学一致性导出的修正宇宙学，并用 SNe、宇宙钟、DESI DR2 BAO 与 Planck 2018 CMB distance priors 做 MCMC 和贝叶斯证据比较。摘要报告熵指数被强烈限制在接近标准情形，部分扩展可提高推断的 H0 并缓和 CMB-SH0ES 张力，但贝叶斯证据在所有数据组合中都不支持这些扩展相对 ΛCDM。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把 CMB distance priors 与低红移距离探针结合，用来检验修改 Friedmann 方程是否能解释 H0 张力和暗能量背景演化。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于这种模型是否只是在压缩后的 CMB 距离信息层面缓和张力，而非真正改善与完整 CMB 各向异性数据的一致性。
key_points: 研究由广义质量-视界关系和广义视界熵导出的修正 Friedmann 宇宙学。
联合 SNe、宇宙钟、DESI BAO 和 Planck 2018 CMB distance priors 做 MCMC 约束与贝叶斯证据比较。
摘要称扩展参数可缓和 Hubble tension，但所有扩展相对 ΛCDM 均被贝叶斯证据不支持。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Planck distance priors 是否足以代表完整 CMB 约束、各子模型先验和贝叶斯证据对先验体积的敏感性，以及 H0 提升是否伴随对 BAO/SNe 或早期宇宙物理的一致性代价。

papers.title: Cosmological consequences of a dynamical dark matter in the light of DESI DR2 measurements
papers.abstract: Recent DESI results exhibit preference for a Null Energy Condition violating dynamical dark energy, with early phantom behaviour. We explore an alternative interpretation in which this preference arises from unconventional dark matter dynamics rather than from dynamical dark energy. We propose a dynamical dark matter (DDM) model, with a non-zero equation of state (EoS) that smoothly interpolates between early time and late time asymptotes across a transition scale factor $a_t$, and study its consequences against cosmological datasets including CMB, DESI DR2 BAO, SNeIa (PantheonPlus, Union3, and DESY5) and growth rate data. We find the early time EoS to be consistent with zero, while the present day value is negative at a significance ranging from $0.42σ$ to $3.02σ$ depending on the dataset combination. The strongest preference occurs from the combination of CMB, DESI, and DESY5 giving the present day EoS to be $-0.060^{+0.013}_{-0.028}$ and $a_t = 0.41^{+0.088}_{-0.13}$ at 68\% CL. This preference for a non-zero, late time DM EoS persists when growth rate data are included and across all three SNeIa compilations considered, while the matter density $Ω_m$ mildly shifts to higher values relative to $Λ$CDM. The model also predicts a lower $σ_8$ and $S_8$ than $Λ$CDM, in better agreement with weak-lensing data, while $H_0$ remains unchanged and in tension with local distance-ladder measurements. The DDM model is preferred over $Λ$CDM ($Δχ^2_{\rm MAP} = -14.093$, $Δ{\rm DIC} = -7.838$ for Planck+DESI+DESY5) but disfavored relative to the CPL parameterization of DE ($Δχ^2_{\rm MAP} = 6.755$, $Δ{\rm DIC} = 7.966$). This preference is consistent among other combination of datasets as well.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 + 5 tables, 3 + 2 figures, comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: DESI DR2 测量背景下动力学暗物质的宇宙学后果
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种暗物质状态方程随尺度因子平滑转变的动力学暗物质模型，用它替代动力学暗能量来解释 DESI DR2 相关偏好，并联合 CMB、BAO、SNeIa 与增长率数据进行检验。摘要报告早期状态方程与零一致，晚期状态方程在若干数据组合中偏负，模型可降低 σ8/S8、但不缓解 H0 张力，且相对 CPL 暗能量参数化仍较不受偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对暗物质背景密度和扰动演化高度敏感，因此任何非冷暗物质状态方程都会影响声学峰、距离标尺以及与 BAO/SNe 的联合约束。该模型还涉及 S8 张力和 DESI 暗能量迹象的解释，对用 CMB 联合低红移巡天区分暗能量与暗物质新物理很相关。
key_points: 提出非零暗物质状态方程的动力学暗物质模型，作为 DESI 所提示动力学暗能量偏好的替代解释。
联合 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、多套 SNeIa 和增长率数据检验模型。
摘要称晚期暗物质状态方程可能为负，S8/σ8 低于 ΛCDM，但 H0 张力仍未解决。
methods: dynamical dark matter model with interpolating equation of state
comparison with ΛCDM and CPL parameterization
MAP χ² and DIC model comparison
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗物质非零状态方程的扰动处理、早期宇宙/CMB 初始条件一致性、与标准冷暗物质物理的可区分性，以及模型比较中相对 ΛCDM 与 CPL 的结论是否受数据组合和参数先验驱动。

papers.title: Cosmological Evidence for Dark Axion-Dark Baryon Interactions from Apparent Phantom Crossing
papers.abstract: Interactions between dark matter and dark energy can lead to an apparent phantom-crossing behavior that mimics the expansion history preferred by the latest cosmological observations from DESI baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO), Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB), and Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) data. In a previous paper [Khoury, Lin, and Trodden 2025 arXiv:2503.16415], we proposed a concrete particle physics realization of this idea, consisting of a strongly coupled dark sector in which a dark axion is coupled to dark baryons. In this paper, we investigate this idea further by comparing its predictions to the latest cosmological data. We implement the dark axion-dark baryon interaction model in a Boltzmann code and confront it with CMB, DESI DR2 BAO, and SNe Ia data. For the CMB+DESI DR2+DES-Dovekie combination, the best-fit model improves the fit relative to $Λ$CDM by $Δχ^2=-14.48$. The preferred solution exhibits a non-monotonic dark-matter mass evolution: the mass decreases between matter-radiation equality and recombination, while increasing over the BAO/SNe-sensitive epoch, leading to an apparent phantom crossing in an effective dark-energy description. Interestingly, the same dynamics produces an Early Dark Energy-like energy injection near matter-radiation equality, but in the data-preferred region this component is too small to raise $H_0$ enough to substantially reduce the current tension.
papers.comment: Add more references. 13 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables

analysis.title_zh: 来自表观 Phantom Crossing 的暗轴子-暗重子相互作用的宇宙学证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究暗物质-暗能量相互作用是否可解释最新 BAO、CMB 和 Ia 型超新星数据偏好的表观 phantom crossing，并采用一个暗轴子耦合暗重子的具体暗扇区模型。摘要称作者将该模型实现进 Boltzmann 代码并与 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、SNe Ia 数据比较，得到相对 ΛCDM 更优的最佳拟合，同时暗物质质量呈非单调演化并产生较小的类早期暗能量注入。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接使用 CMB 与 DESI BAO、超新星联合约束暗扇区相互作用，关系到 CMB 推断的背景演化、物质-辐射相等附近能量成分以及 H0 张力解释。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于该模型是否在不破坏声学峰、重组物理和透镜等约束的前提下改善晚期宇宙数据拟合。
key_points: 将暗轴子-暗重子相互作用模型接入 Boltzmann 代码并与 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、SNe Ia 数据比较。
摘要报告 CMB+DESI DR2+DES-Dovekie 组合相对 ΛCDM 有更好的最佳拟合，且出现有效暗能量描述中的表观 phantom crossing。
模型同时在物质-辐射相等附近产生类似早期暗能量的注入，但摘要称在数据偏好区域不足以显著缓解 H0 张力。
methods: Boltzmann 代码实现暗轴子-暗重子相互作用模型
Type Ia 超新星数据，包含 DES-Dovekie 组合
与 ΛCDM 的拟合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对相互作用模型在 Boltzmann 方程中的实现、暗物质质量非单调演化如何影响重组前后可观测量，以及 Δχ² 改善是否伴随额外参数、先验选择或数据组合依赖。

papers.title: Constraints on the remote quadrupole field from the polarized Sunyaev Zel'dovich effect
papers.abstract: The polarized Sunyaev Zel'dovich (pSZ) effect is a cosmic microwave background (CMB) polarization anisotropy induced by Thomson scattering from free-electrons in non-linear structure. The pSZ signal is determined by the distribution of ionized gas tracing the cosmic web and the CMB quadrupole at the location of free-electrons - the remote quadrupole field. Measuring the pSZ effect provides a consistency check of the optical depth to reionization and sheds light on the anomalous nature of the large-scale CMB temperature anisotropies, such as the low observed CMB temperature quadrupole. In this paper, we demonstrate that a CMB-CMB-galaxy bispectrum summarizes several existing pSZ statistics, and that in our observable Universe the ideal galaxy sample to detect pSZ is at $z \sim 1-2$. We evaluate the bispectrum using CMB data from Planck and ACT with galaxy density from the unWISE galaxy redshift catalog as well as Planck cosmic infrared background (CIB) maps. We do not make a statistically significant detection of the pSZ effect, which is consistent with the expected O$(1)$ signal-to-noise from this data combination. The measured amplitude of the pSZ bispectrum provides constraints on the optical depth bias associated with large-scale structure (the amplitude of the pSZ signal) of $b_q=1.02 \pm 2.64$, the optical depth to reionization of $τ_{\rm rei} = -0.01 \pm 0.14$, and the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ of $σ_r \sim 150$ ($n_t = 0$) or $σ_r \sim 3$ ($n_t = -1$). We forecast that future measurements could tighten the constraints on these quantities by roughly a factor of 3, which is sufficient to provide independent confirmation of the low CMB quadrupole and the optical depth to reionization.
papers.comment: All comments are welcome, 34+20 pages, 23 figures

analysis.title_zh: 利用偏振 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应约束远程四极场
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由非线性结构中自由电子 Thomson 散射产生的偏振 Sunyaev Zel'dovich 效应，以约束自由电子位置处的 CMB 远程四极场。摘要称作者用 CMB-CMB-星系双谱统一描述若干 pSZ 统计量，并结合 Planck、ACT、unWISE 星系红移目录和 Planck CIB 图进行估计，但未获得统计显著探测，只给出对 pSZ 振幅、再电离光学深度和张量标量比的宽约束及未来改进预期。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: pSZ 是 CMB 偏振的次级各向异性，直接连接大尺度 CMB 四极场、宇宙网电离气体分布和再电离光学深度。若未来能精确测量，它可独立检验低 CMB 温度四极异常、τ_rei 推断以及与原初张量扰动相关的大尺度偏振信息。
key_points: pSZ 效应探测的是自由电子处的 CMB 远程四极场，可检验再电离光学深度和大尺度温度四极异常。
作者指出 CMB-CMB-星系双谱可概括若干已有 pSZ 统计量，理想星系样本位于 z 约 1-2。
用 Planck、ACT、unWISE 和 Planck CIB 的组合未得到统计显著的 pSZ 探测，结果与预期低信噪比一致。
methods: unWISE galaxy redshift catalog 的星系密度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对双谱估计量与既有 pSZ 统计量的等价关系、星系/CIB 对电离气体的偏置建模、前景和遮罩处理，以及由未显著探测转化为 τ_rei、b_q 和 r 约束时的先验与退化方向。

papers.title: Testing the Direction of Dark Sector Interaction Using Late-Time Datasets
papers.abstract: In this work, we constrain the phenomenological interacting dark energy $ξ$IDE model using baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from DESI Data Release 1 and Data Release 2, combined with cosmic chronometer measurements, compressed CMB likelihoods, and three different Type Ia supernova compilations: Pantheon$^+$, DES-Dovekie, and Union3. We constrain the parameters of the $ξ$IDE model using a Markov Chain Monte Carlo analysis, using the nested sampling algorithm implemented in the \texttt{dynesty} package through the cosmological inference code \texttt{SimpleMC}. Compared to $Λ$CDM, the $ξ$IDE model favors slightly higher values of the Hubble constant, leading to a reduction in the Hubble tension. However, the tension is not completely resolved for any dataset combination. The parameter $ξ$ is consistently constrained to values close to its $Λ$CDM prediction, indicating no statistically significant deviation from the standard cosmological scenario. Similarly, except for the CMB + DESI DR1 + CC dataset combination, the dark energy equation-of-state parameter prefers values of $w_{\rm X}>-1$, showing a preference for quintessence-like behavior and providing evidence for dynamical dark energy. The interaction parameter combination, $ξ+3w_{\rm X}$, is found to be negative for all dataset combinations, corresponding to energy transfer from dark energy to dark matter. The strongest preference is obtained for the CMB + DESI DR2 + CC + Union3 dataset combination, yielding $ξ+3w_{\rm X}=-0.035\pm0.023$, which corresponds to a deviation of only $1.52σ$ from the non-interacting limit. Therefore, the current data provide only a weak indication of a non-zero dark-sector interaction. Model comparison based on the $Nσ$ statistic shows weak evidence in favor of the interacting scenario, while Bayesian evidence consistently prefers the $Λ$CDM model.

analysis.title_zh: 使用晚期数据集检验暗扇区相互作用的方向
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用晚期宇宙数据并结合压缩 CMB 似然检验现象学相互作用暗能量 ξIDE 模型中暗扇区能量转移的方向。摘要称 MCMC/嵌套采样分析显示该模型可略微提高 H0 并减轻但不能解决 Hubble 张力，ξ 接近 ΛCDM 极限，非零相互作用仅有弱迹象，贝叶斯证据一致偏好 ΛCDM。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作涉及 CMB 压缩似然与 BAO、超新星和宇宙计时器的联合约束，核心问题是晚期背景观测是否需要暗能量和暗物质相互作用。对 CMB 宇宙学而言，它提示仅靠当前联合背景数据尚难建立相互作用暗扇区，同时也提醒压缩 CMB 信息在非标准模型中的适用性需要检查。
key_points: 使用 DESI DR1/DR2 BAO、宇宙计时器、压缩 CMB 似然和三套 Ia 型超新星样本约束 ξIDE 模型。
ξ 接近 ΛCDM 预期，摘要称当前数据没有统计显著偏离标准宇宙学。
相互作用方向组合 ξ+3w_X 在所有数据组合中为负，但最强偏好也仅为 1.52σ，贝叶斯证据仍偏好 ΛCDM。
methods: DESI Data Release 1 and Data Release 2 BAO
Nσ statistic 与 Bayesian evidence 模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对压缩 CMB 似然对相互作用暗能量模型是否充分、ξIDE 参数化中能量转移方向的符号约定、不同超新星汇编和 DESI DR1/DR2 对结果的驱动作用，以及 Nσ 与贝叶斯证据为何给出不同模型偏好。

papers.title: Constraints on Ultra-Light Axions from the DESI DR1 Full Shape, Planck and ACT
papers.abstract: We present updated bounds on ultra-light axions (ULAs) as a subcomponent of dark matter, derived from the full-shape analysis of the DESI Data Release 1 galaxy power spectra combined with Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) data from ACT and Planck. We focus on the mass window $10^{-32}\,\mathrm{eV}\leq m_a \leq 10^{-24}\,\mathrm{eV}$, employing state-of-the-art analysis methods rooted in the Effective Field Theory of Large Scale Structure. For the smallest masses, our joint analysis with DESI improves over CMB-only constraints by more than a factor of 2, establishing the most stringent limits to date. For instance, for $m_a \sim 10^{-29}\,\mathrm{eV}$ ULAs are constrained to be a fraction as small as $0.3\%$ of the total matter energy density. The DESI Luminous Red Galaxy sample shows a mild preference for an ULA subcomponent with $m_a \approx 10^{-26}\,\mathrm{eV}$, mirroring previous hints from BOSS, but this preference vanishes upon combination with CMB data. Probing the largest masses, $m_a\gtrsim10^{-25}\,\mathrm{eV}$, in future studies will benefit from extending the data analysis to smaller scales, both for galaxy clustering and CMB lensing, but will also require concurrent improvements in the theoretical modeling.
papers.comment: 10 pages + appendices and references, 8 figures, 2 tables

analysis.title_zh: 利用 DESI DR1 全形状、Planck 和 ACT 对超轻轴子的限制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 DESI DR1 星系功率谱全形状分析并联合 ACT 与 Planck 的 CMB 数据，更新了质量范围 10^{-32} 到 10^{-24} eV 的超轻轴子作为暗物质子成分的限制。摘要报告称，在最小质量端联合分析相对仅 CMB 约束改进超过 2 倍，并在 m_a 约 10^{-29} eV 时将 ULA 占总物质能量密度的比例限制到 0.3%；LRG 样本中的轻微偏好在加入 CMB 后消失。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 超轻轴子会改变物质功率谱和结构增长，并与 CMB 初级各向异性、CMB 透镜和低红移星系聚类共同受限；这篇工作直接展示了 CMB 与 DESI 大尺度结构数据在暗物质微观性质约束上的互补性。
key_points: 结合 DESI DR1 星系功率谱全形状与 ACT、Planck CMB 数据限制超轻轴子暗物质子成分。
在最低质量端，DESI+CMB 相比仅 CMB 约束有显著改进；摘要称给出迄今最严格限制。
DESI LRG 中对特定质量 ULA 的轻微偏好在加入 CMB 后消失。
methods: DESI DR1 galaxy power spectra full-shape analysis
Effective Field Theory of Large Scale Structure
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 ULA 质量扫描、先验和全形状 EFT 建模如何影响暗物质分数上限，特别是 LRG 轻微偏好为何在加入 CMB 后消失，以及小尺度、CMB 透镜信息是否被一致处理。

papers.title: Anisotropic Dirac-Born-Infeld Inflation with Non-Vacuum Initial States: Primordial Perturbations, Non-Gaussianity, and Observational Constraints
papers.abstract: We investigate linear and nonlinear primordial perturbations in an anisotropic Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) inflationary model with a non-vacuum initial state. Using the Arnowitt-Deser- Misner (ADM) formalism, we expand the action up to second and third order in the curvature perturbation and derive the corresponding scalar and tensor power spectra, as well as the bispectrum and the equilateral non-linearity parameter \(f_{NL}^{\mathrm{equil}}\). The effects of anisotropic corrections and non-Bunch-Davies (non-BD) initial conditions are incorporated through the slow-roll sector and Bogoliubov coefficients. For the numerical analysis, we consider an intermediate expansion scenario together with a phenomenological ansatz for the excited-state occupation number \(N_k\). By comparing the model predictions with recent observational datasets, including Planck2018 TT, TE, EE + lowE + lensing + BK18 + BAO and DESI+CMB+DESY5 data, we identify observationally viable regions in the parameter space of the model. Our analysis indicates that the anisotropic DBI scenario with non-vacuum initial conditions can remain compatible with current constraints on the scalar spectral index, tensor-to-scalar ratio, and equilateral non-Gaussianity for suitable ranges of the anisotropy parameter \(c\) and the initial-state parameter \(N_{k,0}\).
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in European Physical Journal C

analysis.title_zh: 具有非真空初态的各向异性 Dirac-Born-Infeld 暴胀：原初扰动、非高斯性与观测限制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察带非真空初态的各向异性 Dirac-Born-Infeld 暴胀模型，使用 ADM 形式把曲率扰动作用量展开到二阶和三阶，推导功率谱、双谱与赤道型非高斯参数。摘要称，在给定中间膨胀情景和激发态占据数的现象学假设下，该模型在适当的各向异性参数与初态参数范围内可与当前 n_s、r 和赤道型非高斯约束相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暴胀模型的标量谱、张量谱和非高斯性是 CMB 温度、偏振和 B 模式观测的核心目标；该文把非真空初态与各向异性 DBI 动力学联系到 Planck、BK18 和大尺度结构联合约束，对评估 CMB 可检验的早期宇宙模型有直接相关性。
key_points: 研究各向异性 DBI 暴胀在非真空初态下的线性与非线性原初扰动。
通过二阶、三阶作用量推导标量/张量功率谱、双谱和赤道型非高斯参数。
与 Planck2018、BK18、BAO、DESI+CMB+DESY5 等数据比较后，摘要称存在与当前观测相容的参数区域。
methods: second- and third-order action expansion in curvature perturbation
phenomenological ansatz for excited-state occupation number N_k
Planck2018 TT, TE, EE + lowE + lensing + BK18 + BAO
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对非 Bunch-Davies 初态和各向异性修正的参数化是否自洽，观测约束中 Planck/BK18/BAO/DESI 组合的似然实现是否完整，以及 f_NL^{equil}、r、n_s 的可行区域是否依赖特定的 N_k 设定。

papers.title: Assessing the large-scale angular clustering of UNIONS Lyman Break Galaxies via cross-correlations
papers.abstract: Lyman-break galaxies (LBGs), selected via the strong spectral break blueward of the Lyman limit, are powerful tracers of large-scale structure at redshifts $z>2$. In this work, we assess the feasibility of using LBGs selected from the Ultraviolet Near Infrared Optical Northern Survey (UNIONS) multi-band photometric catalog as cosmological probes of the high-redshift Universe using two-point statistics. We demonstrate that spatially varying imaging systematics, driven by variations in PSF depth, seeing across the UNIONS footprint, limit robust measurements of the LBG auto-angular power spectrum on large scales, even after correcting the LBG field with linear or non-linear mitigation techniques. This study shows that clustering analyses of faint galaxy samples close to survey depth are challenging. We therefore turn to cross-correlation measurements with external tracers, in particular the \textit{Planck} CMB lensing convergence and quasars from DESI DR1 and \textit{Quaia}, which are less sensitive to the angular imaging systematics. Using both data and mock catalogues, we demonstrate that the LBG--CMB lensing cross-power spectrum can be measured more robustly than the auto-spectrum, with an amplitude consistent with theoretical predictions. Residual systematics primarily manifest as excess variance at large angular scales, without introducing a significant bias in the recovered signal. Taken together, these results establish UNIONS-selected LBGs as reliable tracers for cross-correlation cosmology at $z\sim 2.5$, and highlight cross-correlation techniques as a powerful and robust avenue for extracting cosmological information from photometric high-redshift galaxy samples in the presence of complex imaging systematics.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 19 figures, to be submitted to The Open Journal of Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 通过互相关评估 UNIONS Lyman Break 星系的大尺度角向聚类
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估 UNIONS 多波段光度星表选出的 Lyman-break 星系能否用二点统计作为 z>2 宇宙学探针。摘要报告称，大尺度自角功率谱受 PSF 深度和 seeing 等成像系统误差严重限制，而与 Planck CMB 透镜以及 DESI DR1、Quaia 类星体的互相关更稳健，LBG-CMB 透镜互功率谱振幅与理论预期一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 高红移星系与 CMB 透镜的互相关可检验结构增长和物质分布，同时降低单一光度样本系统误差的影响；该文对未来利用 CMB 透镜交叉相关开展高红移宇宙学分析具有方法学意义。
key_points: 评估 UNIONS 光度 Lyman-break 星系在 z 约 2.5 作为高红移大尺度结构示踪体的可用性。
大尺度自角功率谱受到随空间变化的成像系统误差限制，即使线性或非线性修正后仍然困难。
与 Planck CMB 透镜、DESI DR1 和 Quaia 类星体的互相关更稳健，LBG-CMB 透镜互功率谱振幅与理论预期一致。
methods: linear and non-linear imaging-systematics mitigation techniques
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对成像系统误差模板、线性/非线性修正方法和 mock catalogues 是否足以刻画大尺度 excess variance，并检查 LBG-CMB 透镜互相关振幅与理论预测一致性的误差预算。

papers.title: Hawking Radiation in $f(\mathcal{R})$ Gravity: Survival of lighter black holes
papers.abstract: Einstein's theory of general relativity (GR) has been remarkably successful in describing gravitational phenomena. However, several open questions in modern cosmology and astrophysics (e.g. inflation, dark energy) suggest the need for extensions or modifications to this framework. Modified gravity (MGR) theories, including scalar-tensor models and higher-dimensional approaches, attempt to address these gaps while maintaining consistency with established experimental tests. This work investigates Hawking radiation within an $f(\mathcal{R})$ gravity theory, with $\mathcal{R}$ being scalar curvature, focusing on its implications for primordial black holes (PBHs) as potential dark matter (DM) candidates. Our analysis reveals that PBHs evaporate slowly in MGR compared to GR predictions. Specifically, we find that non-rotating black holes with masses $\sim 5 \times 10^{13}$ g or lower would have survived by the present epoch, depending on the MGR parameter-a mass threshold approximately at least ten times smaller than in GR. This retarded evaporation timeline imposes relaxed new constraints on the viability of PBHs as DM constituents, thereby reshaping the landscape of possible solutions to the DM problem. This motivates further investigation into alternative gravitational theories and their cosmological consequences.
papers.comment: 8 pages including 11 figures(13 png files); comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: f(\mathcal{R}) 引力中的霍金辐射：更轻黑洞的存活
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 f(\mathcal{R}) 修正引力中的霍金辐射，并讨论其对原初黑洞作为暗物质候选体的影响。摘要报告称，相比广义相对论，该模型下 PBH 蒸发更慢，某些质量约为 5×10^13 g 或更低的非旋转黑洞可存活至今，具体取决于修正引力参数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PBH 暗物质会影响早期宇宙、引力理论和暗物质约束版图；虽然该文不直接分析 CMB 数据，但 PBH 丰度和蒸发历史与宇宙学观测约束相关，可能间接影响 CMB 时代前后的能量注入与暗物质模型讨论。
key_points: 研究 f(\mathcal{R}) 修正引力中的霍金辐射。
摘要称 PBH 在该模型中比 GR 预言蒸发更慢。
结果被用于讨论 PBH 作为暗物质候选体的约束变化。
methods: 与广义相对论下霍金蒸发预言比较
针对非旋转原初黑洞质量阈值的估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 f(\mathcal{R}) 模型和参数范围的具体设定、霍金温度/蒸发率推导是否自洽，以及“更轻黑洞可存活”对 PBH 暗物质丰度约束的适用前提。

papers.title: XShooter DESI Lens Program: Sample characterization
papers.abstract: Large imaging surveys in cosmology are detecting orders of magnitude more lens systems than known so far. This unprecedented dataset will lead to robust constraints on cosmology and galaxy evolution models. However, a preliminary careful characterization of the lens and source samples are mandatory. In this work, we report on a VLT/XShooter observation program of 67 lens systems to characterize their spectroscopic redshift distribution. These systems were previously detected on the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Legacy Imaging Surveys by Huang et al. 2021 and Storfer et al. 2022 with deep residual neural network. We manage to measure redshifts for 58 lenses and 57 sources. We also identify 2 sources with indication of outflow in the shape of the emission lines and 7 sources with rotating disks in $[OII]$ or $Hα$. We find no particular bias associated to the redshift measurement operation, meaning that our measured source redshift distribution is likely representative of the true one and can be used to calibrate analyses in large imaging surveys.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 long table, long appendix with 63 lens system descriptions, submitted to A&A

analysis.title_zh: XShooter DESI 透镜计划：样本表征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 VLT/XShooter 对 67 个 DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys 强透镜系统的观测计划，用于表征透镜和源的光谱红移分布。摘要称测得 58 个透镜和 57 个源的红移，并未发现红移测量操作带来的明显偏差，因此源红移分布可能可代表真实分布并用于大型成像巡天校准。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 强透镜样本的红移分布和选择函数是透镜宇宙学、星系演化及大型巡天系统误差控制的基础；对 CMB 研究者而言，它与低红移结构、暗能量约束以及和 CMB 互补的宇宙学探针有关。
key_points: 基于 VLT/XShooter 对 67 个强透镜系统进行光谱表征。
样本来自 DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys，并由深度残差神经网络筛选。
摘要称已测源红移分布可用于校准大型成像巡天分析。
methods: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys 透镜候选样本
深度残差神经网络筛选的透镜系统
透镜与源的光谱红移测量
[OII] 与 Hα 发射线形态识别
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对样本选择函数、红移测量失败样本是否真的无偏、以及该 67 个系统对未来强透镜宇宙学或星系演化标定的代表性。

papers.title: Alleviating the Hubble Tension with Smooth Sign-Switching Dark Energy: Full CMB Constraints with DESI and PantheonPlus
papers.abstract: Sign-switching dark energy has recently been proposed as a minimal modification of the late-time expansion history aimed at alleviating tensions within the standard cosmological model. In this work, we investigate ECDM, a smooth realisation of this scenario, with the dark energy density gradually transitioning from a negative to a positive value. We develop a consistent formulation of the perturbation equations that remains well behaved even when the dark energy equation-of-state parameter diverges during the transition. We confront the model with a comprehensive set of cosmological observations, including cosmic microwave background measurements from Planck 2018, ACT DR6 and SPT-3G, baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from DESI DR2, Type Ia supernova distances from Pantheon+, and local Hubble constant measurement of SH0ES. The inclusion of perturbations allows us to assess the impact of the model on structure growth and CMB anisotropies, providing a more thorough test of sign-switching dark energy. Our results show that this class of models is fully compatible with current precision cosmological observations while alleviating the Hubble tension and providing a compelling modification of the late-time dynamics of the Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 用平滑变号暗能量缓解 Hubble 张力：结合 DESI 与 PantheonPlus 的完整 CMB 约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种平滑实现的变号暗能量模型 ECDM，其中暗能量密度从负值逐渐过渡到正值，并构造了在过渡期间状态方程参数发散时仍表现良好的扰动方程。作者将其与 Planck 2018、ACT DR6、SPT-3G、DESI DR2、Pantheon+ 和 SH0ES 等数据比较，摘要称该类模型与当前精密宇宙学观测相容，同时可缓解 Hubble 张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇直接使用多组 CMB 数据并讨论暗能量扰动、结构增长和 CMB 各向异性，对评估晚期宇宙动力学是否能缓解 H0 张力很相关；它也涉及 DESI BAO 与超新星数据如何和 CMB 联合限制非标准暗能量。
key_points: 提出并检验平滑变号暗能量 ECDM。
摘要强调构造了在状态方程参数发散时仍良态的扰动方程。
联合 Planck、ACT、SPT-3G、DESI、Pantheon+ 和 SH0ES 检验模型。
methods: 平滑变号暗能量 ECDM 模型
暗能量扰动方程的一致 formulation
Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星距离
SH0ES 本地 Hubble 常数测量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对暗能量密度过零和状态方程发散处的扰动处理、CMB 各向异性和结构增长约束如何实现，以及缓解 Hubble 张力是否依赖 SH0ES 或特定数据组合。

papers.title: Neutrino mass constraints in the Schwarzschild-de Sitter black-hole dark energy model with ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 data
papers.abstract: Recent DESI observations have posed new challenges to $Λ$CDM, showing a preference for dynamical dark energy and yielding neutrino mass constraints within $Λ$CDM that approach the lower bound allowed by neutrino oscillation experiments. In this work, we investigate cosmological constraints on the key neutrino parameters, $\sum m_ν$ and $N_{\rm eff}$, within the Schwarzschild-de Sitter black-hole dark energy (SdSDE) framework. We use cosmic microwave background (CMB) data from Planck and ACT DR6, baryon acoustic oscillation data from DESI DR2, and type Ia supernova data from DES-Dovekie and PantheonPlus. We find that SdSDE scenarios prefer a positive neutrino mass whenever $\sum m_ν$ is allowed to vary. Using CMB+DESI+DES-Dovekie data, we obtain $\sum m_ν=0.207^{+0.047}_{-0.052}~{\rm eV}$ for SdSDE+$\sum m_ν$, reduced to $\sum m_ν=0.162^{+0.055}_{-0.056}~{\rm eV}$ when $N_{\rm eff}$ is also varied. This arises from the positive correlation between $N_{\rm eff}$ and $\sum m_ν$, together with the systematic preference of SdSDE for values of $N_{\rm eff}$ below the standard value. Furthermore, the best-fit $χ^2$ comparison shows that $Λ$CDM with extended neutrino parameters is strongly preferred over the corresponding SdSDE extension. Overall, the positive neutrino mass preference induced by SdSDE may reflect parameter compensation rather than an improved global fit, a possibility that should be further tested with future high-precision observational data.

analysis.title_zh: 结合 ACT DR6 和 DESI DR2 数据在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞暗能量模型中约束中微子质量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞暗能量模型中，用 Planck/ACT DR6 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 与超新星数据约束 Σmν 和 Neff。摘要报告称，当允许 Σmν 变化时 SdSDE 倾向正的中微子质量，但 χ² 比较显示带扩展中微子参数的 ΛCDM 比相应 SdSDE 扩展更受偏好，提示该质量偏好可能来自参数补偿。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接使用 ACT DR6 与 Planck CMB 数据，并讨论小尺度 CMB、BAO、超新星和暗能量模型假设如何影响中微子质量推断。对于 CMB 宇宙学读者，关键意义在于它提醒中微子质量“检出”或上限可能强烈依赖暗能量参数化和模型拟合质量，而不能只看边缘化后的质量区间。
key_points: 在 SdSDE 黑洞暗能量框架下重新约束总中微子质量与有效相对论自由度。
使用 Planck、ACT DR6、DESI DR2、DES-Dovekie 与 PantheonPlus 等数据组合。
摘要称 SdSDE 可诱导正的中微子质量偏好，但最佳拟合 χ² 比较并不支持其相对 ΛCDM 的整体拟合改进。
methods: DES-Dovekie Ia 型超新星数据
PantheonPlus Ia 型超新星数据
在 SdSDE、SdSDE+Σmν、SdSDE+Σmν+Neff 等扩展模型中进行宇宙学参数约束
最佳拟合 χ² 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 SdSDE 参数与中微子参数之间的退化方向、数据组合选择对 Σmν 偏好的驱动作用，以及 χ² 比较中哪些数据集贡献了对 ΛCDM 扩展模型的偏好。

papers.title: Intertwined Constraints in Extended Cosmologies: Dark Energy, Curvature, Neutrinos, and Inflation
papers.abstract: We present a systematic reassessment of cosmological constraints beyond $Λ$CDM by progressively relaxing the assumptions underlying Dark Energy (DE), Curvature, Neutrinos, and Inflation. Using the latest CMB data together with DESI BAO and different SN catalogues, we show that the preference for dynamical DE persists across all the extended cosmologies considered. $Ω_k$ remains compatible with flatness, despite a mild $2.2σ$ preference for $Ω_k>0$ that is substantially degraded in dynamical DE extensions. Constraints on $N_{\rm eff}$ are broadly consistent with $N_{\rm eff}=3.04$, while cosmological upper limits on the total neutrino mass vary substantially across the cosmologies explored, ranging from $\sum m_ν\lesssim 0.06$ eV to $\lesssim 0.2$ eV. We quantify both the preference for the mass ordering and the apparent tension between cosmology and oscillation experiments, showing that they are strongly framework dependent. We find no evidence for inflationary tensor modes, with $r\lesssim 0.035$. Constraints on the spectral index $n_s$ show significant model dependence. Allowing for the scalar runnings produces a mild shift toward $α_s>0$ and $β_s>0$ that can reabsorb the preference for larger $n_s$ found in small-scale CMB data, although both $α_s$ and $β_s$ remain consistent with zero at $\sim 1.5σ$. We highlight the implications for slow-roll inflation and benchmark models. None of the extensions considered here can resolve the $H_0$ tension. We discuss the implications for $Ω_m$ and $S_8$. Overall, dynamical DE is the only significant deviation from $Λ$CDM and has the strongest impact on the inferred conclusions in the other sectors of the model.
papers.comment: 102 pages, 30 figures, 26 tables, including supplementary material. A systematic assessment of current cosmological constraints in extended parameter spaces

analysis.title_zh: 扩展宇宙学中的交织约束：暗能量、曲率、中微子与暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用最新 CMB、DESI BAO 和不同超新星星表，对暗能量、曲率、中微子和暴胀假设逐步放宽后的宇宙学约束进行系统重评。摘要报告称，动力学暗能量是最显著且影响最广的 ΛCDM 偏离；曲率、Neff、Σmν、ns、r 和 running 的推断均存在不同程度模型依赖，但所考察扩展不能解决 H0 张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 参数推断高度相关，因为它把 CMB 与 DESI BAO、超新星联合后，检查多个常被单独讨论的扩展扇区之间的相互影响。对研究 CMB 的读者而言，它的价值在于评估小尺度 CMB、暴胀参数和中微子约束在动力学暗能量背景下是否仍可稳健解释。
key_points: 系统放宽暗能量、曲率、中微子和暴胀相关假设来重评 ΛCDM 之外的约束。
摘要称动力学暗能量偏好在所考虑扩展模型中持续存在，而 H0 张力未被这些扩展解决。
中微子质量上限、质量排序偏好、ns 与张量标量比约束均表现出模型依赖性。
methods: 逐步放宽暗能量、曲率、中微子和暴胀假设的扩展宇宙学模型比较
对质量排序偏好及宇宙学与振荡实验张力的量化
标量谱指数、张量标量比及标量 running 参数约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“动力学暗能量偏好”在不同 CMB、DESI BAO 和超新星星表组合下的稳健性，以及各扩展参数是否同时释放时改变了中微子、曲率和暴胀结论。

papers.title: Unveiling the properties of galaxy cores excavated by supermassive black hole binaries with SHARP
papers.abstract: Massive black hole (MBH) binaries form as a result of galaxy mergers and can coalesce into a single MBH by emitting gravitational waves detectable by LISA and pulsar timing array campaigns. Although electromagnetic observations of bound MBH binaries are extremely challenging, an indirect signature of their passage is the core scouring: a bound binary shrinks by ejecting nearby stars, creating a flat stellar density core of the size of the binary influence radius. Through this mechanism, stars on radial orbits are preferentially ejected, resulting in a central tangential anisotropy in the velocity field of stars that can be identified via IFU observations. At present, the sample of galaxies with such properties is limited by instrument resolution to the closest giant ellipticals within the nearest ~100 Mpc. The SHARP-VESPER IFU and MICADO+MORFEO instruments can work in concert to detect both these features: their unprecedented spatial resolution can allow us to detect central scourings with sizes above ~500 pc in principle up to reionization; smaller cores of ~150 pc can be detected up to z~0.14, encompassing a volume that is more than 40 times the one available at present. In addition, they can enable the search for these features in smaller galaxies, enhancing by a factor 30 the volume over which we can search for pc-size cores around 1-10 million solar mass MBHs. The fraction of scoured galaxies, combined with their kinematic and morphological properties, carry information on the amount of merging binaries, their masses and typical environment, thus knowing this will be fundamental to complement the forthcoming gravitational wave data.
papers.comment: 8 pages, part of the SHARP Science Book collection on New Astronomy (https://www.sciencedirect.com/special-issue/10W3B6JJBXH)

analysis.title_zh: 利用 SHARP 揭示超大质量黑洞双星挖掘出的星系核心性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论大质量黑洞双星在星系并合后通过抛射中心恒星挖空星系核心，并在恒星速度场中留下切向各向异性的间接电磁信号。摘要称 SHARP-VESPER IFU 与 MICADO+MORFEO 的空间分辨率可显著扩大这类核心 scouring 特征的可探测范围，从而补充未来 LISA 和脉冲星计时阵列的引力波数据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于星系与引力波天体物理，并非直接 CMB 研究；与宇宙学的联系在于它涉及星系并合史、超大质量黑洞双星种群以及可探测到再电离时期附近的结构演化线索。对 CMB 读者而言，它更像是理解晚期结构形成和多信使观测背景的外围参考，而不是 CMB 参数约束论文。
key_points: 研究大质量黑洞双星通过 eject 恒星造成星系核心 scouring 的可观测特征。
摘要强调 SHARP-VESPER IFU 与 MICADO+MORFEO 的高空间分辨率可扩大可探测体积。
核心形态和恒星运动学各向异性可作为未来引力波观测的电磁互补信息。
methods: 积分视场光谱 IFU 观测
恒星密度核心 scouring 特征
恒星速度场中的中心切向各向异性
与 LISA 和脉冲星计时阵列引力波观测的互补讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对摘要中关于可探测核心尺度、红移范围和体积增益的估算假设，特别是仪器分辨率、表面亮度限制和核心识别标准。

papers.title: Running into tension: primordial black holes from ultra-slow-roll inflation, spectral running, and the Hubble tension
papers.abstract: Single-field ultra-slow-roll (USR) inflation is among the most studied mechanisms for primordial black hole (PBH) formation. These models predict a negative spectral running ($α_s<0$), whose magnitude increases with the PBH mass. This is in tension with recent hints for positive running from Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) data. However, inflationary parameters inferred from CMB data are sensitive to the assumed pre-recombination expansion history, which is precisely where new physics motivated by the Hubble tension should operate. Focusing on axion-like early dark energy (EDE) as a benchmark, we investigate the effect of such pre-recombination new physics on $α_s$, and hence on the viability of USR PBH models, in light of state-of-the-art CMB data from Planck, ACT, and the South Pole Telescope, together with Baryon Acoustic Oscillation data from DESI DR2. Our analysis therefore provides an updated set of constraints on $α_s$ and the running of the running $β_s$. For most dataset combinations, moving from $Λ$CDM to EDE increases the inferred $α_s$: once the acoustic angular scale $θ_s$ is fixed, EDE increases the diffusion-to-acoustic angular scale ratio $θ_d/θ_s$, and the shift in $α_s$ compensates this extra damping by increasing small-scale power. In this sense, tension calls for tension: taking the Hubble tension seriously as an indication for new physics strengthens the challenges faced by USR PBH models. More broadly, our analysis stresses that inflationary model selection using CMB-inferred inflationary parameters such as $n_s$ and $α_s$ may be premature, especially until the Hubble tension, and more generally the pre-recombination expansion history, is understood.

analysis.title_zh: 陷入张力：来自超慢滚暴胀的原初黑洞、谱运行与哈勃张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论单场超慢滚暴胀产生原初黑洞所需的负谱运行，是否与ACT等CMB数据中正谱运行的迹象相冲突。作者以轴子型早期暗能量为预复合前新物理基准，结合Planck、ACT、SPT和DESI DR2 BAO数据约束α_s与β_s；摘要报告多数数据组合中从ΛCDM转向EDE会提高推断的α_s，从而使USR PBH模型更受挑战。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接连接CMB阻尼尾、小尺度原初功率谱推断、哈勃张力相关的预复合前物理，以及PBH暗物质模型选择。它提醒CMB读者：用CMB推断的n_s和α_s筛选暴胀模型时，结论可能依赖对早期膨胀史的假设。
key_points: 研究USR暴胀形成PBH时对负谱运行的要求。
比较ΛCDM与轴子型早期暗能量下CMB推断的α_s和β_s。
摘要称EDE通常会提高推断的α_s，从而加剧USR PBH模型困难。
methods: DESI DR2重子声波振荡数据
以轴子型早期暗能量作为预复合前新物理基准模型
约束谱运行α_s与运行的运行β_s
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对不同数据组合下α_s、β_s约束如何变化，以及EDE通过θ_d/θ_s改变阻尼尾并由α_s补偿小尺度功率这一机制是否依赖具体先验或数据选择。

papers.title: Cosmological Viability of Exponential Infrared $f(T)$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the cosmological viability of exponential infrared $f(T)$ teleparallel gravity using current cosmological observations. This framework realizes late-time cosmic acceleration through torsional modifications of gravity without enlarging the six-parameter cosmological parameter space of spatially flat $Λ$CDM, and admits two distinct solution branches: a phantom-like model (Model I) and a model featuring a negative-to-positive transition in the effective torsional dark-energy density (Model II). We constrain both branches using CMB observations from Planck, ACT, and SPT together with DESI BAO and Pantheon+ Type Ia supernovae. We find that the principal branch (Model I) alleviates the Hubble tension relative to $Λ$CDM, but remains statistically disfavoured by the combined dataset. The secondary branch (Model II) is decisively ruled out. We show that the failure of Model II originates from the interplay between background and perturbation constraints: once late-time distance measurements constrain the expansion history, the model becomes overconstrained, forcing correlated shifts in $Ω_{\rm m}h^2$, $A_s$, $n_s$, and $τ_{\rm reio}$, degrading the fit to the CMB damping tail and driving the optical depth to unphysical values. Our results demonstrate that perturbation observables provide stringent and complementary tests of teleparallel gravity beyond the background expansion history.

analysis.title_zh: 指数型红外 f(T) 引力的宇宙学可行性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用当前宇宙学观测检验一种指数型红外f(T)遥平行引力模型，该模型不扩大平直ΛCDM的六参数空间而试图解释晚期加速，并包含两个解分支。摘要报告，结合Planck、ACT、SPT、DESI BAO和Pantheon+后，主分支相对ΛCDM可缓解Hubble张力但统计上仍不受青睐，次分支则被决定性排除。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作强调CMB不仅通过几何距离约束修正引力，也通过扰动、阻尼尾、A_s、n_s和再电离光学深度等量检验模型。对CMB研究者而言，它说明晚期加速或Hubble张力模型必须同时通过背景和扰动层面的CMB检验。
key_points: 检验指数型红外f(T)遥平行引力的两个宇宙学分支。
使用CMB、BAO和超新星数据联合约束。
摘要称Model I缓解Hubble张力但总体拟合受挫，Model II被排除。
methods: 背景膨胀与扰动观测联合约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对两个分支的参数化、扰动方程处理和先验设置，尤其是Model II中τ_reio趋向非物理值及CMB阻尼尾拟合变差的具体来源。

papers.title: Cosmological Concordance in an Especially Opaque Universe: A Tentative Cosmological Detection of Physical Neutrino Mass in $Λ$CDM
papers.abstract: The measurement of the sum of neutrino masses is among the primary promises of precision cosmology, achievable by combining complementary early- and late-Universe probes. However, these datasets currently exhibit mild-to-strong disagreements within $Λ$CDM and its simplest extensions, giving rise to multiple tensions, including the Hubble tension, the preference for "negative" neutrino mass, and indications of evolving dark energy. It has recently been shown that these tensions can be alleviated by adopting a higher value of the optical depth to reionization parameter, $τ$, when large-scale cosmic microwave background (CMB) polarization data are ignored. We extend this proposal and show that an especially high prior on $τ= 0.11 \pm 0.006$ simultaneously addresses all three of these tensions, significantly reducing the need for new physics beyond $Λ$CDM. We determine the "concordance" value of $τ$ by requiring physical neutrino mass and consistency of the Hubble constant, $H_0$, inferred from the CMB and that preferred by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) and full-shape measurements. Within this high-$τ$ Universe, we obtain the first $2σ$ detection of a positive neutrino mass, $Σm_ν = 0.10^{+0.04}_{-0.05}$~eV at 68\% C.L., while restoring cosmological concordance between datasets within $Λ$CDM. In particular, low-redshift distance predictions are consistent with DESI BAO observations and the inferred dark-energy equation-of-state parameters are consistent with a cosmological constant, both with and without supernovae data. The concordance power of our $τ$ prior further motivates new measurements of $τ$, e.g., through large angular scale CMB polarization observations with the \textit{LiteBIRD}, CLASS, or proposed PICO experiments. (Abridged)

analysis.title_zh: 一个特别不透明宇宙中的宇宙学一致性：ΛCDM中物理中微子质量的试探性宇宙学探测
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究在ΛCDM框架内，通过采用较高的再电离光学深度τ先验，是否能同时缓解Hubble张力、“负”中微子质量偏好和演化暗能量迹象。摘要称作者以要求中微子质量为物理正值且CMB与DESI推断的H_0一致来确定τ，并在τ=0.11±0.006先验下得到Σm_ν=0.10^{+0.04}_{-0.05} eV的2σ正质量探测，同时改善多数据集一致性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离光学深度τ是CMB大尺度偏振和振幅退化关系中的关键参数，直接影响A_s、结构增长和中微子质量推断。该论文对CMB读者的重要性在于，它把τ测量系统性与中微子质量、DESI一致性和暗能量结论联系起来，并突出LiteBIRD、CLASS、PICO等未来大角尺度偏振观测的价值。
key_points: 提出用较高再电离光学深度先验缓解多项ΛCDM内张力。
在忽略大尺度CMB偏振数据的语境下讨论τ的“协调”取值。
摘要报告在高τ先验下得到Σm_ν正值的2σ探测并改善数据一致性。
methods: CMB与DESI BAO及全形状测量的一致性要求
低红移距离预测与DESI BAO比较
含或不含超新星数据的暗能量状态方程检验
LiteBIRD、CLASS、PICO等大角尺度CMB偏振测量作为未来动机
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对高τ先验的物理和观测依据，以及忽略大尺度CMB偏振数据后所得Σm_ν探测与数据协调是否由先验主导。

papers.title: Constraining primordial oscillations and inflationary particle production with Planck, ACT DR6, and DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Non-standard inflationary models often predict oscillatory features in the primordial power spectrum. We present constraints on general oscillatory templates for primordial power spectra, including those that vary linearly and logarithmically with wavenumber, as well as oscillations induced by inflationary particle production. We utilize the Planck 2018 and Atacama Cosmology Telescope Data Release 6 cosmic microwave background data as well as large-scale structure data from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 2. To efficiently explore the multimodal posteriors for these models as well as performing mode comparisons, we integrate the preconditioned sequential Monte Carlo sampler, pocoMC, into the widely used sampling code, Cobaya. We find that the combined dataset tightens the 95% CL upper bounds on the general oscillation amplitudes to $A_{\text{lin}} < 0.021$, $A_{\text{log}} < 0.022$, and $A_{\text{log rf}} < 0.023$, restricting the amplitude to $\sim 2\%\, A_s$. For the inflationary particle production model, our analysis places a maximum a posteriori constraint on the coupling constant of $g = 0.034$. While these models all provide an improved fit to the data compared to the concordance $Λ$CDM model, the Bayesian evidence still reveals a moderate preference for $Λ$CDM compared to models with general oscillations and is inconclusive regarding the particle production model, suggesting that the added complexity of these models beyond the standard model is not statistically justified by current data.

analysis.title_zh: 用 Planck、ACT DR6 与 DESI DR2 约束原初振荡和暴胀期粒子产生
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck 2018、ACT DR6 和 DESI DR2 约束非标准暴胀模型预言的原初功率谱振荡，包括线性/对数波数依赖模板和暴胀粒子产生模型，并用 pocoMC+Cobaya 处理多峰后验和模型比较。摘要报告联合数据将一般振荡振幅的 95% CL 上限压到约 2% A_s 量级，粒子产生模型给出耦合常数的最大后验约束，同时贝叶斯证据对一般振荡模型仍中等偏好 ΛCDM，对粒子产生模型结论不明确。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初功率谱特征会直接投影到 CMB 温度、偏振和物质功率谱中，是检验暴胀微物理的重要窗口。该工作把高精度 CMB 与 DESI 大尺度结构数据联合起来，并显式进行模型证据比较，因此对判断 CMB 中潜在振荡特征是否超出 ΛCDM 有直接参考价值。
key_points: 检验原初功率谱中的线性、对数振荡模板以及暴胀粒子产生模型。
联合使用 Planck 2018、ACT DR6 CMB 数据和 DESI DR2 大尺度结构数据。
摘要称振荡模型相对 ΛCDM 改善拟合，但贝叶斯证据仍不支持用额外复杂度取代 ΛCDM。
methods: Atacama Cosmology Telescope Data Release 6 CMB 数据
Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 2 大尺度结构数据
一般振荡原初功率谱模板：随波数线性变化、对数变化及 log rf 形式
暴胀粒子产生诱导的振荡模型
将预条件序贯蒙特卡洛采样器 pocoMC 集成到 Cobaya
多峰后验探索与模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对振荡模板的先验范围、频率参数处理、look-elsewhere 效应和贝叶斯证据计算设置，因为这些会直接影响“拟合改善但模型不受偏好”的判断。

papers.title: A hidden reionization prior biases cosmological inference
papers.abstract: Precision cosmology assumes that cosmic reionization was a single smooth transition. We show that this assumption is in tension with current observations: the Planck optical depth, patchy kinetic Sunyaev--Zel'dovich (PkSZ)limits from SPT and ACT, and the Ly$α$ forest endpoint cannot be simultaneously reproduced by any viable monotonic ionization history. Non-parametric reconstructions and Planck EE polarization provide independent support for an additional ionization component at $z \gtrsim 12$. Incorporating this early phase relaxes the upper bound on the summed neutrino mass to $\sum m_ν< 0.39$~eV ($95\%$ CL) and shifts $σ_8$ toward values preferred by weak-lensing surveys, both consequences of the standard $A_s$--$τ_e$ degeneracy. These shifts arise from relaxing a hidden prior on reionization shape rather than from new physics, and identify reionization shape as an implicit prior in cosmological inference. Next generation of CMB and 21~cm experiments will be able to test this directly,which will convert what has been an unflagged systematic on $σ_8$ and $\sum m_ν$ into a quantified statistical uncertainty.

analysis.title_zh: 隐藏的再电离先验会偏置宇宙学推断
analysis.summary_zh: 本文质疑精密宇宙学中默认的单次平滑再电离假设，比较 Planck 光学深度与 EE 偏振、SPT/ACT 的 patchy kSZ 限制以及 Lyα 森林终点，并进行非参数化电离史重建。摘要称现有观测支持 z≳12 的额外早期电离成分；放松再电离形状先验后，中微子质量上限变为 Σmν<0.39 eV、σ8 向弱透镜偏好的方向移动。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对再电离光学深度 τ_e 的测量与原初振幅 A_s 强简并，进而影响 σ8、物质涨落幅度和中微子质量等核心宇宙学参数。若再电离形状假设本身是未标记的系统误差，那么基于 CMB 的参数约束和与弱透镜等低红移探针的张力解释都需要重新评估。
key_points: 指出常用的单调平滑再电离假设可能构成隐含先验。
摘要称 Planck 光学深度、SPT/ACT patchy kSZ 限制和 Lyα 森林终点难以由可行单调电离史同时解释。
加入 z ≳ 12 的早期电离成分会改变中微子质量和 σ8 推断，来源于 A_s–τ_e 简并而非新物理。
methods: SPT 和 ACT 的 patchy kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 限制
非参数化再电离历史重建
包含 z \gtrsim 12 早期电离成分的模型
利用 A_s--τ_e 简并解释参数偏移
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“无可行单调电离史可同时再现实测”的判据、非参数重建先验、PkSZ 建模以及 Lyα 终点约束如何合并；这些决定了所谓隐藏再电离先验是否稳健。

papers.title: Probing Anomalous Microwave Emission with the Square Kilometre Array
papers.abstract: Anomalous microwave emission (AME) represents an excess of radiation in the 10-60 GHz range, distinct from synchrotron, free-free, or thermal dust emission. Although most commonly attributed to electric dipole radiation from rapidly rotating small dust grains (spinning dust), alternative mechanisms such as magnetic dipole emission (MDE) remain plausible. The detection of AME across diverse environments, from diffuse interstellar clouds to protoplanetary disks and external galaxies, suggests that multiple physical processes or carriers may contribute to its origin. Understanding AME is essential for both Galactic astrophysics and cosmology, as it constitutes a significant foreground for cosmic microwave background (CMB) studies, potentially biasing measurements. This chapter reviews current theoretical frameworks and observational evidence for AME, highlighting the key outstanding questions concerning its emission mechanisms, carriers, and polarization properties. We discuss how the Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO), through its unprecedented sensitivity, angular resolution, and frequency coverage, will transform AME studies. SKA observations will enable detailed mapping of AME morphology, precise characterisation of its spectral energy distribution, and the identification of its carriers in Galactic and extragalactic environments. By combining SKA-mid data with higher-frequency observations from ALMA and other facilities such as SPHEREx, it will be possible to disentangle competing models and exploit AME as a diagnostic probe of interstellar grain physics and the small-scale structure of the interstellar medium.
papers.comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKAII(AASKAII), 2026 (arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no: AASKAII/Vidal01

analysis.title_zh: 用平方公里阵列探测异常微波辐射
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇章节综述异常微波辐射 AME 的理论解释和观测证据，重点讨论 spinning dust、磁偶极辐射等机制及其载体、偏振性质等未解问题。摘要称 SKAO 的灵敏度、角分辨率和频率覆盖将改进 AME 形态成图、谱能量分布刻画和载体识别，并可与 ALMA、SPHEREx 等联合区分竞争模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: AME 位于 CMB 前景建模高度敏感的微波频段，若其谱形、空间分布或偏振性质处理不当，会影响 CMB 温度和偏振信号的前景分离。面向未来高精度 CMB 实验，SKA 对 AME 物理的约束可帮助改进银河前景模板和系统误差预算。
key_points: 综述 10–60 GHz 异常微波辐射的物理解释和观测证据。
强调 AME 是 CMB 分析的重要银河前景，可能偏置测量。
讨论 SKAO 结合 ALMA、SPHEREx 等数据区分 spinning dust、MDE 等模型的潜力。
methods: AME 理论框架与观测证据整理
Square Kilometre Array Observatory 观测能力评估
与 ALMA 高频观测结合
与 SPHEREx 等设施结合
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 SKAO 频率覆盖与 10–60 GHz AME 峰值区间的匹配方式，以及作者如何论证 SKA 与 ALMA/SPHEREx 联合后能区分载体、偏振和辐射机制。

papers.title: Distance-Ladder Measurements of the Hubble Constant: Recent Progress, Systematics, and Prospects
papers.abstract: The Hubble constant, \(H_0\), links the nearby distance scale to the present cosmic expansion rate. Local distance-ladder measurements now reach percent-level precision and remain more than \(5σ\) higher than the value inferred from cosmic microwave background (CMB) observations in base-\(Λ\)CDM, making the reliability of the local ladder a central issue in the Hubble tension. We describe the ladder as a covariance network connecting level-0 geometric anchors, level-1 stellar distance indicators, and level-2 Hubble-flow probes. The Cepheid--Type Ia supernova (SN Ia) route remains the most precise single local ladder, but independent indicators including the tip of the red giant branch (TRGB), J-region asymptotic giant branch (JAGB) stars, Mira variables, surface-brightness fluctuations (SBF), the Tully--Fisher relation, and Type II supernovae (SNe II) now test shared and method-specific systematics. In a compact seven-route covariance summary, combining the Cepheid--SN Ia route with three level-1 alternatives (TRGB, JAGB, and Mira) and three level-2 alternatives (SBF, Tully--Fisher, and SNe II) gives \(H_0=73.30\pm0.92~{\rm km~s^{-1}~Mpc^{-1}}\), still \(5.6σ\) above Planck base-\(Λ\)CDM. JWST has already tested Cepheid crowding and is making independent TRGB-based \(H_0\) measurements increasingly feasible. Over the next five years, a reliable one-percent local \(H_0\) requires larger calibrator samples, cross-validated level-1 zero points, explicit covariance propagation, and AI-assisted, reproducible, pre-specified selection criteria for distance-indicator measurements.
papers.comment: Review article; accepted for publication in Research in Astronomy and Astrophysics; 38 pages, 6 figures; comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 哈勃常数的距离阶梯测量：近期进展、系统误差与前景
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇文章讨论近邻距离阶梯测量哈勃常数的最新进展、主要系统误差和未来前景，并把距离阶梯表述为连接几何锚点、恒星距离指标和哈勃流探针的协方差网络。摘要报告称，Cepheid--SN Ia 与多条 level-1、level-2 替代路线的紧凑七路线合并给出 H0=73.30±0.92 km s^-1 Mpc^-1，仍高于 Planck 在 base-ΛCDM 下由 CMB 推断的数值。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 张力直接比较近邻宇宙距离尺度与 CMB 在 ΛCDM 模型下外推得到的早期宇宙约束，是当前 CMB 宇宙学解释框架的核心压力测试之一。该文若如摘要所述系统梳理本地距离阶梯的协方差和交叉检验，将有助于判断张力更可能来自本地系统误差、CMB/模型假设，还是需要新物理。
key_points: 综述近邻距离阶梯测量 H0 的进展、系统误差和未来需求。
摘要称多条独立路线合并后仍与 Planck base-ΛCDM 存在显著差异。
强调 JWST 检验 Cepheid 拥挤效应及 TRGB 路线的可行性。
methods: 距离阶梯协方差网络：level-0 几何锚点、level-1 恒星距离指标、level-2 哈勃流探针
TRGB、JAGB、Mira、SBF、Tully--Fisher、II 型超新星等独立距离指标
JWST 对 Cepheid crowding 和 TRGB-based H0 的检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对七条距离阶梯路线的协方差如何构造、共享系统误差如何传播，以及合并 H0 与 Planck base-ΛCDM 张力的统计口径是否一致。

papers.title: Cross-correlation of SPT-3G D1 CMB lensing and DES Y3 galaxy lensing
papers.abstract: Measurements of the weak lensing of galaxies and of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) provide direct probes of the cosmic matter density field, but the two observables are sensitive to different spatial scales, redshift ranges, and survey systematics. Their cross-correlation thus enables consistency checks of the theoretical model and of potential systematics in either dataset. We present measurements of the cross-correlation between CMB lensing and cosmic shear over $\sim$1,300 deg$^2$ of the sky using the SPT-3G D1 CMB lensing maps and the Dark Energy Survey Year 3 (DES Y3) shear catalogs. For the first time, we measure this cross-correlation at high significance ($\sim 14σ$) when using a polarization-only CMB lensing reconstruction that is expected to be robust against biases induced by extragalactic foregrounds. We test a variety of other CMB lensing estimators that include temperature information and exhibit different tradeoffs between foreground biases and noise, as well as a shear sample that consists of blue, star-forming galaxies and has been shown to be less impacted by galaxy intrinsic alignments. Assuming $Λ$CDM and marginalizing over uncertainties in intrinsic alignments, baryonic feedback, and various nuisance parameters, we obtain a constraint on the amplitude of matter clustering $S_8 \equiv σ_8 \sqrt{Ω_m / 0.3} = 0.833^{+0.047}_{-0.061}$, consistent with both the primary CMB results from Planck and shear-only results from DES Y3. By combining our measurement with Planck, we find mild constraints on the astrophysical processes that impact the cross-correlation. We obtain a constraint on the intrinsic alignment amplitude of the DES sample that is competitive with that from shear-only analyses, and we find a lower limit on the strength of baryonic feedback.

analysis.title_zh: SPT-3G D1 CMB 透镜与 DES Y3 星系透镜的互相关
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文测量 SPT-3G D1 CMB 透镜图与 DES Y3 星系剪切目录在约 1300 平方度天区上的互相关，用来检验物质分布、理论模型和两类数据的系统误差。摘要报告在 ΛCDM 并边缘化 intrinsic alignment、重子反馈和多种 nuisance 参数后得到 S8=0.833^{+0.047}_{-0.061}，与 Planck 主 CMB 和 DES Y3 shear-only 结果一致，并对 intrinsic alignment 与重子反馈给出约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜和星系弱透镜追踪不同红移和尺度上的大尺度结构，二者互相关是检验 ΛCDM 结构增长、CMB 透镜前景偏差、星系 intrinsic alignment 和重子反馈的重要交叉探针。对 CMB 读者而言，偏振-only 透镜重建的高显著性互相关尤其有价值，因为它降低了温度图中星系外前景导致偏差的担忧。
key_points: 测量 SPT-3G D1 CMB 透镜与 DES Y3 星系弱透镜的互相关。
摘要称首次用仅偏振 CMB 透镜重建高显著性测得该互相关。
在 ΛCDM 下得到的 S8 与 Planck 主 CMB 和 DES Y3 shear-only 结果一致。
methods: 约 1300 平方度天区的 CMB lensing 与 cosmic shear 互相关
包含温度信息的多种 CMB lensing estimators
蓝色恒星形成星系 shear sample
ΛCDM 参数推断，并边缘化 intrinsic alignments、baryonic feedback 和 nuisance parameters
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对偏振-only 透镜重建的前景鲁棒性检验、温度相关估计量之间的一致性、IA 和重子反馈先验如何影响 S8 与互相关振幅。

papers.title: Forward Searches for Heavy Neutrinos and $Z'$ Bosons at FCC-hh
papers.abstract: The discovery of neutrino masses strongly motivates extensions of the Standard Model containing heavy neutral leptons and additional gauge interactions. We investigate the prospects for probing these states at the proposed Forward Physics Facility (FPF) of the 100 TeV Future Circular Collider (FCC-hh) within a broad class of anomaly-free chiral $U(1)$ gauge extensions. These models predict a new neutral gauge boson, $Z'$, together with right-handed neutrinos responsible for generating light neutrino masses through the seesaw mechanism. We study long-lived particle signatures arising from both heavy neutrinos and the $Z'$ boson produced in the far-forward region. In particular, we analyze heavy neutrino production from meson decays, visible decays of long-lived $Z'$ bosons produced through meson decays and proton bremsstrahlung, long-lived $Z'$ bosons decaying into heavy-neutrino pairs, and prompt $Z'$ decays yielding long-lived heavy neutrinos. The expected event rates are evaluated for the proposed FPF detector configurations, taking into account realistic detector geometry, decay probabilities, and visible final states. We derive projected sensitivities to the heavy neutrino mass and active-sterile mixing as well as to the $Z'$ mass and gauge coupling for several representative $U(1)$ charge assignments. Our results demonstrate that the FPF at FCC-hh can substantially extend the discovery reach for light long-lived heavy neutrinos and light $Z'$ bosons beyond existing and proposed experiments, providing a powerful and complementary probe of neutrino-mass models and hidden gauge sectors. https://github.com/SouvikPhD/RHN-Detection-with-FASER-2-
papers.comment: 23 pages, 7 captioned figures, Comments are welcome

papers.title: Using SKAO to Understand the Clustering of Gravitational Wave Sources
papers.abstract: Coalescing Binary Black Holes (BBHs) trace the Large-Scale Structure (LSS) of the Universe, and their clustering properties can be extracted from Gravitational Wave (GW) data. Next-generation detectors, such as the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer, will enable statistical studies of GW sources thanks to the massive number of detected events. However, such events will still suffer from significant instrumental and theoretical uncertainties. Cross-correlating GW maps with other LSS surveys provides a promising strategy to mitigate these limitations. The SKA-Mid intensity mapping and radio continuum surveys offer ideal datasets for cross-correlation studies with GWs (SKAO$\times$ET2CE). Their wide sky coverage and deep redshift sensitivity will allow precise probing of the epochs and environments where stellar BBHs form most efficiently. In this chapter, we forecast the potential of cross-correlation angular power spectra to extract information on the distribution and clustering properties of GW events. First, we model the number density and bias of three independent tracers: GW sources, neutral hydrogen intensity maps, and radio galaxies. We estimate the constraining power of SKA-Mid$\times$ET2CE on the GW clustering bias, which carries information on the origin of GW progenitors, e.g., whether they formed through stellar evolution or are primordial black holes. Finally, we develop a semi-analytic model for GW events hosted by SKAO galaxies as a function of the time-delay distribution between the binary formation and merger, which is still largely uncertain to date. We forecast the signal-to-noise ratio of their cross-correlation with SKA-Mid, and demonstrate that SKA-Mid$\times$ET2CE will foster our understanding of the time-delay distribution.
papers.comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII), 2026 (arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no:AASKAII/Bosi01. Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII) outlines the transformative scientific advances that will be enabled by the SKA telescopes

analysis.title_zh: 利用 SKAO 理解引力波源的聚类

papers.title: Cosmological constraints from the DESI DR1 Bispectrum Full-Shape and DR2 BAO
papers.abstract: We present cosmological constraints from the combination of DESI DR1 full-shape measurements, including for the LRG bispectrum, and DESI DR2 BAO data. The joint analysis accounts for cross-covariance using mocks, while ShapeFit compression mitigates prior volume effects that hinder beyond-$Λ$CDM analyses. In $Λ$CDM, the bispectrum (P+B) shifts $σ_8$ up by $1.1σ$ and $S_8$ by $1.2σ$, reducing their uncertainties by $26\%$ and $28\%$, respectively. For $w_0w_a$CDM, DESI-only analyses with the bispectrum shift dark energy parameters toward $Λ$CDM, staying consistent with a cosmological constant within $1σ$. Adding CMB creates a preference for evolving dark energy: DESI+CMB (P+B) shows a $2.8σ$ deviation from $Λ$CDM. Including DES-Dovekie supernovae alone reduces this to $1.6σ$, while the full combination DESI+CMB+DES-Dovekie gives $3.1σ$, driven primarily by the CMB. The bispectrum consistently weakens evidence for time-varying dark energy relative to power-spectrum-only analyses. The bispectrum also enhances sensitivity to massive neutrinos: in DESI-only analysis, the power-spectrum-only posterior for $\sum m_ν$ is consistent with zero, whereas adding the bispectrum yields a mean of $0.26\pm0.17$~eV and a $95\%$ upper limit of $0.57$~eV, shifting the peak into the positive region and agreeing with oscillation lower bounds. For modified gravity, the bispectrum further constrains $μ_0 = 0.12\pm0.49$ from DESI-only data, consistent with general relativity. Our analysis shows that accounting for cross-dataset covariances and avoiding prior volume effects yields robust constraints, with the bispectrum raising amplitude parameters and tightening their uncertainties.

analysis.title_zh: 来自 DESI DR1 双谱全形状和 DR2 BAO 的宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文给出 DESI DR1 全形状测量、LRG 双谱和 DESI DR2 BAO 的联合宇宙学约束，并用 mocks 处理交叉协方差、用 ShapeFit 缓解先验体积效应。摘要报告双谱在 ΛCDM 中提高并收紧振幅参数约束，在含 CMB 的 w0waCDM 分析中仍出现演化暗能量偏好，但双谱相对仅功率谱分析会削弱时变暗能量证据，并增强对中微子质量和修正引力参数的敏感性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 宇宙学直接相关，因为它讨论 DESI 与 CMB 联合后对暗能量演化、结构增长振幅、总中微子质量和修正引力的约束；这些参数正是 CMB 基准模型外推到低红移时最敏感的检验方向，也关系到 S8、暗能量和中微子质量的多探针一致性。
key_points: 联合 DESI DR1 全形状信息、LRG 双谱和 DESI DR2 BAO，并用 mocks 处理交叉协方差。
在 ΛCDM 中，加入双谱提高 σ8 和 S8 并缩小误差；在 w0waCDM 中，双谱相对仅功率谱分析削弱时变暗能量证据。
摘要称 DESI+CMB 组合显示对演化暗能量的偏好，但加入超新星后的显著性取决于组合，且主要由 CMB 驱动。
methods: ΛCDM、w0waCDM、大质量中微子和修正引力参数约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 CMB 数据集的具体选择、与 DESI 的协方差处理、ShapeFit 压缩对非 ΛCDM 参数的充分性，以及“时变暗能量偏好主要由 CMB 驱动”这一判断在不同数据组合和先验下是否稳健。

papers.title: Primordial Black Holes: A Review of Formation and Evolution
papers.abstract: Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) have emerged as a leading non-particulate candidate for dark matter and a unique cosmological probe, a paradigm shift accelerated by the detection of anomalous binary mergers by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) collaboration. While the literature is rich with phenomenological constraints, the fundamental quantum and relativistic underpinnings governing PBH genesis and evolution often receive comparatively less emphasis. This review aims to bridge that gap by systematically detailing the physics of PBH formation and their subsequent evolutionary trajectory. We critically examine the hydrodynamic complexity of the early universe, establishing the relativistic thresholds for collapse, the non-linear \emph{race against sound} in the primordial plasma, and the rigorous mathematical utility of the compaction function. Furthermore, by incorporating the dynamic nature of FLRW backgrounds, higher curvature corrections, and quantum backreaction via the memory burden effect, we challenge the standard hawking evaporation and show that extreme-curvature environments halt evaporation entirely, leaving Planck-scale relics that evade current extragalactic bounds. Finally, we map the multimessenger observational landscape, highlighting how the imminent search for sub-solar mass inspirals by next-generation gravitational wave observatories such as the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer could yield smoking-gun evidence for the PBH paradigm, ultimately transforming these primordial relics into unparalleled laboratories for high-energy physics.
papers.comment: Invited Review for Special Issue to Commemorate 100 Years of Indian Journal of Physics (accepted for publication), 41 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables

analysis.title_zh: 原初黑洞：形成与演化综述
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于原初黑洞形成与演化的综述，聚焦早期宇宙塌缩的相对论条件、非线性流体过程、compaction function 以及蒸发阶段的高曲率和量子反作用效应。摘要称作者挑战标准霍金蒸发图像，提出极端曲率环境可使蒸发停止并留下 Planck 尺度遗迹，同时梳理下一代引力波观测对亚太阳质量 PBH 并合的检验前景。

讨论 FLRW 背景、高曲率修正和 memory burden 量子反作用对霍金蒸发图像的影响。
摘要强调亚太阳质量并合的下一代引力波搜寻可为 PBH 图景提供关键证据。

FLRW 动态背景、高曲率修正和 memory burden effect
LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 异常双星并合背景与 ET、Cosmic Explorer 前景

papers.title: A cross-calibration approach for polarisation-sensitive detectors in CMB experiments: application to LiteBIRD's polarisation angle calibration
papers.abstract: One of the current challenges in observational cosmology is obtaining high-precision polarisation maps of the CMB to measure primordial $B$-modes and constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r$). The weakness of this signal compared to foregrounds and $E$-to-$B$ leakage makes this task particularly challenging, requiring large detector arrays operating at multiple frequencies and extremely precise calibration. We present a cross-calibration algorithm to determine relative calibration of detectors within the same frequency band of a CMB experiment. The method iteratively compares single-detector maps with band-averaged maps and can be applied to any calibration parameter that can be observed and corrected at the map level, relaxing pre-flight calibration requirements and enabling post-processing validation. We validate the pipeline by calibrating the polarisation angle of simulated LiteBIRD observations, including both random detector miscalibration and wafer-level rotations. The algorithm converges to correct values with arcminute precision. Finally, we propagate residual calibration uncertainties through component separation and tensor-to-scalar ratio estimation pipelines using both parametric (FgBuster) and blind (HILC) methods. The induced bias on $r$ remains well below the LiteBIRD systematics budget of $δr < 6.5\times10^{-6}$, demonstrating that the method is suitable for next-generation CMB experiments.

analysis.title_zh: CMB 实验中偏振敏感探测器的交叉定标方法：应用于 LiteBIRD 的偏振角定标
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 CMB 原初 B 模测量对偏振定标精度的要求，提出一种在同一频段内通过单探测器图与频段平均图迭代比较来求相对定标的交叉定标算法。摘要报告该方法在模拟 LiteBIRD 观测的偏振角定标中可收敛到角分精度，并且残余不确定性经 FgBuster/HILC 成分分离和 r 估计后造成的偏差低于 LiteBIRD 的系统误差预算。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 偏振角误定标会把 E 模泄漏到 B 模，直接影响原初引力波和张量标量比 r 的推断；这篇工作面向 LiteBIRD 这类下一代 CMB 偏振实验，关注的是从探测器级系统误差到成分分离和宇宙学参数估计的传播。
key_points: 提出同一频段内探测器相对定标的交叉定标算法。
用模拟 LiteBIRD 观测检验偏振角定标，包括随机探测器失准和晶圆级旋转。
摘要称残余定标误差经前景分离和 r 估计后引入的偏差低于 LiteBIRD 系统误差预算。
methods: 单探测器图与频段平均图的迭代比较
张量标量比 r 估计管线
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对交叉定标算法对天空信号、噪声、扫描策略和前景残差的假设，尤其是“arcminute precision”和 r 偏差预算在不同失准模式下是否稳健。

papers.title: Phantom-Divide Crossing in Exponentially Coupled Quintessence and the Role of Neutrino-Mass Freedom
papers.abstract: We investigate a quintessence dark-energy model with an exponential potential and an exponential coupling to cold dark matter (CDM), hereafter referred to as the CQ-EXP model, using Planck CMB, DESI BAO, and DES-Dovekie supernova observations. We also examine how variations in the neutrino mass sector affect the constraints. When the neutrino mass sum is fixed at $\sum m_ν=0.06$ eV, the data favor a coupling between quintessence and CDM, with the coupling parameter $β$ deviating from zero at more than $3σ$. In particular, the observations favor the $β<0$ branch, where the energy transfer between the two dark sectors changes sign and the effective equation of state (EoS) of dark energy crosses the phantom divide, $w=-1$. When the effective neutrino mass parameter $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}$ is treated as a free parameter, the data show a preference for negative values of $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}$. This additional freedom weakens the preference for the coupling between quintessence and CDM and leads to nearly identical values of $χ^2_{\rm min}$ for the CQ-EXP models with $β>0$ and $β<0$, corresponding respectively to models without and with phantom-divide crossing in the effective EoS. Both values are slightly larger than that obtained in the $w_0w_a$CDM model, indicating that the CQ-EXP model cannot be statistically distinguished from the $w_0w_a$CDM model with the data considered here. Therefore, when $\sum m_ν$ is fixed, current observations favor the CQ-EXP model with phantom-divide crossing. In contrast, when negative values of $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}$ are allowed, a CQ-EXP dark energy without crossing $w=-1$ can also provide an effective explanation of the latest observations.

analysis.title_zh: 指数耦合 Quintessence 中的幻影分界跨越及中微子质量自由度的作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck CMB、DESI BAO 和 DES-Dovekie 超新星数据约束一种带指数势并与冷暗物质指数耦合的 quintessence 暗能量模型，同时考察中微子质量自由度的影响。摘要称固定 ∑mν=0.06 eV 时数据偏好 β<0 且有效暗能量状态方程跨越 w=-1；若允许有效中微子质量参数自由并取负值，则耦合偏好减弱，β>0 与 β<0 分支的 χ²_min 近乎相同，且该模型不能与 w0waCDM 统计区分。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Planck CMB 与 BAO、超新星联合约束是检验晚期宇宙膨胀和暗能量模型的核心手段；该文讨论的暗能量-CDM 相互作用与中微子质量自由度会影响 CMB 推断的背景参数退化关系，并关系到 DESI 时代对 ΛCDM 偏离信号的解释。
key_points: 研究指数势和指数 CDM 耦合的 quintessence 暗能量模型。
固定中微子质量和允许有效中微子质量自由时，对暗能量-CDM 耦合的偏好不同。
摘要称该模型与 w0waCDM 在所用数据下不能被统计区分。
methods: 固定 ∑mν=0.06 eV 的参数约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对负的 ∑mν,eff 的物理定义和先验处理，以及耦合参数 β 的显著性是否受数据组合、参数先验和模型分支选择驱动。

papers.title: Dark Energy in the DESI Era: A Brief Review of Evidence, Beyond-$Λ$CDM Interpretations, and Tensions
papers.abstract: Recent baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from DESI provide important new clues for reassessing whether the standard $Λ$CDM model offers a sufficient description of the late-time expansion history of the Universe. When combined with cosmic microwave background and type Ia supernova data, these measurements show an apparent departure from the $Λ$CDM model, commonly described as dynamical dark energy (DDE) with equation of state crossing the phantom divide (i.e., quintom behavior). This review examines the current status of the DESI-motivated indications for DDE and their possible implications for physics beyond $Λ$CDM. We discuss how the strength of the preference for DDE depends on the adopted parametrization and dataset combination, and how residual systematics or internal tensions among datasets may affect its interpretation. At the background level, several mechanisms beyond $Λ$CDM can produce similar expansion histories. We therefore further discuss how the same effective departure from $w=-1$ may arise from physically distinct scenarios, including interacting dark energy, non-minimally coupled gravity, and non-standard dark matter. Meanwhile, these different new-physics interpretations may have different implications for current cosmological tensions, especially those involving $H_0$, $S_8$, and $\sum m_ν$. In conclusion, the question posed by DESI is not merely whether dark energy evolves with time, but rather how, within the framework of precision cosmology, to disentangle new physics scenarios from systematic errors.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 12 figures; Invited Review for RAA (Research in Astronomy and Astrophysics), prepared for the Special Forum: "Dark Energy and the Hubble Constant Crisis" at the 28th Annual Conference of the China Association for Science and Technology

analysis.title_zh: DESI 时代的暗能量：证据、ΛCDM 之外的解释与张力简评
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇围绕 DESI 时代暗能量问题的简短综述，讨论 DESI BAO 与 CMB、Ia 型超新星结合后对 ΛCDM 偏离和跨越 w=-1 的动力学暗能量迹象。摘要强调这种偏好的强度依赖参数化和数据组合，并比较相互作用暗能量、非最小耦合引力、非标准暗物质等不同物理解释及其与 H0、S8、∑mν 张力的关系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 给出早期宇宙锚点，而 DESI BAO 和超新星约束晚期膨胀；该综述聚焦这些数据联合时出现的 ΛCDM 偏离迹象，对 CMB 研究者理解参数退化、数据张力和新物理解释很有参考价值。
key_points: 综述 DESI BAO 与 CMB、Ia 型超新星联合后对动力学暗能量的提示。
强调 DDE 偏好的强弱依赖参数化、数据组合、系统误差和数据内部张力。
比较相互作用暗能量、非最小耦合引力和非标准暗物质等可能解释。
methods: DESI 重子声波振荡测量
对 ΛCDM 之外解释的综述比较
对 H0、S8、∑mν 张力的讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对综述如何区分数据驱动的 DDE 偏好与参数化选择、数据组合和潜在系统误差造成的表观偏离。

papers.title: Raising the reionization optical depth with inflationary CMB features
papers.abstract: Within the highly successful $Λ$CDM paradigm established with cosmic microwave background (CMB) anisotropy measurements, the optical depth through reionization $τ$ is the most uncertain due both to the difficulty in measuring large-angle polarization and the assumptions made in their interpretation. Currently, for the Planck primary data in the flat $Λ$CDM cosmology with slow-roll inflation and standard reionization, the one-sided 95% upper limit for $τ$ is $τ_{\rm max}=0.0696$. Yet when all current CMB measurements excluding large-angle polarization are combined with baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements, the one-sided 95% lower limit is an incompatible $τ_{\rm min}=0.074$. If the long-standing low-power feature of the temperature measurements is interpreted as physically originating from inflation then $τ$ inferred from large-angle polarization becomes larger. Marginalizing over templates of the low-power feature based on the generalized slow-roll formalism of inflation raises the Planck maximum to a more compatible $τ_{\rm max}=0.075$ which further increases to $τ_{\rm max} = 0.082$ with the inclusion of all CMB+BAO data. This marginalization does not assess the statistical significance of the low-power feature itself; rather, it shows that allowing a higher $τ$ is a consequence of interpreting the anomaly as a physical feature instead of a statistical fluctuation.

analysis.title_zh: 用暴胀产生的 CMB 特征提高再电离光学深度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究平坦 ΛCDM、慢滚暴胀和标准再电离假设下，再电离光学深度 τ 在 Planck 大角度偏振与 CMB+BAO 组合约束之间的张力。摘要称，若把 CMB 温度低功率特征解释为源自暴胀的物理特征，并用广义慢滚形式的模板边缘化，Planck 对 τ 的上限会提高，并与 CMB+BAO 所偏好的较高 τ 更相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: τ 直接影响 CMB 初级各向异性振幅退化、再电离历史和低红移结构幅度推断，是 CMB 参数约束中最敏感的系统环节之一。该工作提醒读者，初始功率谱特征与大尺度偏振的解释会影响 τ，从而影响 CMB 与 BAO 等数据组合的宇宙学参数一致性。
key_points: 讨论再电离光学深度 τ 在不同 CMB/BAO 数据组合中的不一致。
将温度低功率反常解释为暴胀物理特征会提高大角度偏振推断的 τ 上限。
作者强调该边缘化并不评估低功率特征本身的统计显著性。
methods: 当前 CMB 测量但排除大角度偏振
基于广义慢滚暴胀形式的低功率特征模板边缘化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对低功率特征模板的先验、参数化与边缘化方式如何改变 τ 的后验，以及这些设置是否只是在放宽再电离历史/初始功率谱假设而非真正解决数据张力。

papers.title: Fireworks at Cosmic Dawn: relieving BAO-CMB tensions with the Pop III.1 Flash
