papers.abstract: A Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) optical depth of $τ\sim 0.09$, several $σ$ in excess of the latest Planck low-$\ell$ EE polarization measurement, has been proposed as a way to reconcile the preference for a sub-minimal neutrino mass sum in a combined analysis with CMB and Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) three-year data. Reionization, however, is not just probed by $τ$. It is also constrained by Ly$α$ forest observations that indicate a late end of reionization, and the patchy kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (pkSZ) effect which prefers a short duration. We explore whether an early phase of reionization can achieve a high $τ$ while remaining consistent with both Ly$α$ forest and pkSZ constraints. As a concrete example, we consider supermassive Pop III.1 stars, dark-matter-powered metal-free stars proposed as progenitors of supermassive black holes. Within this framework, self-regulating ionizing feedback imposes a minimum source separation of $\sim 1 \, \text{cMpc}$, consequently limiting large-scale ionization fluctuations and reducing the pkSZ power on observationally relevant scales. Our fiducial model realizes an optical depth of $τ= 0.087$ with a Pop III.1-driven flash ionization phase centered at $z = 20$, while evading the most conservative $2σ$ upper limits on the pkSZ signal from the most recent South Pole Telescope data release. More broadly, our findings motivate further exploration of early reionization models with weakly clustered sources as a possible resolution of tensions between BAO and CMB measurements.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to ApJL, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙黎明的烟火：用 Pop III.1 闪耀缓解 BAO-CMB 张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察用早期再电离阶段获得较高 CMB 光学深度 τ 的可能性，以缓解 CMB 与 DESI BAO 组合分析中与中微子质量相关的张力。摘要报告的具体例子是由超大质量 Pop III.1 恒星驱动、中心在 z=20 的快速电离阶段，可实现 τ=0.087，并在其模型设定下避开保守的 SPT pkSZ 上限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离光学深度 τ 是 CMB 低多极偏振和宇宙学参数推断的关键量，而非均匀再电离还会通过 pkSZ 产生次级各向异性。该论文把高 τ 方案同时放在 Lyα 森林和 pkSZ 约束下检验，对评估 CMB-BAO 张力是否可由早期天体物理过程缓解有直接关联。
key_points: 探讨高 τ 是否可由早期再电离阶段实现，同时不违反 Lyα 森林和 pkSZ 约束。
具体模型采用超大质量 Pop III.1 恒星作为早期电离源。
弱成团或自调节反馈导致的大源间距可降低观测相关尺度上的 pkSZ 功率。
methods: DESI 三年数据背景下的 CMB+BAO 张力设定
patchy kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect 约束
South Pole Telescope 最新数据发布的 pkSZ 上限
超大质量 Pop III.1 恒星再电离模型
自调节电离反馈与源间距建模
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 Pop III.1 源的丰度、寿命、反馈和成团性假设，以及 pkSZ 计算如何与 SPT 上限和 Lyα 森林的晚期再电离约束同时比较。

papers.title: Constraints on Cosmic Strings from the Curl-Mode CMB Lensing Power Spectrum measured by ACT DR6
papers.abstract: A network of cosmic strings is one of the few well-motivated cosmological sources of vector and tensor metric perturbations on the largest observable scales. Such perturbations imprint a characteristic curl component in the deflection angle of cosmic microwave background (CMB) photons that, unlike the scalar lensing potential, vanishes for adiabatic density fluctuations at linear order. We exploit the curl-mode lensing reconstruction released as part of the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) Data Release~6 (DR6), based on five seasons of temperature and polarization data covering $9400~\mathrm{deg}^2$ of sky, to set new constraints on the dimensionless string tension $Gμ$ and the inter-commutation (reconnection) probability $P$. Modelling the string-induced curl power spectrum within the velocity-dependent one-scale framework, we obtain a $2σ$ upper bound on the combination $GμP^{-1}\le 3.5\times 10^{-5}$ in the small-$P$ regime, and $Gμ\le 5.0\times 10^{-5}$ at $2σ$ assuming the canonical Nambu-Goto value $P=1$. Combining the ACT DR6 curl bandpowers with the Planck 2013 curl-mode reconstruction, which extends down to $L_{\rm min}=2$, tightens these bounds to $GμP^{-1}\le 3.2\times 10^{-5}$ and $Gμ\le 4.3\times 10^{-5}$ ($2σ$). These represent the tightest constraints on cosmic strings derived from the curl-mode CMB lensing power spectrum to date. Using the ACT data alone, compared to the ACT 2008-season analysis, the ACT DR6 constraint on $GμP^{-1}$ is nearly an order of magnitude tighter.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 ACT DR6 测得的 curl-mode CMB 透镜功率谱约束宇宙弦
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 ACT DR6 的 CMB curl-mode 透镜重建来约束宇宙弦网络产生的矢量和张量扰动。摘要称，在速度依赖 one-scale 模型下，ACT DR6 单独以及与 Planck 2013 curl 重建联合均给出对弦张力 Gμ 和重连概率 P 的新上限，并较早期 ACT 分析显著收紧。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜的 curl 模式不同于常规标量密度扰动产生的梯度型透镜势，可用于寻找宇宙弦等早期宇宙缺陷的非标量扰动信号。该结果扩展了 CMB 透镜从标准结构形成测量到新物理约束的用途，并为未来 CMB 透镜系统误差控制提供参照。
key_points: 利用 ACT DR6 发布的 curl-mode CMB 透镜重建约束宇宙弦。
curl 分量在线性标量绝热扰动中消失，因此可作为矢量/张量源的探针。
摘要称得到目前来自 curl-mode CMB 透镜功率谱的最严格宇宙弦约束。
methods: ACT 五季温度和偏振数据
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 curl-mode 重建的噪声偏差、系统误差和协方差处理，以及 velocity-dependent one-scale 宇宙弦模型到 curl 功率谱的映射是否主导最终的 Gμ 与 P 约束。

papers.title: Resolving the Hubble Tension in the Early Dark Energy Framework with JWST and DESI Data
papers.abstract: In the JWST and DESI era, the JWST high-redshift galaxy observations and DESI baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements severely challenge the standard $Λ$CDM model, while the $H_0$ tension becomes increasingly prominent. In this work, we investigate the capability of the early dark energy (EDE) model to alleviate the $H_0$ tension utilizing cosmic microwave background data from Planck, ACT, and SPT, BAO data from DESI, and ultraviolet luminosity function observations from the JWST. Within the canonical axion EDE framework, the CMB+DESI+JWST data significantly increase the $H_0$ value to $71.58\pm1.05\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, alleviating the $H_0$ tension to the $1.0σ$ level. Simultaneously, this model improves the fit to the JWST data and exhibits statistical performance significantly better than the $Λ$CDM model, with $Δχ^2_{\mathrm{tot}} = -18.26$ and $Δ\mathrm{DIC} = -11.89$. Our results highlight the complementary advantages of JWST high-redshift galaxy data alongside early- and late-time observations in testing EDE and alleviating the $H_0$ tension.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 JWST 和 DESI 数据在早期暗能量框架中解决哈勃张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验早期暗能量模型是否能在 JWST 高红移星系观测、DESI BAO 与 Planck/ACT/SPT CMB 数据的联合约束下缓解 H0 张力。摘要称，在经典轴子 EDE 框架中，联合数据将 H0 推高至 71.58±1.05 km s^-1 Mpc^-1、把张力降至 1.0σ，并相对 ΛCDM 改善了 JWST 拟合与整体统计指标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接围绕 CMB 推断的早期宇宙参数与本地/晚期 H0 测量之间的冲突展开，并使用 Planck、ACT、SPT 等 CMB 数据检验 EDE。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于加入 JWST 高红移星系与 DESI BAO 后，是否真的改变了 CMB 对声学尺度、物质密度和早期能量注入的约束结构。
key_points: 在轴子型早期暗能量框架下联合 Planck、ACT、SPT、DESI 与 JWST 数据。
摘要报告该组合将 H0 提高到 71.58±1.05 km s^-1 Mpc^-1，并把 H0 张力缓解到 1.0σ。
模型同时改善对 JWST 紫外光度函数数据的拟合，并相对 ΛCDM 给出更优统计表现。
methods: JWST 高红移星系紫外光度函数观测
经典轴子早期暗能量模型
与 ΛCDM 的 χ² 和 DIC 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 JWST 紫外光度函数如何进入似然、星系形成/恒星形成效率等天体物理假设是否驱动 EDE 偏好，以及 CMB+DESI 与加入 JWST 后各自对 H0、EDE 参数和拟合优度的贡献。

papers.title: From Evidence to Evident: Decisive Cosmological Evidence for the Normal Neutrino Mass Hierarchy
papers.abstract: Cosmological data have reached the precision needed to turn the neutrino mass ordering from a weak Bayesian preference into a decisive model-selection test. We compute the evidence for the Normal and Inverted Hierarchies by combining DESI DR2 clustering with NuFIT oscillation data. In baseline $Λ$CDM, DESI DR2 plus Planck CamSpec gives $Σm_ν<0.0642\,{\rm eV}$ at 95\% confidence, close to the normal-ordering floor, $Σm_ν^{\rm NH}\simeq0.059\,{\rm eV}$, but well below the inverted-ordering minimum, $Σm_ν^{\rm IH}\simeq0.099\,{\rm eV}$. Thus the inverted hierarchy lies in the tail of the cosmological likelihood. The Bayes factor $K=P(D|{\rm NH})/P(D|{\rm IH})$ exceeds $460$ even for a conservative reference prior, and remains strong, $K>40$, in baseline-model extensions. We show that this result is robust to the choice between a reference prior and a physically motivated logarithmic hierarchical prior, marking the transition from {\em prior-sensitive evidence} to {\em likelihood-dominated exclusion} of the inverted hierarchy within standard cosmology. Embedding these priors in the two-dimensional design space of measure (logarithmic versus linear in mass) and structure (hierarchical versus non-hierarchical), we find that all four prior constructions give decisive evidence under DESI DR2, with residual prior dependence governed mainly by the measure -- a factor $\sim\!10$ in $K$ -- rather than by the hierarchy assumption. At the prior-family level, the evidence favors the SJPV prior predictive over HS by a Bayes factor above $4,700$ across each matched-support variation tested. The favored normal ordering pushes the effective Majorana mass to the few-meV regime, with median $m_{ββ}=3.28\,{\rm meV}$ and 95\% credible interval $0.95<m_{ββ}<11.55\,{\rm meV}$, below the inverted-ordering target for upcoming neutrinoless double-beta decay experiments.

analysis.title_zh: 从证据到显然：支持正中微子质量层级的决定性宇宙学证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 DESI DR2 星系聚类、Planck CamSpec 与 NuFIT 振荡数据比较正、反中微子质量层级的贝叶斯证据。摘要报告，在基线 ΛCDM 中宇宙学质量和上限已接近正序下限且低于反序最小值，使反序落在似然尾部，并给出支持正序的强贝叶斯因子。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 中微子质量和会影响 CMB 透镜、物质功率谱与晚期结构增长，因此其层级判断与 CMB+大尺度结构联合宇宙学密切相关。该摘要的核心意义在于，DESI 与 Planck 的组合可能把中微子质量排序从先验敏感的模型比较推进到更由似然驱动的宇宙学约束。
key_points: 联合 DESI DR2 星系聚类与 NuFIT 振荡数据计算正、反中微子质量层级的证据。
摘要称 DESI DR2 加 Planck CamSpec 在 ΛCDM 中给出 Σmν<0.0642 eV 的 95% 上限，接近正序下限且低于反序最小值。
作者报告正序相对反序的贝叶斯因子在保守先验下仍超过 460，并在若干模型扩展中保持强证据。
methods: ΛCDM 基线模型及模型扩展
贝叶斯证据与 Bayes factor
参考先验、对数分层先验及四类先验构造比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对贝叶斯因子对宇宙学数据组合、Σmν 先验边界、质量参数化方式以及 ΛCDM 扩展的敏感性，尤其是“似然主导排除反序”的判据是否充分。

papers.title: Emergent Gauge Symmetries in Particle Physics and Cosmology
papers.abstract: Where do gauge symmetries come from? These lectures develop the idea that the Standard Model might be emergent, with its gauge symmetries dissolving in some phase transition deep in the ultraviolet. The (meta-)stability of the Higgs vacuum may be pointing to some new critical phenomena at very high energy scales, with the Higgs connecting physics at LHC laboratory energies to that in the deep ultraviolet. In the emergence scenario, the dark energy scale comes out similar to the size of light Majorana neutrino masses. These two quantities appear at the same order in a low energy expansion in inverse powers of the scale of emergence, about $10^{16}$ GeV. Dark matter candidates include axions and phonon like excitations of degrees of freedom above the scale of emergence. Possible tests of these ideas involve neutrinos as well as gravitational-waves-related signals from the early Universe, which are sensitive to physics at very high energy scales.
papers.comment: Lectures presented at the 65. Jubilee Cracow School of Theoretical Physics, Zakopane, June 14-21 2025. 40 pages, to appear in Acta Physica Polonica B

analysis.title_zh: 粒子物理与宇宙学中的涌现规范对称性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文以讲义形式讨论标准模型及其规范对称性可能是紫外深处相变后的涌现现象，并把 Higgs 真空亚稳性、暗能量尺度、Majorana 中微子质量和暗物质候选体联系起来。摘要称，这一框架可通过中微子和早期宇宙引力波相关信号进行检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章与 CMB 的关系较间接，主要在于其早期宇宙高能相变可能留下随机引力波背景或影响暗物质/暗能量理论图景。对 CMB 宇宙学读者而言，它更像是高能理论背景材料，而不是直接的数据分析或 CMB 观测约束论文。
key_points: 这是一组关于规范对称性涌现思想的讲义式论文。
作者讨论标准模型规范对称性可能在极高能相变中涌现，并与 Higgs 真空亚稳性相关。
摘要提出暗能量尺度、轻 Majorana 中微子质量、轴子/声子样暗物质候选体及早期宇宙引力波信号之间的可能联系。
methods: 理论讲义/概念框架构建
低能展开中按涌现尺度反幂次分析
中微子、早期宇宙引力波相关可检验信号讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该涌现尺度约 10^16 GeV 的低能展开如何定量给出暗能量尺度与轻 Majorana 中微子质量同阶，以及这些早期宇宙引力波或中微子检验是否具有可计算的观测预言。

papers.title: CMBComp: A Simple and Accurate Compressed CMB Likelihood for Dark Energy, Curvature, and Massive Neutrinos
papers.abstract: We present CMBComp, a compact and accurate compressed cosmic microwave background (CMB) likelihood that captures the dominant geometric information of the full CMB likelihood derived from the combined SPT-3G D1 + ACT DR6 + Planck PR3 primary CMB anisotropy + Planck PR4/NPIPE CMB-lensing dataset, which we collectively refer to as SPA. The compression is fast to evaluate and trivial to implement in standard inference pipelines. We construct and validate it in five model spaces: the spatially flat cosmological-constant model ($Λ$CDM), and its dynamical-dark-energy ($w_0w_a$CDM), massive-neutrino ($νΛ$CDM), non-flat ($oΛ$CDM), and joint massive-neutrino--dynamical-dark-energy ($νw_0 w_a$CDM) extensions. Five compressed likelihoods are introduced, corresponding to two three-parameter compressions for the dark-energy sector (CMB-3 for $Λ$CDM and CMB-3w for $w_0w_a$CDM), two four-parameter compressions for the neutrino sector (CMB-4$ν$ for $νΛ$CDM and CMB-4$ν$w for $νw_0 w_a$CDM), and a four-parameter curvature compression (CMB-4k for $oΛ$CDM). Combining each compressed likelihood with the DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) data, we demonstrate that the resulting posteriors agree to high precision with those obtained from the corresponding full-CMB chains. CMBComp is therefore particularly well suited to cosmological inference for models that modify the late-time expansion history, enabling accurate CMB constraints to be incorporated into new analyses with minimal computational overhead and without reliance on a full Boltzmann-solver-based inference pipeline. The compressed likelihood files and example notebooks accompanying CMBComp are made publicly available at https://github.com/Amoghsriv/CMBComp.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Comments are welcome. Github URL: https://github.com/Amoghsriv/CMBComp

analysis.title_zh: CMBComp：用于暗能量、曲率和有质量中微子的简单而准确的压缩 CMB 似然
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 CMBComp，一套用于暗能量、曲率和有质量中微子相关模型的压缩 CMB 似然，旨在保留来自 SPA 组合 CMB 数据的主导几何信息并便于快速推断。摘要称其在五类模型空间中构建和验证，并与 DESI DR2 BAO 联合后能高精度复现相应全 CMB 链的后验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 约束常是晚期宇宙学参数推断的基准，但完整 CMB likelihood 和 Boltzmann 求解器链条计算成本高。若该压缩似然的适用范围如摘要所称可靠，它可让研究者在 DESI BAO、超新星等低红移数据分析中更方便地纳入 CMB 几何信息，尤其适合检验暗能量、曲率和中微子质量对距离尺度的影响。
key_points: 提出面向晚期膨胀史扩展模型的压缩 CMB 似然 CMBComp。
压缩对象来自 SPT-3G D1、ACT DR6、Planck PR3 主 CMB 各向异性与 Planck PR4/NPIPE CMB 透镜组合数据。
与 DESI DR2 BAO 结合后，摘要称后验与相应全 CMB 链高精度一致。
methods: SPT-3G D1 + ACT DR6 + Planck PR3 primary CMB anisotropy + Planck PR4/NPIPE CMB-lensing 数据组合
在 ΛCDM、w0waCDM、νΛCDM、oΛCDM、νw0waCDM 五类模型空间中构建和验证
与 DESI DR2 BAO 数据联合比较压缩似然和 full-CMB chains 的后验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对压缩参数的定义、协方差/非高斯处理、适用模型边界，以及它在非标准早期宇宙或改变声学尺度物理的模型中是否仍可安全使用。

papers.title: Consistency of DES and DESI distances and the Standard Cosmological Model
papers.abstract: We test the consistency of the cosmic distance-redshift relation inferred from the cosmic microwave background (CMB), the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) baryon acoustic oscillation measurements, and the Dark Energy Survey (DES) Type Ia supernovae within the framework of flat $Λ$CDM. DESI recovers the CMB-constrained parameter combination $(r_d h)(Ω_m/0.3)^{0.4}$ with sub-percent precision, demonstrating excellent agreement between BAO measurements at $z \sim 1$ and the acoustic scale at recombination. Imposing the CMB constraint yields an estimate of $Ω_m$ that is slightly lower than, but only in mild tension with, the Planck value. The high-redshift DES supernova sample is well described by the standard cosmological model, whereas the current low-redshift anchor sample exhibits a systematic offset of $\sim 0.05$ mag that drives much of the apparent preference for evolving dark energy. Preliminary data from the Dark Energy Bedrock All-Sky Supernova Program (DEBASS) do not show this offset, suggesting that unresolved low-redshift systematics may account for the discrepancy. These results suggest that a single flat $Λ$CDM model accurately describes the distance-redshift relation from the local Universe to recombination, placing increasingly stringent constraints on new-physics explanations of the Hubble tension.

analysis.title_zh: DES 与 DESI 距离测量以及标准宇宙学模型的一致性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在平直 ΛCDM 框架下比较 CMB、DESI BAO 和 DES Ia 型超新星推断的宇宙距离-红移关系。摘要报告 DESI 与复合声学尺度约束高度一致，高红移 DES 超新星符合标准模型，而当前低红移锚点样本存在约 0.05 mag 系统偏移，可能解释一部分演化暗能量偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 给出的重组时期声学尺度与低红移 BAO、超新星距离梯共同构成 Hubble tension 和暗能量检验的核心链条。该工作若成立，将把部分偏离 ΛCDM 的信号指向低红移超新星系统误差，从而影响用 CMB 外推到今天宇宙膨胀率时对新物理的解释。
key_points: 检验 CMB、DESI BAO 与 DES Ia 型超新星给出的距离-红移关系是否符合平直 ΛCDM。
摘要称 DESI 以亚百分比精度恢复 CMB 约束的特定参数组合。
低红移超新星锚点样本的系统偏移被认为驱动了相当部分演化暗能量偏好。
methods: flat ΛCDM 框架下的一致性检验
Dark Energy Bedrock All-Sky Supernova Program preliminary data
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对低红移超新星锚点的样本定义、校准和系统误差模型，以及所谓约 0.05 mag 偏移如何传播到演化暗能量和 Hubble tension 相关结论。

papers.title: Constraints on the Sum of Neutrino Masses from ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 Considering Isocurvature Initial Conditions
papers.abstract: We present a robust assessment of cosmological constraints on the sum of neutrino masses ($\sum m_ν$) when relaxing the standard assumption of purely adiabatic primordial initial conditions. Allowing for a neutrino density isocurvature (NDI) component alongside the adiabatic mode, we analyse the latest CMB-SPA combination (Planck 2018, ACT DR6, and SPT-3G), DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation data, and the DES Year 5 supernova sample. Within the $Λ$CDM model, the 95\% upper limit weakens only marginally from $\sum m_ν< 0.052$ eV (purely adiabatic) to $< 0.057$ eV (including NDI), with the NDI amplitude consistent with zero. In the CPL dynamical dark energy model, the adiabatic limit is $< 0.111$ eV, shifting to $< 0.115$ eV with NDI, yet the isocurvature mode remains undetected. While these limits are robust against the inclusion of isocurvature perturbations, they are highly sensitive to both the assumed dark energy equation of state and the prior lower bound on $\sum m_ν$. Notably, the adiabatic $Λ$CDM limit of $0.052$ eV lies below the minimum sum required by the normal neutrino mass hierarchy ($0.05878$ eV), indicating that this bound is an artifact of the statistical prior extending to zero. Imposing a physically motivated hierarchy-informed prior raises the limit to $< 0.092$ eV. Our results demonstrate that current data show no evidence for NDI modes and that the inferred neutrino mass upper limit is robust against this extension, but a definitive, model-independent bound requires addressing prior dependencies and dark energy uncertainties. This work provides the first joint constraint on $\sum m_ν$ and NDI using the full CMB-SPA+DESI DR2+DES dataset.

analysis.title_zh: 在考虑等曲率初始条件下利用 ACT DR6 和 DESI DR2 约束中微子质量总和
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在放松纯绝热初始条件假设后，联合 CMB-SPA、DESI DR2 BAO 和 DES Year 5 超新星数据约束中微子质量总和与中微子密度等曲率初始模。摘要称当前数据未发现 NDI 模，加入 NDI 仅轻微放宽 Σmν 上限，但结果对暗能量模型和 Σmν 的先验下界非常敏感。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对初始条件和中微子质量都高度敏感，而 BAO 和超新星帮助打破几何退化。该论文直接关系到 CMB 推断中常用“纯绝热初始扰动”假设的稳健性，以及近期结合 ACT、SPT、Planck 与 DESI 得到的强中微子质量上限是否可被视为模型独立结论。
key_points: 研究在允许中微子密度等曲率初始条件时，中微子质量和 NDI 的联合约束。
摘要称 NDI 振幅与零一致，加入 NDI 只轻微放宽中微子质量上限。
强调中微子质量上限对暗能量模型和 Σmν 先验下界高度敏感。
methods: 允许 neutrino density isocurvature (NDI) 与绝热模共同存在的参数分析
ΛCDM 与 CPL dynamical dark energy model
hierarchy-informed prior 对 Σmν 的检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 NDI 参数化、与绝热模的相关性设定、Σmν 先验边界和中微子层级先验如何改变后验；还需确认极强质量上限是否主要由数据驱动而非先验体积效应。

papers.title: Alleviating the Hubble tension with the $Λ_{ω_s}$CDM model
papers.abstract: We formulate a novel extension of the $Λ$CDM model, named $Λ_{ω_s}$CDM, in which we consider an additional term at early times in order to alleviate the Hubble tension. This additional component, referred to as \emph{matter with pressure}, indicates a barotropic fluid that is subdominant to dust and radiation as the Universe expands, thereby recovering the $Λ$CDM paradigm at late times. We constrain the $Λ_{ω_s}$CDM cosmology by performing a Markov Chain Monte Carlo analysis with Planck 2018 CMB, DESI DR2, and Pantheon+\texttt{SH0ES} data. The results suggest that the barotropic factor and the normalized density of the new fluid are given, respectively, by $ω_s=0.294_{-0.004(0.023)}^{+0.014(0.015)}$ and $10^{5}Ω_s=1.62_{-0.56(0.91)}^{+0.36(1.02)}$. With these two additional parameters, the Hubble constant is increased to $H_0 = 71.51^{+0.72(1.43)}_{-0.74(1.46)}$ km/s/Mpc, alleviating \emph{de facto} the Hubble tension.
papers.comment: Proceeding AstroMarche2 conference, September 2025, Accepted for publication in IJMPA, 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table

analysis.title_zh: 用 Λ_{ω_s}CDM 模型缓解哈勃张力
analysis.summary_zh: 该文提出 Λ_{ω_s}CDM 模型，在早期宇宙加入一个随膨胀相对尘埃和辐射变得次主导的有压 barotropic 流体，以尝试缓解 Hubble 张力。摘要报告作者用 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 和 Pantheon+SH0ES 做 MCMC 约束，得到非零的新流体参数，并使 H0 升至约 71.5 km/s/Mpc。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Hubble 张力直接牵涉 CMB 推断的早期宇宙标尺与局域距离梯推断之间的不一致；任何早期宇宙额外组分都会改变 CMB 声学峰、声学视界和参数退化结构，因此对 CMB 宇宙学模型检验高度相关。
key_points: 提出含早期额外“有压物质”组分的 Λ_{ω_s}CDM 扩展模型。
使用 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 与 Pantheon+SH0ES 数据做 MCMC 约束。
摘要称加入两个新参数后 H0 升高，从而缓解 Hubble 张力。
methods: ΛCDM 的早期宇宙扩展模型 Λ_{ω_s}CDM
重子/辐射之外的 barotropic fluid（matter with pressure）参数化
Markov Chain Monte Carlo 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对该早期额外流体如何影响声学尺度、阻尼尾和物质辐射平衡，以及 Planck CMB 与 DESI/Pantheon+SH0ES 联合拟合中是否存在参数退化或数据集间张力被重新分配。

papers.title: Galaxy-cluster-stacked Fermi-LAT, part IV: $\sim70$ GeV WIMP annihilation lines
papers.abstract: The strongest constraints on the velocity-dependent ($p$-wave) annihilation of weakly interacting massive particle (WIMP) dark matter were derived from the deep potential wells of galaxy clusters. Even weaker signals can be extracted from sufficient aggregated clusters, by cross-correlating $γ$-rays with large-scale structure tracers or stacking over extensive cluster catalogs. Three independent such analyses show a similar triad of emission lines in Fermi-LAT data, around 70, 40, and 13 GeV, emerging from featureless spectra in each hemisphere upon cross-correlation with eROSITA maps, and in stacked MCXC, eROSITA, and DESI catalog clusters only once boosted to the cluster frame. These lines fit the anticipated $χχ\toγγ$, $γZ$, and $γh$ annihilation channels of a $\sim70$ GeV WIMP $χ$, detected by composite matched filters at trial-corrected global $Z$-scores reaching $5.6σ$ (cross-correlations) and $2.3σ$ (stacking), with intrinsic $\sim10^{[-20,-19]}$ cm$^3$ s$^{-1}$ channel cross-sections. High-resolution spectra establish six lines and an unresolved ($2$--$3$ line) feature in total, naturally aligned with the anticipated nine channels of two cross-annihilating WIMPs of masses $67.3_{-0.1}^{+0.1}$ and $71.4_{-0.1}^{+0.2}$ GeV (profile-likelihood bounds; $_{-5\%}^{+3\%}$ systematic; $5.3σ$). The Galactic-center GeV excess is broadly consistent with the corresponding broad annihilation continuum.

analysis.title_zh: 星系团堆叠的 Fermi-LAT 分析第四部分：约 70 GeV WIMP 湮灭谱线
analysis.summary_zh: 该文分析 Fermi-LAT 数据中与星系团及大尺度结构示踪相关的伽马射线谱线，采用交叉相关、星系团堆叠、匹配滤波和似然方法寻找 WIMP 湮灭信号。摘要报告在约 70、40、13 GeV 附近出现一组三联谱线，并将其与约 70 GeV WIMP 的 γγ、γZ、γh 等湮灭通道相联系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇主要属于间接暗物质探测和高能天体物理，但暗物质性质是 CMB 宇宙学参数和早期宇宙能量注入约束的重要组成部分；若谱线解释成立，将影响冷暗物质粒子图景，并需与 CMB 对湮灭能量注入的限制相容。
key_points: 研究 Fermi-LAT 伽马射线数据中与星系团相关的谱线特征。
摘要称多个交叉相关和堆叠分析在约 70、40、13 GeV 附近看到类似谱线三联征。
将这些特征解释为约 70 GeV WIMP 湮灭通道的候选信号，但需精查试验因子、背景建模和系统误差。
methods: 与 eROSITA maps 的交叉相关
将信号提升到星系团参考系
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对谱线搜索的背景模型、look-elsewhere/trial correction、星系团参考系提升步骤、目录选择函数，以及交叉相关和堆叠结果是否真正独立。

papers.title: Axion-Sourced Gravitational Waves in $\mathrm{B\!-\!L}$ Hybrid Inflation
papers.abstract: Minimal supersymmetric $\mathrm{B\!-\!L}$ hybrid inflation predicts a negligible vacuum tensor-to-scalar ratio $r_{\rm vac}\sim 10^{-8}$ due to its extremely flat potential. In this letter, we show that adding a spectator pseudoscalar axion-like field coupled to the $\rm {U}(1)_{\mathrm{B\!-\!L}}$ gauge sector via a Chern-Simons term circumvents this suppression. The rolling axion triggers a tachyonic instability for one gauge field helicity, exponentially amplifying gauge fluctuations. These sourced modes generate a stochastic gravitational-wave background with tensor power spectrum ${\cal P}_{T}^{\rm src}\propto e^{4πξ}/ξ^{6}$, where $ξ= α\dotφ / (2 f_a H)$ is the gauge-field instability parameter. For $ξ\sim3.3$--$3.6$, the tensor-to-scalar ratio reaches $r\sim10^{-3}$, within the sensitivity of LiteBIRD. For $ξ\sim3.6$, the gravitational-wave spectrum develops a peaked shape that enters the LISA sensitivity band (peaking at frequencies around $10^{-3}$ Hz) with an amplitude $h^2Ω_{\rm GW}\sim2.5\times10^{-13}$. The mechanism predicts chiral gravitational waves, a broken consistency relation $r=16ε$, and a distinctive $r$--$Ω_{\rm GW}$ correlation that could be tested by future CMB and interferometer observations.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, to be submitted to PRL

analysis.title_zh: B−L 混合暴胀中的轴子源引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 该文讨论在最小超对称 B−L 混合暴胀中加入旁观者类轴子场，通过 Chern-Simons 耦合放大一个规范场手征，从而产生额外 sourced 原初引力波。摘要报告该机制可把原本极小的真空张量标量比提高到 LiteBIRD 可探测量级，并在特定不稳定参数下产生可进入 LISA 频段的峰状随机引力波谱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接面向 CMB B 模原初张量信号：它提供了非真空、手征的张量来源，可能改变 r 的解释和单场慢滚一致性关系；同时把 CMB 张量观测与空间引力波干涉仪频段的随机背景联系起来。
key_points: 在 B−L 混合暴胀中加入旁观者类轴子赝标量场及 Chern-Simons 耦合。
滚动轴子触发规范场单手征的 tachyonic 放大，产生 sourced 随机引力波背景。
摘要称可使 r 达到 LiteBIRD 灵敏度附近，并在部分参数下进入 LISA 频段，同时预言手征引力波和破缺的单场一致性关系。
methods: 最小超对称 B−L hybrid inflation 框架
与 U(1)_{B−L} 规范场的 Chern-Simons 耦合
sourced tensor power spectrum 估算
LiteBIRD 与 LISA 灵敏度比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 sourced 张量增强是否同时满足标量扰动、非高斯性、回反应和有效场论控制条件，并确认 r 与 LISA 频段 Ω_GW 的关联是否依赖窄参数区间。

papers.title: Impact of CMB low-$\ell$ EE polarization data on dark energy parameterizations
papers.abstract: Measurement of the optical depth to reionization ($τ_\mathrm{reio}$) is largely driven by the large-scale EE polarization data of CMB ($\ell<30$). Removing the low-$\ell$ EE data potentially alleviates various cosmological tensions. In this work, we study the effect of the low-$\ell$ EE polarization measurements on the CPL, JBP and BA dark energy parameterizations using CMB data from Planck and ACT DR6, combined with DESI BAO and PantheonPlus compilation of Type Ia supernovae. We find that excluding low-$\ell$ EE data shifts $τ_\mathrm{reio}$ and $A_s$ to higher values through the unbroken $A_s-τ_\mathrm{reio}$ degeneracy with a $\sim(1.4-1.8)σ$ shift in $A_s$ for $Λ$CDM and JBP, and a milder $\sim 1σ$ shift for CPL and BA. The equation of state (EOS) for all three parameterizations moves towards the quintessence regime ($w(z) > -1$) upon exclusion of low-$\ell$ EE data, driven primarily by the strengthening of the $w_a-A_s$ and the $w_a-τ_\mathrm{reio}$ correlations, with a small effect from the correlations of $w_0$ with $A_s$ and $τ_\mathrm{reio}$. The most prominent effect occurs in JBP, where the EOS lies entirely within the quintessence regime at $1σ$ when excluding low-$\ell$ EE data. Model comparison through AIC shows positive evidence in favor of CPL and BA and weak evidence in favor of JBP, robust to the inclusion of low-$\ell$ EE data and CMB data used. DIC model comparison shows strong evidence in favor of CPL and BA when low-$\ell$ EE data is included, and positive evidence when it is excluded. For JBP, we get positive (weak) evidence when including (excluding) low-$\ell$ EE data over $Λ$CDM.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures; Accepted for publication in Physical Review D

analysis.title_zh: CMB 低多极 EE 偏振数据对暗能量参数化的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 CMB 大尺度 EE 偏振数据，尤其是低多极 ℓ<30 数据，对 CPL、JBP 和 BA 暗能量参数化约束的影响。摘要报告称，移除低多极 EE 数据会使 τ_reio 和 A_s 升高，并使三种参数化的暗能量状态方程向 w(z)>-1 的 quintessence 区域移动；AIC/DIC 比较总体上给出 CPL 和 BA 相对 ΛCDM 的证据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 低多极 EE 偏振直接影响再电离光学深度和原初标量振幅的推断，而这些参数又会通过与暗能量参数的相关性改变晚期宇宙学结论。对 CMB 研究者而言，这篇文章突出说明了大尺度偏振数据选择不仅影响 τ_reio，也会传导到暗能量模型比较和宇宙学张力讨论中。
key_points: 低多极 EE 数据主导再电离光学深度测量。
移除低多极 EE 会通过未打破的 A_s-τ_reio 简并推高 τ_reio 和 A_s。
三种暗能量参数化的状态方程均向 quintessence 区域移动。
methods: PantheonPlus Ia 型超新星汇编
AIC 与 DIC 模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对低多极 EE 数据的剔除方式、Planck 与 ACT DR6 的组合细节，以及 A_s-τ_reio、w_a-A_s、w_a-τ_reio 相关性如何在不同暗能量参数化中驱动结论。

papers.title: Constraints with CMB lensing on dark matter decays to massive decay products
papers.abstract: Motivated by the recent measurements by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) which suggest a late-time matter density approximately 5\% lower than that inferred from Planck we investigate models in which dark matter decays to two less massive, and thus warm, states. The decaying dark matter (DDM) models are parameterized by the fraction $f$ of dark matter that decays, the decay rate $Γ$, and the fraction $\varepsilon$ of the mass retained by the decay products. To efficiently explore the warm decay product regime, we employ \texttt{CLASSIER-DDM}, a modified version of the public Boltzmann solver \texttt{CLASS} that solves the perturbation equations with DDM via an integral-equation method. We consider DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations and Planck 2018 CMB data including lensing, and find that DDM models are not favored over the $Λ$CDM model. This result arises because CMB lensing tightly constrains the velocity kicks imparted to decay products. For example, for $f\simeq0.5$, we find $1σ$ constraints to the decay-product kick velocities an order of $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-3}$ times the speed of light for decay redshifts from shortly after recombination until today. Nonetheless, the allowed parameter space includes models with sufficient power suppression at small-scales to potentially address dwarf galaxy anomalies. Our results also suggest that explanations for DESI that involve dark-matter decays to one massive and one massless particle will be constrained by CMB lensing.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 CMB 透镜约束暗物质衰变为有质量衰变产物的模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文受 DESI 对晚期物质密度较 Planck 推断偏低的提示启发，检验暗物质衰变为两个较轻有质量暖态的模型。作者使用 CLASSIER-DDM、DESI DR2 BAO 和 Planck 2018 CMB 含透镜数据，摘要报告称这类 DDM 模型相对 ΛCDM 未被偏好，主要因为 CMB 透镜强烈限制衰变产物获得的速度 kick。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜测量对结构增长和物质功率谱的积分效应敏感，因此能直接检验暗物质衰变导致的晚期聚团变化。该工作把 DESI BAO 与 Planck CMB 及透镜信息结合，用于评估暗物质衰变能否解释晚期物质密度或小尺度结构相关异常。
key_points: 研究暗物质衰变为两个较轻且较暖的有质量产物。
CMB 透镜对衰变产物的速度 kick 给出强约束。
摘要称这类 DDM 模型相对 ΛCDM 未被数据偏好。
methods: 积分方程方法求解含 DDM 的扰动方程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 CMB 透镜似然如何约束衰变产物速度 kick、DDM 参数 f、Γ、ε 的先验设定，以及小尺度功率压低与 DESI 低物质密度提示之间的对应是否依赖特定参数区域。

papers.title: Controlling instrumental systematics for the BICEP inflation survey
papers.abstract: The BICEP series of experiments has been observing CMB polarisation from the South Pole for over 20 years, with the goal of constraining inflationary gravitational waves. The upcoming data release, using data taken through 2024, is forecasted to constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ at the level of $σ(r) \sim 0.005$ (including delensing), with the longer-term goal of reaching $σ(r) \sim 0.001$ by 2034. As the survey sensitivity increases, it is crucial to control instrumental systematics to unprecedented levels, and our goal is to limit dominant sources of systematics to 20% of $σ(r)$ or lower. Achieving this requires careful instrumental characterisation and dedicated end-to-end studies to evaluate the impact of each systematic on cosmological parameters. We first present the BICEP calibration program, which characterises the optical, spectral, and polarisation response of the receivers. We then describe the analysis strategies implemented to identify and mitigate systematic contamination, and we detail simulations used to evaluate the impact of residual effects. We focus in particular on beam systematics, the dominant source of systematics for BICEP receivers. Finally, we report preliminary estimates of the expected level of systematic contamination for upcoming BICEP results, and we discuss approaches to evaluate and mitigate instrumental systematics for future surveys.
papers.comment: Conference proceedings - Rencontres de Moriond, Cosmology, 2026

analysis.title_zh: BICEP 暴胀巡天的仪器系统误差控制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 BICEP 暴胀巡天为未来更高精度约束张标比 r 而开展的仪器系统误差控制工作。摘要描述了 BICEP 的标定项目、系统误差识别和缓解策略、端到端模拟，并给出即将发布结果中系统污染水平的初步估计，重点关注主导的波束系统误差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 寻找 CMB B 模式中的原初引力波要求极严格的偏振系统误差控制，尤其是在去透镜后目标 σ(r) 持续降低的情况下。该文对研究 CMB 偏振、B 模式和未来地面实验设计的读者重要，因为它聚焦于系统误差如何进入 r 的宇宙学约束。
key_points: BICEP 长期目标是约束暴胀引力波对应的张标比 r。
随着灵敏度提升，仪器系统误差需要被限制到 σ(r) 的小比例。
摘要特别强调 beam systematics 是 BICEP 接收机的主导系统误差来源。
methods: BICEP 南极 CMB 偏振观测
光学、频谱和偏振响应标定
系统误差识别与缓解分析策略
残余系统误差对宇宙学参数影响评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对各类系统误差到 r 偏差或不确定度的传播方法、beam systematics 的建模与验证方式，以及所谓 20% σ(r) 控制目标在端到端模拟中的具体判据。

papers.title: KiDS-Legacy: Joint analysis of second- and third-order cosmic shear
papers.abstract: Weak lensing by large-scale structure is a powerful cosmological probe. While most analyses rely on second-order correlations, these are primarily sensitive to the parameter combination $S_8 = σ_8 (Ω_m/0.3)^{0.5}$, limiting their ability to constrain $Ω_m$ and other cosmological parameters independently. Higher-order statistics capture non-Gaussian features of the density field and can therefore break parameter degeneracies and extract more cosmological information from weak lensing surveys. We present a joint analysis of second- and third-order cosmic shear in the final data release of the Kilo-Degree Survey (KiDS-Legacy). We combine COSEBIs (Complete Orthogonal Sets of E-/B-mode Integrals) at scales between 2' and 300' with third-order aperture mass moments at scales between 4' and 32' to perform a joint analysis of second- and third-order statistics. Compared to previous KiDS analyses, we implement several methodological advances: an intrinsic alignment model with redshift and mass dependence, a baryon correction model validated on multiple hydrodynamical simulations, and corrections for reduced shear and source clustering. Combining COSEBIs with third-order aperture mass statistics in KiDS-Legacy yields $Ω_m = 0.297^{+0.056}_{-0.040}$ and $S_8 = 0.806^{+0.025}_{-0.023}$, significantly tightening the $Ω_m$ constraints and more than doubling the figure of merit in the $Ω_m$--$S_8$ plane compared to the two-point analysis alone. The third-order measurements pass stringent internal consistency tests, are fully compatible with the KiDS-Legacy 2-point constraints, other 2+3-point lensing results and with Planck CMB measurements within $1σ$, providing no evidence for an $S_8$ tension and demonstrating the maturity of 3-point cosmic shear as a key probe for forthcoming surveys.
papers.comment: 14 pages plus appendix, 15 figures, submitted to A&A

analysis.title_zh: KiDS-Legacy：二阶与三阶宇宙剪切的联合分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对弱透镜二阶统计主要约束 S_8、难以单独收紧 Ω_m 的问题，在 KiDS-Legacy 中联合 COSEBIs 二阶 cosmic shear 与三阶 aperture mass moments。摘要报告联合分析得到 Ω_m=0.297^{+0.056}_{-0.040}、S_8=0.806^{+0.025}_{-0.023}，相对二点分析显著收紧 Ω_m，并与 KiDS 二点、其他 2+3 点透镜结果及 Planck CMB 在 1σ 内相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 弱透镜 S_8 约束是检验 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 结构增长预测的重要低红移交叉检验。该工作声称三阶 cosmic shear 已能提高 Ω_m--S_8 平面的约束力，并报告与 Planck CMB 相容，因此对评估所谓 S_8 张力及未来巡天的高阶统计分析有直接意义。
key_points: KiDS-Legacy 联合使用二阶与三阶 cosmic shear 统计。
三阶 aperture mass moments 用于捕捉密度场非高斯信息并缓解 Ω_m--S_8 退化。
摘要称结果与 Planck CMB 在 1σ 内相容，未显示 S_8 张力证据。
methods: COSEBIs（二阶 E/B 模积分），角尺度 2'--300'
三阶 aperture mass moments，角尺度 4'--32'
含红移和质量依赖的 intrinsic alignment 模型
经多个流体动力学模拟验证的 baryon correction model
reduced shear 与 source clustering 修正
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对三阶统计的协方差、系统误差传播、baryon/IA/reduced-shear/source-clustering 修正如何影响 Ω_m 与 S_8 后验，以及“与 Planck 在 1σ 内相容”的比较基准是否一致。

papers.title: Non-linear Structure Formation in Planck+DESI Favoured Interacting Dark Energy Cosmologies
papers.abstract: Following our previous work constraining interacting dark energy (IDE) models, which showed their potential to alleviate the Hubble tension, in this work we investigate the non-linear effects of the IDE scenario favoured by CMB and DESI observations. The implications of IDE for the $S_8$ tension remain unclear, since current weak-lensing and large-scale-structure analyses either exclude highly non-linear scales or model the non-linear regime using prescriptions calibrated within $Λ$CDM. We address this issue by implementing a fully self-consistent IDE pipeline. We perform N-body simulations of the IDE model with a transfer rate $Q=ξ{\cal H}ρ_x$ using a modified implementation of RAMSES. Since the dark matter Euler equation remains unchanged with respect to $Λ$CDM, the interaction can be incorporated through the modified background evolution and an effective time-dependent dark matter particle mass. We find scale-dependent deviations in the quasi-linear and non-linear regimes of the matter power spectrum, together with modifications to the density-field morphology and halo abundance. Our results show that the impact of IDE on quasi-linear and non-linear structure formation cannot be captured by standard $Λ$CDM-calibrated prescriptions, highlighting the importance of model-consistent non-linear modelling for future weak-lensing and large-scale-structure constraints on interacting dark energy cosmologies.

analysis.title_zh: Planck+DESI 偏好的相互作用暗能量宇宙学中的非线性结构形成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由 CMB 与 DESI 观测偏好的相互作用暗能量模型在准线性和非线性结构形成中的影响，动机是现有弱透镜和大尺度结构分析常排除强非线性尺度或使用 ΛCDM 标定处方。作者用修改版 RAMSES 对 Q=ξ𝓗ρ_x 模型做自洽 N 体模拟，摘要报告物质功率谱、密度场形态和晕丰度出现尺度依赖偏离，且不能由标准 ΛCDM 标定处方捕捉。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对暗能量和暗物质相互作用的约束主要来自早期宇宙和线性扰动，而低红移弱透镜与大尺度结构检验依赖非线性建模。若 IDE 可缓解 Hubble 张力但改变非线性结构增长，那么它也会影响 S_8 张力讨论及 CMB+DESI+弱透镜联合约束的一致性。
key_points: 研究 Planck+DESI 偏好的相互作用暗能量模型在非线性结构形成中的表现。
使用修改版 RAMSES 进行 IDE N 体模拟，包含修正背景演化和时变暗物质粒子质量。
摘要称 ΛCDM 标定的非线性处方不能捕捉 IDE 的准线性和非线性效应。
methods: Planck 与 DESI 所偏好的相互作用暗能量情景
修改版 RAMSES 的 N 体模拟
物质功率谱、密度场形态、halo abundance 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Planck+DESI 偏好参数的来源和先验、RAMSES 修改是否严格实现 IDE 动力学、初始条件与质量演化处理，以及与 ΛCDM 标定非线性处方比较时的公平性。

papers.title: CMB Constraints on Pre-Inflationary Axion Dark Matter Isocurvature
papers.abstract: Although measurements of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) are consistent with a nearly scale-invariant primordial spectrum of adiabatic perturbations, in which the energy densities of different components (radiation, baryons, and dark matter) fluctuate proportionally, there could also exist isocurvature perturbations, in which density fluctuations of the individual components differ from the adiabatic mode. Cold dark matter isocurvature (CDI) perturbations with a variety of spectral tilts generated in pre-inflationary axion models provide one such example. In this article, we present the most updated constraints on these axion CDI perturbations using the latest CMB anisotropy measurements from Planck, the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT), and the South Pole Telescope (SPT). We study both fixed spectral indices with values ranging from red- to blue-tilted spectra as well as the case with a free index. We find that the constraint on the spectral index gets moderately improved with the combined datasets compared to Planck alone, while the bounds on the isocurvature amplitudes for the fixed spectral indices we consider do not get tighter. We also discuss the theoretical implications of our constraints, in particular for models giving rise to blue-tilted spectra.

analysis.title_zh: CMB 对预暴胀轴子暗物质等曲率扰动的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck、ACT 和 SPT 的最新 CMB 各向异性测量更新对预暴胀轴子模型产生的冷暗物质等曲率扰动约束。摘要报告，相比只用 Planck，联合数据对谱指数的约束有适度改善，但对所考察固定谱指数情形下的等曲率振幅上限并未变紧，并讨论了蓝倾谱模型的理论含义。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 等曲率扰动是 CMB 原初扰动检验中的核心非绝热自由度，直接关系到暴胀前轴子暗物质场景是否可行。该文结合 Planck、ACT、SPT 数据更新 CDI 约束，对研究 CMB 初始条件、暗物质生成机制和蓝倾等曲率模型的读者尤其相关。
key_points: 直接使用 Planck、ACT、SPT 最新 CMB 各向异性数据约束轴子 CDI 等曲率扰动。
考察固定谱指数和自由谱指数两类情形，覆盖红倾到蓝倾谱。
摘要称联合数据适度改善谱指数约束，但固定谱指数下等曲率振幅界限未收紧。
methods: Planck CMB 各向异性测量
ACT CMB 各向异性测量
SPT CMB 各向异性测量
冷暗物质等曲率（CDI）扰动约束
固定谱指数与自由谱指数分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 CDI 振幅与谱指数的参数化、不同 CMB 数据集的组合方式和多极范围、与绝热谱参数的退化关系，以及蓝倾谱模型的理论先验如何影响解释。

papers.title: Narrow-Line Seyfert 1 Galaxies in the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 1
papers.abstract: Narrow-line Seyfert 1 (NLSy1) galaxies are peculiar active galactic nuclei (AGN) known to exhibit a variety of intriguing observational features from low-frequency radio waves to high-energy $γ$~rays. As of now, NLSy1 catalogs are primarily based on optical spectroscopic observations from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS). Here we report, for the first time, a new catalog of NLSy1 galaxies using the high-quality optical spectroscopic observations made public in the first data release of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI). We performed a detailed spectral decomposition of more than 71,000 optical spectra of AGN not included in the SDSS catalog and located at $z<0.9$. From this sample, we identify 18749 objects as NLSy1 galaxies for the first time. We also supplement the NLSy1 catalog with a sample of broad-line Seyfert 1 galaxies. The NLSy1 galaxies identified in the DESI data tend to have slightly higher bolometric luminosities and lower black hole masses (though with large dispersions), leading to the higher Eddington ratios than those of the SDSS-NLSy1 sample matched in redshifts and absolute $B$-band magnitudes. Moreover, the fraction of DESI-NLSy1 galaxies detected in the radio, X-ray, and $γ$-ray catalogs was found to be lower than that of SDSS-NLSy1 sources. We conclude that deeper multiwavelength investigations of these enigmatic AGN will help unravel the low-luminosity end of the NLSy1 population. The catalog has been made available at https://www.ucm.es/blazars/seyfert and Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20484681.

analysis.title_zh: 暗能量光谱仪第一数据发布中的窄线 Seyfert 1 星系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 DESI DR1 公开的光学光谱，为未包含在 SDSS 目录且 z<0.9 的 AGN 构建新的窄线 Seyfert 1 星系目录，并通过详细谱分解识别出 18749 个首次归类为 NLSy1 的天体。摘要报告称，这些 DESI-NLSy1 相比匹配的 SDSS-NLSy1 样本具有略高的热辐射光度、较低黑洞质量和较高 Eddington 比，同时在射电、X 射线和 γ 射线目录中的检出比例较低。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于星系与 AGN 巡天研究，而非直接 CMB 分析；其宇宙学相关性来自 DESI 大规模光谱数据产品和 AGN 样本选择。对 CMB 读者而言，它可能影响前景源、AGN 多波段交叉匹配以及大尺度结构示踪体的理解，但摘要未显示其直接用于 CMB 透镜、ISW 或参数约束。
key_points: 基于 DESI DR1 光谱构建新的窄线 Seyfert 1 星系目录。
从未纳入 SDSS 目录且 z<0.9 的 AGN 光谱中首次识别出大量 NLSy1 候选体。
与匹配的 SDSS-NLSy1 样本相比，DESI-NLSy1 的多波段检出比例较低。
methods: DESI DR1 高质量光学光谱观测
对超过 71,000 个未纳入 SDSS 目录、z<0.9 的 AGN 光谱进行详细谱分解
与 SDSS-NLSy1 样本按红移和绝对 B 波段星等匹配比较
交叉匹配射电、X 射线和 γ 射线目录
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 NLSy1 的光谱判据、谱分解模型和选择函数，尤其是 DESI 与 SDSS 样本在深度、目标选择和多波段覆盖上的差异是否足以解释物理量和检出率差别。

papers.title: The Manticore Project II: Bayesian digital twins of cosmic structure across the SDSS and BOSS volumes
papers.abstract: We present Manticore-Deep, a high-resolution Bayesian field-level reconstruction of cosmic large-scale structure over a comoving volume of $(4~h^{-1}\mathrm{Gpc})^{3}$ to $z\approx0.7$ at ${\sim}4$~Mpc/h resolution. Extending the companion Manticore-Local analysis (Paper~I), Manticore-Deep jointly constrains five galaxy redshift surveys within a single hierarchical Bayesian framework using the BORG algorithm. The inference reconstructs primordial initial conditions evolved under gravity, yielding a posterior ensemble of three-dimensional density and velocity fields that causally reproduce the observed large-scale structure. A novel tiled inference strategy extends the reconstructed volume by more than an order of magnitude beyond Paper~I. Posterior realisations are consistent with LCDM, reproducing Gaussian isotropic initial conditions and the expected $z=0$ matter power spectrum, bispectrum, and halo mass function over the resolved scales. We validate the reconstruction using two independent template-free posterior-predictive tests against observations excluded from the inference. Cross-correlation with the \textit{Planck} PR3 CMB lensing map yields a cumulative detection significance of 7.4 $σ$, while velocity-weighted stacking of $64{,}750$ galaxy clusters on the \textit{Planck} 217~GHz map detects the kinetic Sunyaev--Zel'dovich effect at $3.5σ$, with a model-independent approach--recession split confirming the inferred velocities. Together, these tests validate both the projected-density and three-dimensional velocity fields recovered by Manticore-Deep. The BOSS Great Wall is recovered as a ${\sim}3σ$ overdensity consistent with LCDM across the posterior ensemble. Manticore-Deep establishes a benchmark for survey-depth constrained cosmological digital twins and reproducible field-level validation of large-scale structure reconstructions.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 21 figures. Published in MNRAS. Data will become available at www.cosmictwin.org. This is a Learning the Universe publication
papers.journal_ref: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society, Volume 550, Issue 4, August 2026, stag1366

analysis.title_zh: Manticore 项目 II：跨越 SDSS 与 BOSS 体积的宇宙结构贝叶斯数字孪生
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 Manticore-Deep，在 SDSS 与 BOSS 体积内用 BORG 层级贝叶斯框架重建到 z≈0.7 的三维大尺度结构密度和速度场，并生成后验 ensemble。摘要报告称，重建在解析尺度上与 LCDM 一致，并通过未参与推断的观测进行后验预测检验，包括与 Planck PR3 CMB 透镜图的交叉相关和 Planck 217 GHz 图上的 kSZ 速度加权堆叠。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 宇宙学直接相关：它把星系红移巡天的三维大尺度结构重建与 Planck CMB 透镜和 kSZ 次级各向异性相连接。若摘要所述验证成立，这类场级“数字孪生”可用于 CMB 透镜交叉相关、kSZ 速度场检验、结构增长研究以及未来多探针联合分析。
key_points: 提出 Manticore-Deep：覆盖 SDSS 与 BOSS 体积的高分辨率贝叶斯场级大尺度结构重建。
后验三维密度和速度场通过 Planck CMB 透镜与 kSZ 观测进行独立检验。
摘要称重建结果在解析尺度上与 LCDM 的初始条件、功率谱、双谱和 halo 质量函数一致。
methods: 单一层级贝叶斯框架联合约束五个星系红移巡天
原初初始条件的引力演化重建
与 Planck PR3 CMB lensing map 交叉相关
对 64,750 个星系团在 Planck 217 GHz 图上进行速度加权堆叠以检测 kSZ 效应
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对场级重建的选择函数、偏差模型、平铺边界处理和后验协方差传播；同时检查 CMB 透镜交叉相关与 kSZ 堆叠是否真正独立于重建输入，以及显著性评估和空检验的定义。

papers.title: Inflationary interpretation of the gravitational-wave signal in the European Pulsar Timing Array DR2 with constraints
papers.abstract: The second data release of the European Pulsar Timing Array (EPTA) collaboration provides evidence for the presence of a gravitational-wave (GW) background. In this work, we explore a potential cosmological interpretation of this signal in terms of inflationary scenarios. We parametrize the tensor power spectrum in terms of the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$, the tensor spectral index $n_t$, the reheating temperature $T_{\text{rh}}$, and the cut-off frequency $f_{\text{end}}$. We incorporate all relevant observational constraints, including those from the Cosmic Microwave Background, Big Bang Nucleosynthesis, and LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observations. We demonstrate that imposing these constraints consistently reduces the region of parameter space that provides a viable interpretation of the EPTA signal, to $-11.66 \lesssim \log_{10}r \lesssim -1.45$, $1.32 \lesssim n_t \lesssim 2.47$, $1.78\text{ MeV} \lesssim T_{\text{rh}} \lesssim 28.2\text{ GeV}$, and $75.86\text{ nHz} \lesssim f_{\text{end}} \lesssim 14.45\text{ Hz}$ at the 95% confidence level. This favours the scenario in which the GW spectrum in the EPTA frequency band originates from tensor modes that re-entered the Hubble radius during the radiation-dominated era, allowing for a higher $r$ and a flatter spectrum. However, $T_{\text{rh}}$ must take very low values, which are challenging to explain theoretically.

analysis.title_zh: 在约束条件下对欧洲脉冲星计时阵列 DR2 引力波信号的暴胀解释
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察 EPTA DR2 报告的引力波背景是否可由暴胀情景解释，通过以 r、n_t、再加热温度和截止频率参数化张量功率谱，并联合 CMB、BBN 与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 等约束来限制参数空间。摘要报告称，一致施加这些约束后，可行区域显著缩小，并偏向 EPTA 频段中的张量模在辐射主导时期重入视界的情景，但需要理论上较难解释的很低再加热温度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接关联 CMB 的原初张量扰动约束：CMB 对张量标量比和大尺度张量谱给出关键限制，而脉冲星计时阵列探测的是远高频段的随机引力波背景。将 EPTA 与 CMB、BBN 和地面引力波观测联合起来，有助于检验蓝倾斜张量谱、再加热历史和暴胀后早期宇宙动力学。
key_points: 讨论 EPTA DR2 引力波背景信号的暴胀起源解释。
参数化张量功率谱，并联合 CMB、BBN、LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 等约束。
摘要称一致加入约束后，可解释 EPTA 信号的参数空间明显收缩，并偏好极低再加热温度。
methods: EPTA 第二数据发布的引力波背景信号
联合 CMB、Big Bang Nucleosynthesis、LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测约束
95% 置信水平参数空间约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 EPTA 信号似然、张量谱参数化和截止频率处理，以及 CMB、BBN、LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 约束如何联合；特别要检查极低再加热温度是否与 BBN 下限和具体暴胀模型假设相容。

papers.title: CMBolic: Symbolic emulators for the Cosmic Microwave Background. I. Lensing
papers.abstract: We present the first installment of CMBolic: a suite of symbolic cosmic microwave background (CMB) emulators. In this instance, we emulate the CMB lensing potential power spectrum $C_\ell^{φφ}$ for the widely used extended $Λ$CDM model which simultaneously includes massive neutrinos and evolving dark energy modelled using the Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL) parameterization. We achieve comparable precision to existing neural network emulators, with the added benefit of simpler handling as our emulators are analytic functions of the model parameters and multipole $\ell$. On independent validation spectra evaluated in the range $2\leq \ell \leq 5500$, CMBolic achieves mean absolute fractional errors of $0.27\%$ in the $Λ$CDM subspace and $0.32\%$ across the full extended parameter space. This emulation error is well below even the most optimistic noise forecasts from CMB Stage 4 experiments. We apply CMBolic to cosmological parameter estimation with Bayesian inference using the lensing-only likelihoods from ACT DR6 and Planck. We show excellent agreement between the posteriors obtained by CMBolic and the Boltzmann code CLASS. This demonstrates the practical use of CMBolic on cosmological parameter estimation, reducing the runtime from 2 weeks to under 3 minutes.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures. Code available at https://github.com/dvokrouhlicky/CMBolic

analysis.title_zh: CMBolic：宇宙微波背景的符号模拟器。I. 透镜
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 CMBolic 的首个组成部分：用于模拟 CMB 透镜势功率谱 C_ell^{φφ} 的符号解析 emulator，覆盖同时包含大质量中微子和 CPL 演化暗能量的扩展 ΛCDM 模型。摘要报告其验证误差低于 CMB-S4 乐观噪声预期，并在 ACT DR6 与 Planck 透镜-only 贝叶斯参数估计中复现 CLASS 后验，同时将运行时间从两周降至三分钟以内。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜功率谱是约束物质聚集、几何距离、中微子质量和暗能量演化的重要观测量；若解析 emulator 在扩展参数空间内足够准确，可显著加速 CMB 透镜似然分析和未来 Stage-4 级数据的参数扫描。
key_points: 提出 CMBolic 的第一部分，针对 CMB 透镜势功率谱进行符号模拟。
覆盖含大质量中微子和 CPL 演化暗能量的扩展 ΛCDM 参数空间。
摘要称其在 ACT DR6 与 Planck 透镜-only 参数推断中与 CLASS 后验符合，并显著降低运行时间。
methods: 符号 CMB emulator / 解析函数模拟器
CMB 透镜势功率谱 C_ell^{φφ}
扩展 ΛCDM，包括大质量中微子与 CPL 暗能量参数化
ACT DR6 与 Planck lensing-only likelihoods
与 Boltzmann 代码 CLASS 对比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对训练/验证参数范围、符号表达式的构造方式、误差在参数空间边界和高 ell 处的分布，以及在 ACT DR6/Planck 透镜似然中替代 CLASS 时是否会引入可忽略但系统性的后验偏移。

papers.title: Reconstructing dark energy with fewer assumptions
papers.abstract: We perform minimalistic reconstructions of the dark energy density and equation of state using late-time distance measurements. Our methodology avoids assumptions that correlate the values of these functions over time and instead yields their approximate average evolution within seven redshift bins from $z=0$ to $z=4.2$. Constraints are obtained using combinations of BAO measurements from DESI and SDSS, alongside Type Ia supernovae measurements from Pantheon+ and the latest recalibrated samples, Union3.1 and DES-Dovekie. Only an acoustic scale prior is included from the CMB so that our results are insensitive to the possible matter density tension between early and late-time probes. All combinations yield consistent reconstructed histories: a dark energy density that rises to a local maximum before decreasing at late times and an equation of state with two apparent oscillations around the cosmological constant limit. Both functions tentatively suggest a phantom crossing in the equation of state around $z\sim0.6$-$0.8$. These patterns are robust to numerous parameter extensions, such as freely varying spatial curvature and neutrino mass, and they persist in the uncorrelated amplitudes obtained through localized principal component analysis. Deviations from $Λ$CDM in individual bins reach a maximum significance of $\sim2.6$-$3σ$, while the total chi-square difference between the reconstructions and this model provides up to $\sim2σ$ support for the seven additional parameters in the reconstructions. As these significances remain moderate, our main result is the level of consistency between combinations of the most widely used background-level observations. Our results suggest that the dark energy evolution signal is a persistent feature of the data and that it cannot be explained solely by fluctuations or systematics in individual measurements.

analysis.title_zh: 以更少假设重建暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用晚期距离测量对暗能量密度和状态方程做分箱式、低相关假设的重建，结合 DESI/SDSS BAO 与多套 Ia 型超新星数据，并只从 CMB 使用声学尺度先验。摘要报告不同数据组合给出一致的重建历史：暗能量密度先升至局部最大后在晚期下降，状态方程围绕宇宙学常数界限出现两个表观振荡，并在 z≈0.6–0.8 附近有试探性的 phantom crossing，但偏离 ΛCDM 的统计支持仍为中等。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接关联 DESI 时代的暗能量演化信号及其与早期宇宙约束的兼容性；它有意避免使用完整 CMB 物质密度约束，只保留声学尺度先验，因此对研究 CMB 与晚期距离探针之间的张力、暗能量参数化偏差和中微子/曲率退化很有参考价值。
key_points: 用较少先验假设重建暗能量密度和状态方程的红移演化。
主要使用晚期距离观测，只从 CMB 引入声学尺度先验。
摘要称多种数据组合得到一致的演化迹象，但相对 ΛCDM 的显著性仍属中等。
methods: 七个红移 bin 的暗能量密度与状态方程重建，z=0 到 z=4.2
空间曲率和中微子质量等参数扩展
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“最小假设”重建中 bin 的定义、先验体积效应、CMB 声学尺度先验的具体实现，以及所谓振荡和 phantom crossing 是否受数据组合、校准或参数化选择驱动。

papers.title: The DESI results impact the local determination of $H_0$
papers.abstract: Measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) have revealed evidence for dark energy that evolves. If local distance measurements are analyzed with the $w_0w_a$ models preferred by the DESI measurements, the value for the Hubble constant can be as much as $2.5\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}}$ smaller than the value obtained assuming $Λ$CDM. When these $w_0w_a$ models are further constrained by cosmic microwave background (CMB) and type Ia supernova (SNIa) data, the downward shift is $1.1 \pm 0.38\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}}$ (DESI + CMB) and $0.5 \pm 0.1\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}}$ (DESI + CMB + SNIa). The dependence of local determinations of $H_0$ on the background cosmology, combined with the fact that the low-redshift cosmology is not well constrained, is relevant to the Hubble tension.

analysis.title_zh: DESI 结果对 H0 本地测定的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 DESI BAO 所偏好的 w0wa 演化暗能量模型对本地 H0 测定的影响。摘要称，若用这些模型分析本地距离测量，H0 可比 ΛCDM 假设下低最多 2.5 km s^-1 Mpc^-1；加入 CMB 和 SNIa 约束后，下移量分别变为 1.1±0.38 和 0.5±0.1 km s^-1 Mpc^-1。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 哈勃张力的比较通常涉及 CMB 推断的早期宇宙 H0 与本地距离梯 H0；这篇文章强调即便是本地 H0，也会受低红移背景宇宙学模型选择影响，因此 DESI 暗能量结果可能改变 CMB-本地 H0 张力的定量解释。
key_points: 讨论 DESI 偏好的 w0wa 暗能量模型会如何改变本地 H0 推断。
在 DESI+CMB 以及 DESI+CMB+SNIa 约束下，本地 H0 相比 ΛCDM 出现向下修正。
结果被放在哈勃张力背景下解读，强调本地 H0 推断对背景宇宙学模型的依赖。
methods: 本地距离测量的 H0 分析
Ia 型超新星数据约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对本地距离梯子的哪些步骤依赖背景宇宙学、DESI 偏好 w0wa 模型的选取方式，以及加入 CMB 和 SNIa 后 H0 下移量的不确定度如何传播到哈勃张力判断中。

papers.title: Little red dots as a cosmological probe: constraining $H_0$ with quasi-periodic pulsations
papers.abstract: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has uncovered a population of ``little red dots'' (LRDs) at $z \gtrsim 4$, potentially representing early supermassive black holes embedded in dense gaseous envelopes. The recent discovery of the lensed LRD RXJ2211-RX1 reveals significant variability on rest-frame timescales of decades, which may be interpreted as quasi-periodic variation that has a potential physical parallel to stellar pulsations. In this work, we derive an idealized, self-consistent period-luminosity-temperature ($P$-$L$-$T_{\rm eff}$) relation based on the hydrostatic envelope model. If this theoretical relation holds and can be empirically validated/calibrated, it would offer a novel framework for constraining the Hubble constant ($H_0$). The current sparse sampling of \tgta\ yields a preliminary $H_0 = 120.7_{-46.5}^{+47.0} \text{ km s}^{-1}\text{ Mpc}^{-1}$ as a proof-of-concept, with the error budget dominated by the uncertainty of the pulsation period. Our forecasting analysis shows that continuous monitoring over a 10-year baseline can reduce the $H_0$ uncertainty to 3-20\%, depending on the intrinsic pulsation period, while the systematic uncertainty floor remains to be fully characterized. This method offers a potential independent probe to measure luminosity distances in the early universe.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. PRL under review. Comments and suggestions are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 作为宇宙学探针的“小红点”：用准周期脉动约束 H0
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨 JWST 发现的高红移 little red dots 是否可通过类似脉动的准周期变光来构成新的宇宙学距离探针。作者基于静水平衡包层模型推导理想化的周期-光度-有效温度关系，并以 RXJ2211-RX1 做概念验证，摘要报告当前 H0 约束很弱但长期监测可能显著降低不确定性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作与 CMB 的关系主要在于 H0 张力和早期宇宙距离标尺：若 LRD 脉动关系可校准，它可能提供独立于 CMB 声学标尺和低红移距离梯的高红移光度距离测量。不过摘要也明确显示该方法目前高度依赖模型假设与稀疏采样，尚不能作为成熟的 CMB 张力判据。
key_points: 提出将高红移 little red dots 的准周期脉动作为距离探针。
基于静水平衡包层模型推导理想化的周期-光度-有效温度关系。
当前结果主要是概念验证，周期不确定性主导误差，系统误差尚未充分刻画。
methods: JWST 发现的 z ≳ 4 little red dots 背景
透镜化 LRD RXJ2211-RX1 的变光信息
理论周期-光度-有效温度关系
10 年连续监测基线的预测分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对准周期变光解释、静水平衡包层假设以及 P-L-T_eff 关系能否被独立校准；还要检查透镜放大、选择效应和周期测量如何进入 H0 误差预算。

papers.title: Neutrino mass constraints in interacting dark energy models after DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Recent DESI observations indicate a deviation from the $Λ$CDM model, showing a preference for dynamical dark energy and thereby relaxing the upper limit on the neutrino mass within this framework. This deviation can also be explained by the presence of an interaction between dark energy and dark matter. In this work, we investigate the cosmological upper bounds on the total neutrino mass ($\sum m_ν$) across four different interacting dark energy (IDE) models. The present analysis employs the latest DESI baryon acoustic oscillation, cosmic microwave background, and type Ia supernova datasets. These results demonstrate that the upper bounds on $\sum m_ν$ exhibit profound sensitivity to the specific phenomenological formulation of the interaction term. While the I$Λ$CDM2 model ($Q \propto H ρ_{\mathrm{c}}$) substantially relaxes the stringent upper limit ($\sum m_ν < 0.129$ eV at 95% confidence level), notably the I$Λ$CDM3 model ($Q \propto H_0 ρ_{\mathrm{de}}$), severely compresses the allowed parameter space, yielding a highly restrictive bound of $\sum m_ν < 0.051$ eV. Furthermore, rigorous goodness-of-fit evaluations utilizing the Deviance Information Criterion and $Δχ^2_{\mathrm{MAP}}$ indicate that the current observational data statistically favor these mass-suppressing IDE models. This establishes an exacerbated statistical tension between the observationally preferred IDE scenarios and the normal hierarchy lower bound ($\sim 0.06$ eV) determined by terrestrial neutrino oscillation experiments.

analysis.title_zh: DESI DR2 之后相互作用暗能量模型中的中微子质量约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 DESI DR2 之后，在四种相互作用暗能量模型中宇宙学数据对总中微子质量的上限如何变化。摘要报告，DESI BAO、CMB 与 Ia 型超新星联合约束显示质量上限强烈依赖相互作用项形式，其中某些模型会给出非常紧的上限并与地面中微子振荡实验给出的正常质量序下限形成统计张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接涉及 CMB 参数推断中的关键退化关系：中微子质量、暗能量演化、暗物质-暗能量相互作用和 BAO 标尺会共同影响距离与结构增长约束。对于 CMB 读者，它提示在扩展暗能量模型中引用中微子质量上限时，不能只看数值，还必须检查相互作用参数化和数据组合。
key_points: 使用 DESI BAO、CMB 和 Ia 型超新星数据约束相互作用暗能量模型中的中微子质量。
总中微子质量上限对暗能量-暗物质相互作用项形式非常敏感。
摘要声称某些数据偏好的 IDE 模型会加剧与振荡实验正常质量序下限的张力。
methods: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡数据
四种相互作用暗能量模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对所用 CMB 数据组合、DESI DR2 与超新星样本的具体选择，以及四种 Q 项参数化的先验和稳定性条件；尤其要检查低于正常质量序下限的约束是否由模型先验、数据组合或拟合优度判据驱动。

papers.title: Interacting dark energy constraints from Fermi GRBs and Pantheon+ SNe Ia with full GRB covariance
papers.abstract: The standard $Λ$CDM model faces long-standing theoretical and observational problems, such as the Hubble tension, which motivate extensions beyond $Λ$CDM, including interacting dark energy (IDE). Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) are precise probes of the late-time expansion history, while gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) can extend distance measurements to higher redshifts. However, GRB cosmology depends on the calibration of luminosity relations, the covariance treatment, and the intrinsic scatter. In this work, we use 15 years of Fermi/GBM long-GRB observations and Pantheon+ SNe Ia to test whether current distance data provide evidence in favor of IDE models over $Λ$CDM. We compare four flat models: $Λ$CDM, $w$CDM, IDE-$ρ_{\rm de}$, and IDE-$ρ_{\rm c}$. The GRB covariance is constructed by propagating the Amati-relation calibration covariance, and the GRB intrinsic scatter is sampled as a nuisance parameter. A diagonal GRB covariance is also considered as a robustness test. With the full GRB covariance, both the GOLD and FULL samples give $H_0\simeq 72.8~{\rm km~s^{-1}~Mpc^{-1}}$ in $Λ$CDM. The IDE models do not improve the fit enough to compensate for their extra parameters, and the BIC favors the simpler $Λ$CDM model. The diagonal-covariance test gives the same model-selection conclusion, although it changes the fitted GRB intrinsic scatter. We conclude that, for the two interaction forms considered here and at the present level of GRB systematics, current GRB and Pantheon+ data do not provide evidence for interacting dark energy. Current GRBs mainly provide a high-redshift extension of the Hubble diagram and test the shape of the expansion history.

analysis.title_zh: 使用完整 GRB 协方差的 Fermi 伽马暴与 Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星对相互作用暗能量的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 15 年 Fermi/GBM 长 GRB 与 Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星距离数据，比较 ΛCDM、wCDM 及两类相互作用暗能量模型。摘要报告，在传播 Amati 关系校准协方差并采样 GRB 内禀散布后，IDE 模型未能以拟合改善抵消额外参数，BIC 偏好更简单的 ΛCDM。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接使用 CMB，但与 CMB 宇宙学的晚期扩展检验相关：GRB 和超新星给出高红移哈勃图，可作为 CMB 推断的晚期膨胀历史交叉检查。摘要中的结论意味着，在当前 GRB 系统误差水平下，这类距离数据尚不足以支持通过相互作用暗能量来缓解 H0 张力或改变标准模型解释。
key_points: 用 Fermi/GBM 长暴和 Pantheon+ 超新星检验相互作用暗能量。
显式传播 Amati 关系校准协方差，并采样 GRB 内禀散布。
摘要结论是当前 GRB+SNe 数据未给出支持 IDE 优于 ΛCDM 的证据。
methods: 15 年 Fermi/GBM 长伽马暴观测
Amati 关系校准协方差传播
GRB 内禀散布作为 nuisance 参数采样
对角 GRB 协方差稳健性测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 GRB 光度关系校准是否避免宇宙学循环、完整协方差如何构造，以及 GOLD/FULL 样本选择对 H0 和模型选择的影响；还要看 BIC 惩罚是否主导了对 IDE 的不支持结论。

papers.title: Decaying Dark Matter as a Possible Solution for Cosmological Tensions
papers.abstract: Large-scale structure measurements have revealed persistent tensions between early- and late-time cosmological probes, most notably the long-standing discrepancy in the structure-growth parameter $S_8$. In this work, we explore how a model including decaying dark matter (DDM) can alleviate this tension by suppressing the growth of matter fluctuations at late times. Specifically, we consider a neutrinophilic decay channel in which a heavy dark matter particle $χ$ slowly decays into a Standard Model neutrino and a light invisible fermion, $χ\rightarrow ν+ φ$, modifying both the background evolution and the clustering of structure. Using the DES Year~1 redshift distributions, we construct a baseline matter power spectrum and compute the galaxy-galaxy, shear-shear, and galaxy-shear angular power spectra under both $Λ$CDM and DDM-inspired scenarios. We find that slow dark matter decay produces a scale-dependent suppression of clustering that remains consistent with DES measurements while naturally shifting the predicted structure amplitude toward the lower values favored by weak lensing surveys. Our results suggest that decaying dark matter is a compelling and physically motivated framework for addressing the $S_8$ tension.

analysis.title_zh: 衰变暗物质作为宇宙学张力的一种可能解
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究衰变暗物质是否能缓解早期与晚期宇宙学探针之间的结构增长张力，特别是 S8 张力。作者采用亲中微子衰变道 χ→ν+φ，并用 DES Year 1 红移分布计算 ΛCDM 与衰变暗物质情景下的物质功率谱和三类角功率谱；摘要报告慢衰变会产生尺度依赖的聚类抑制，并使结构振幅更接近弱透镜巡天偏好的较低值。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: S8 张力直接连接 CMB 推断的早期宇宙参数与低红移弱透镜/大尺度结构观测。若暗物质在晚期衰变，它会改变从 CMB 初始条件演化到今日结构的增长历史，因此是检验 ΛCDM 外物理、解释 CMB 与低红移结构不一致的重要候选机制。
key_points: 慢衰变暗物质可在晚期抑制物质涨落增长。
摘要关注 DES Year 1 的星系聚类、弱透镜剪切及其互相关角功率谱。
结果声称该机制在保持与 DES 测量一致的同时，将结构振幅推向弱透镜偏好的较低值。
methods: 衰变暗物质模型：重暗物质粒子 χ 衰变为标准模型中微子和轻不可见费米子 φ，χ→ν+φ
星系-星系、剪切-剪切、星系-剪切角功率谱计算
ΛCDM 与 DDM-inspired 情景比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对衰变寿命、分支道和能量注入如何进入背景与扰动方程，以及与 DES 协方差、尺度切割和重子/非线性建模的相容性是否足以支撑“缓解 S8 张力”的表述。

papers.title: The sound of dynamical dark energy and modified gravity
papers.abstract: Different candidate models are able to reproduce the dynamical dark energy signal preferred by combinations of recent distance measurements. These models may be distinguished by the behavior of their perturbations, which are controlled by the effective sound speed $c_s^2(k,a)$. To explore correlations between the dark energy sound speed and perturbative behavior, we test modified gravity (MG) scenarios in which the dark energy equation of state and sound speed determine modifications to the clustering of matter. We investigate the impact of varying the dark energy sound speed on several cosmological quantities in both General Relativity (GR) and MG. We constrain the dark energy and modified gravity parameters using measurements of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) from Planck PR4, type Ia supernova luminosity distances (SN) from Pantheon+, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) from DESI DR2, and cosmic shear from DES-Y3. Using the combination of CMB+BAO+SN, we find that, in the MG scenarios, the preference for dynamical dark energy is correlated with deviations from GR over redshifts $z < 2$ at over 95\% confidence level. The significance of these deviations is not degraded when considering a dynamical or superluminal sound speed, but vanishes if we assume a cosmological constant. The inclusion of cosmic shear and CMB lensing data significantly shifts the constraints towards GR. Our framework enables the exploration of modified gravity models using the dark energy sound speed as a physically meaningful free parameter.

analysis.title_zh: 动力学暗能量与修正引力之声
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究动力学暗能量和修正引力模型中，暗能量有效声速 c_s^2(k,a) 如何影响扰动和物质聚类，并用 CMB、超新星、BAO 与 cosmic shear 数据约束相关参数。摘要报告，在 CMB+BAO+SN 组合下，MG 情景中动力学暗能量偏好与 z<2 的 GR 偏离在超过 95% 置信水平上相关；但加入 cosmic shear 和 CMB lensing 后，约束显著移向 GR。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接使用 Planck PR4 CMB 和 CMB lensing，并讨论暗能量/修正引力扰动如何影响物质聚类和低红移增长。对 CMB 研究者而言，它关系到如何把 CMB 距离标尺、透镜信号与 DESI、超新星、弱透镜联合起来检验 ΛCDM、动力学暗能量和 GR。
key_points: 暗能量声速被作为区分动力学暗能量和修正引力扰动行为的自由参数。
数据组合包括 Planck PR4 CMB、Pantheon+、DESI DR2 BAO、DES-Y3 cosmic shear，并讨论 CMB lensing。
摘要称 CMB+BAO+SN 下 MG 情景中动力学暗能量偏好与 z<2 的 GR 偏离相关；加入 cosmic shear 和 CMB lensing 后约束显著转向 GR。
methods: 有效声速 c_s^2(k,a) 参数化
广义相对论与修正引力情景比较
Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星光度距离
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 MG 参数化与暗能量声速之间的物理一致性、先验选择，以及 CMB lensing 和 cosmic shear 加入后为何把约束推向 GR，是否由数据张力、系统误差处理或参数退化驱动。

papers.title: Late-time Quantum Vacuum Decay and its Cosmological Implications
papers.abstract: The existence of a landscape of metastable vacua raises the possibility that our Universe may have undergone quantum vacuum decay at late times. This work explores how such a transition can be tested with cosmological observables, focusing on precision distance measurements and cosmic microwave background (CMB) anisotropies. A set of phenomenological models is constructed in which late-time quantum tunneling changes the vacuum energy and may convert a subcomponent of dark matter into dark radiation, possibly accompanied by domain-wall production. The resulting expansion histories are compared with DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation data; supernova distance measurements from DES-Dovekie, Pantheon+, and Union3; and a compressed CMB likelihood. For quantum-tunneling models, current cosmological distance measurements still allow a 50% decrease in the total vacuum energy for a transition redshift $z_t<1$. The model with dark-matter conversion and domain-wall production provides a good fit to resolve the tension between cosmological observables and the $Λ$CDM model, with a preferred transition around $z_t \sim 7$ and about 10% of dark matter participating in the transition. Additionally, CMB anisotropy constraints from bubble nucleation and the associated domain-wall network are derived and shown to strongly restrict slow or sparse late transitions. Applied to the minimal quantum-tunneling model, these constraints allow an $\mathcal{O}(10\%)$ decrease in the total vacuum energy for a transition redshift $z_t$ of order unity. For nonminimal models, dark-matter-density-dependent tunneling can proceed rapidly enough to evade such bounds. These results demonstrate that late-time quantum vacuum decay is a testable cosmological phenomenon and provide a concrete observational handle on metastable-vacuum physics motivated by landscape scenarios.

analysis.title_zh: 晚期量子真空衰变及其宇宙学影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨晚期量子真空衰变是否可通过宇宙学观测检验，构建了真空能改变、暗物质部分转化为暗辐射及可能产生畴壁的唯象模型，并与 BAO、超新星距离和压缩 CMB 似然比较。摘要报告，当前距离测量仍允许低红移转变中总真空能显著下降；包含暗物质转化和畴壁的模型可较好拟合 ΛCDM 相关张力，同时 CMB 各向异性对缓慢或稀疏晚期转变给出强限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 晚期真空能变化会改变 CMB 锚定后的距离-红移关系，而泡成核和畴壁网络还可能直接产生或调制 CMB 各向异性。该工作把精密距离探针与 CMB 各向异性约束结合，用来测试超出 ΛCDM 的真空结构和暗部门相变。
key_points: 晚期量子真空隧穿被建模为真空能变化，并可能伴随暗物质转化为暗辐射和畴壁产生。
作者使用 DESI DR2 BAO、多套超新星距离数据和压缩 CMB 似然检验膨胀历史。
摘要还给出来自泡成核和畴壁网络的 CMB 各向异性约束，称其强烈限制缓慢或稀疏的晚期相变。
methods: 晚期量子隧穿的唯象模型
暗物质向暗辐射转化模型
畴壁产生与泡成核相关 CMB 各向异性约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对压缩 CMB 似然是否足以代表完整 CMB 约束、泡成核/畴壁网络对各向异性的计算假设，以及关于 z_t、真空能下降比例和暗物质参与比例的偏好是否依赖特定先验或数据组合。

papers.title: A Designer's Guide to Lunar Far-Side Interferometer Array: Power Spectrum Measurement and Cosmological Constraints from the Dark Ages
papers.abstract: The 21-cm emission line from neutral hydrogen during the cosmic Dark Ages can be a powerful probe of cosmological models and early universe physics. This work provides a quantitative forecast for the design requirements of a lunar far-side interferometer array aimed at measuring the 21-cm power spectrum and constraining inflationary models through the running of the spectral index $α_s$. During the Dark Ages, larger collapsed objects have not yet formed, allowing linear perturbation theory to remain valid down to much smaller scales than is possible in current large-scale structure or CMB surveys. We first validate this linearity assumption by quantifying the contribution of minihalos to the 21-cm signal. We then establish a generalized and flexible analytical framework for the baseline density distribution of interferometers that may consist of an arbitrary number of stations or sub-arrays. Incorporating a realistic noise model, we determine the configurations necessary to reach the detection threshold and demonstrate that distributing the total collecting area into multiple stations can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the power spectrum at a tunable small scale of interest by up to two orders of magnitude. We then show that a lunar array requires at least $\sim30,000$ probed Fourier modes to achieve a constraint on inflation of $σ(α_s) = 0.034$, a result competitive with the Planck 2018 results and capable of distinguishing between different inflationary scenarios. We quantitatively explain how thermal noise severely erodes modes at high redshifts and small scales -- scales previously considered easily accessible to Dark Ages observations in the literature -- and discuss the prospects for Dark Ages observations as a new and independent probe despite this limitation.

analysis.title_zh: 月球背面干涉阵列设计指南：来自暗时代的功率谱测量与宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对月球背面干涉阵观测宇宙暗时代中性氢 21-cm 功率谱，建立阵列基线密度和噪声的解析预报框架，并用谱指数跑动 α_s 评估暴胀约束能力。摘要报告称，多站点配置可在目标小尺度提高功率谱信噪比，达到与 Planck 2018 结果有竞争力的 α_s 约束需要至少约 30,000 个被探测 Fourier 模，同时热噪声会显著侵蚀高红移小尺度信息。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗时代 21-cm 信号可探测比当前 CMB 和大尺度结构更小的线性尺度，因此能独立检验原初扰动和暴胀模型；对 CMB 读者而言，这篇工作直接比较了 α_s 约束与 Planck 2018，并强调未来低频阵列设计和热噪声会决定其是否真正补充 CMB。
key_points: 面向月球背面干涉阵的暗时代 21-cm 功率谱观测设计做定量预报。
摘要称多站点分配总收集面积可在可调小尺度上显著提高功率谱信噪比。
指出热噪声会严重削弱高红移和小尺度模，限制以往认为容易进入的暗时代尺度。
methods: 暗时代中性氢 21-cm 功率谱预报
线性微扰理论适用性检验
minihalo 对 21-cm 信号贡献的定量估计
任意站点或子阵列数目的基线密度分布解析框架
用谱指数跑动 α_s 约束暴胀模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对热噪声模型、基线密度参数化和“至少约 30,000 个 Fourier 模”到 σ(α_s)=0.034 的 Fisher/似然假设；还要检查 minihalo 贡献是否足以支撑线性理论在目标小尺度上的使用。

papers.title: Dynamical Tsallis WIMP Freeze-Out and Residual Memory Channels in the Radiation Sector
papers.abstract: In this work we generalize the thermal decoupling, or freeze-out, of weakly interacting massive particle dark matter within the Tsallis nonextensive formalism. The generalization is implemented through $q$-deformed distribution functions obtained from the maximum entropy principle with Curado-Tsallis constraints. The Tsallis parameter $q$, which measures deviations from extensivity with respect to the limit $q=1$, is promoted to a dynamical quantity depending on the dimensionless variable $x=m_χ/T$, where $m_χ$ is the dark matter mass. This dynamical evolution is characterized by a relaxation toward extensivity, while requiring that the nonextensive deformation is not completely erased before freeze-out. We solve the Boltzmann equation assuming a sectorial deformation, where only the dark matter equilibrium abundance is generalized and the radiation background remains extensive. The relic abundance is computed for different dark matter masses and initial values of the Tsallis parameter. From this evolution, we extract the residual value $q_χ^{\rm fo}$ at freeze-out, which is then used as the initial input for a phenomenological memory channel. This channel propagates the residual nonextensivity into the radiation sector, specifically into the electron-positron plasma and neutrinos, while photons are kept extensive in order to avoid direct tensions with CMB physics. The resulting deformation modifies the neutrino energy density and the photon reheating contribution, producing a correction to $N_{\rm eff}$. We compare the predicted values with the compressed CMB+BAO constraint on $N_{\rm eff}$ and find that the residual-memory scenario can remain phenomenologically compatible with current bounds.

analysis.title_zh: 动态 Tsallis WIMP 冻结与辐射部门中的残余记忆通道
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 Tsallis 非广延统计框架中推广 WIMP 暗物质冻结，令非广延参数 q 随 x=mχ/T 动态趋向广延极限，并通过 Boltzmann 方程计算遗迹丰度。摘要称冻结时残余的非广延性可经现象学记忆通道传入电子-正电子等离子体和中微子，修正 N_eff，且与当前压缩 CMB+BAO 约束保持现象学相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对有效中微子数 N_eff 和辐射能量密度极为敏感，因此任何暗物质冻结历史向辐射部门传递的非标准效应都可能留下可观测痕迹；这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要在于用 N_eff 作为连接粒子暗物理和 CMB+BAO 数据的桥梁。
key_points: 将 WIMP 热退耦推广到动态 Tsallis 非广延形式。
非广延残余通过现象学“记忆通道”影响电子-正电子等离子体和中微子。
摘要称预测的 N_eff 修正可与压缩的 CMB+BAO 约束相容。
methods: Curado-Tsallis 约束下最大熵原理得到的 q 变形分布函数
令 Tsallis 参数 q 随 x=mχ/T 动态演化
部门化变形：仅推广暗物质平衡丰度，辐射背景保持广延
与压缩 CMB+BAO 的 N_eff 约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 q(x) 的动力学设定是否有微观依据、只让暗物质丰度变形而保持光子广延的处理是否自洽，以及 N_eff 修正与 CMB+BAO 约束比较中采用的压缩似然是否足以代表完整数据限制。

papers.title: Measuring the Hubble constant with strongly lensed gravitational waves from space-based detector networks
papers.abstract: The measurement of the Hubble constant $H_0$ plays a central role in modern cosmology. In this work, we investigate the potential of strongly lensed gravitational-wave (SLGW) signals from massive binary black hole mergers to constrain $H_0$ using future space-based detector networks. We consider two observational scenarios: one in which the source redshift is unknown, and another in which it is independently determined through electromagnetic observations. We show that meaningful constraints on $H_0$ can still be achieved without source-redshift information, provided that the lens redshift is known. For individual SLGW events, the joint Taiji+LISA analysis improves the measurement precision of $H_0$ by approximately a factor of two compared with the Taiji-only configuration. Extending the analysis to the population level, we combine five simulated SLGW events and find that the uncertainty in $H_0$, quantified by the 95\% credible interval, reaches the $1.1\times10^{-1}$ level when the source redshift is treated as unknown, and further improves to $4.2\times10^{-2}$ when the source redshift is independently measured. Our results demonstrate that joint space-based gravitational-wave observations can substantially enhance the cosmological capability of SLGW events and provide a promising avenue for precision measurements of the Hubble constant.

analysis.title_zh: 利用空间探测器网络观测的强透镜引力波测量哈勃常数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估未来空间引力波探测器网络利用大质量双黑洞并合的强透镜引力波信号约束 H0 的能力，并比较源红移未知与由电磁观测独立测定两种场景。摘要报告称，只要透镜红移已知，即使源红移未知也能得到有意义的 H0 约束，Taiji+LISA 联合优于 Taiji 单独，五个模拟事件合并可进一步降低不确定度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 是 CMB 推断宇宙学与近邻宇宙测量之间张力的核心参数；强透镜引力波提供一种独立于 CMB 声学尺度和传统距离梯的测量路径，可作为检验 ΛCDM 或系统误差的重要外部交叉检查。
key_points: 研究空间引力波探测器网络用强透镜引力波测量 H0。
比较源红移未知和电磁观测给出源红移两种情形。
摘要称 Taiji+LISA 相比 Taiji 单独可提高单事件 H0 精度，并在五个模拟事件合并后进一步收紧约束。
methods: 大质量双黑洞并合模拟
未来空间探测器网络 Taiji 与 LISA
源红移未知和源红移由电磁观测独立测定两种情景
五个模拟 SLGW 事件的总体合并分析
95% credible interval 表征 H0 不确定度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对强透镜系统的质量模型、镜像识别和时延误差如何进入 H0 后验；还要检查源红移未知时仅依赖透镜红移获得 H0 约束的先验设定及五个模拟事件是否具有代表性。

papers.title: GINKAKU: Scalable Cosmological Structure Formation Simulation Code and Post-processing Pipeline
papers.abstract: We introduce GINKAKU, a new cosmological $N$-body code developed for the Dark Quest II (DQ2) simulation campaign and designed for controlled ensemble production across the cosmological model space required by next-generation galaxy surveys, including massive neutrinos and clustering dark energy. Built on the FDPS framework, GINKAKU couples a TreePM gravity solver with a linear-response treatment of external source terms for components not evolved as $N$-body particles, formulated in the $N$-body gauge. This design incorporates massive-neutrino perturbations, general-relativistic corrections, early-time radiation perturbations, and dark-energy clustering with non-unit effective sound speed at the linear level, while preserving Newtonian particle dynamics on subhorizon scales. The code is validated through internal convergence studies and cross-comparisons with GADGET, PKDGRAV3, and RAMSES on shared initial conditions: code-to-code differences in the nonlinear power spectrum can be reduced below $\sim1\%$ level by tuning internal accuracy parameters, and we identify a production-grade fiducial setting achieving this control at modest cost. We apply GINKAKU to an initial set of DQ2 production runs -- eight cosmological models with $3,000^3$ particles in boxes up to $4\,h^{-1}\mathrm{Gpc}$ -- processed by a renewed post-processing pipeline that reduces the inter-resolution spread of the halo mass function to $\sim 1\%$ and includes halo-shape measurements for intrinsic-alignment statistics. The scale-dependent-growth cosmologies reproduce the expected nonlinear signatures of massive neutrinos and clustering dark energy, demonstrating suitability for emulator-scale production. A total matter power spectrum emulator from these runs is presented in an accompanying paper. (abridged)

analysis.title_zh: GINKAKU：可扩展的宇宙学结构形成模拟代码与后处理管线
analysis.summary_zh: 该文介绍 GINKAKU，一个为 Dark Quest II 模拟计划开发的可扩展宇宙学 N 体代码及后处理流程，用于覆盖含大质量中微子和聚团暗能量的宇宙学模型空间。摘要报告其采用 TreePM 与线性响应外源项处理，并通过收敛测试和与 GADGET、PKDGRAV3、RAMSES 的比较验证，在调节精度参数后非线性功率谱代码间差异可降至约 1% 水平，且已用于首批 DQ2 生产模拟。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 约束常需与低红移大尺度结构、弱透镜和星系巡天联合解释，而这些分析依赖对非线性物质功率谱、晕统计及含中微子/暗能量模型的精确模拟。GINKAKU 若能稳定支撑仿真器级生产，将直接影响 CMB+LSS 联合约束中对小尺度非线性、暗能量聚团和中微子质量效应的建模误差。
key_points: 介绍面向 Dark Quest II 的新宇宙学 N 体模拟代码与后处理流程。
在线性层面纳入大质量中微子、相对论修正、早期辐射扰动和聚团暗能量等外源项。
摘要称与多种代码交叉比较后可将非线性功率谱差异控制到约 1% 水平，并已用于 DQ2 初始生产运行。
methods: N-body gauge 中的线性响应外源项处理
与 GADGET、PKDGRAV3、RAMSES 在共享初始条件上的交叉比较
Dark Quest II 生产运行
更新的后处理管线、晕质量函数与晕形状测量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对线性响应外源项与牛顿粒子动力学的耦合形式、N-body gauge 实现细节、精度参数调节是否会影响不同宇宙学模型上的稳健性，以及 1% 级功率谱和晕质量函数控制的适用尺度与质量范围。

papers.title: Gaussian Process Reconstruction of Cosmological Parameters with Gravitational Wave Sirens using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Future gravitational wave (GW) standard siren catalogues will probe the late-time expansion history of the Universe across redshift ranges largely inaccessible to traditional electromagnetic observations. To determine how effectively this background distance information can distinguish between viable cosmological models, we introduce a model-independent reconstruction framework utilizing Gaussian Process Regression (GPR). Analyzing mock LISA and Einstein Telescope (ET) catalogues across six fiducial cosmological backgrounds-$Λ$CDM, CPL, CPL+$Λ$, interacting dark matter, interacting dark energy and axion inspired early dark energy. We reconstruct the comoving distance and its derivatives. Crucially, we propagated the full GP covariance, including derivative cross-covariances, to robustly evaluate the Hubble parameter $H(z)$ and other diagnostics such as $q(z)$, $\mathcal{O}_{m}(z)$ $w_{\rm total}(z)$ and $κ(z)$. While our analysis demonstrates that GW bright standard sirens faithfully recover fiducial expansion histories, applying pointwise marginal Hellinger distance reveals that background measurements alone do not provide decisive statistical separation among models. Instead, derivative sensitive diagnostics pinpoint specific redshift windows (e.g., $z\simeq1.6-1.8$ for ET and $z\simeq2.6-2.9$ for LISA) where future catalogues will maximize their discriminatory power. As machine learning methodologies become increasingly integral to astrophysics and cosmology, this Bayesian GPR pipeline offers a principled, nonparametric approach to precisely identifying where the most valuable cosmological information lies.

analysis.title_zh: 利用机器学习和引力波标准汽笛对宇宙学参数进行高斯过程重建
