analysis.summary_zh: 该文提出用高斯过程回归对未来引力波亮标准汽笛目录进行模型无关的宇宙学参数与距离导数重建，测试模拟 LISA 和 Einstein Telescope 数据在六种基准宇宙学背景下的表现。摘要报告标准汽笛可恢复基准膨胀历史，但仅靠背景距离测量不能在模型间给出决定性统计区分，导数敏感诊断则指出了最具判别力的红移区间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作主要面向晚期宇宙膨胀史的独立测量，可作为 CMB 推断的低红移互补检验，尤其有助于检查暗能量、相互作用暗物质/暗能量和早期暗能量模型与 CMB 所给早期宇宙约束之间的一致性。不过摘要未涉及 CMB 数据联合分析，因此对 CMB 读者更偏方法和外部探针参考。
key_points: 提出用高斯过程回归重建引力波标准汽笛的背景距离信息。
分析模拟 LISA 和 Einstein Telescope 目录下六类基准宇宙学背景。
摘要称背景距离本身难以给出模型间决定性区分，但导数敏感诊断可定位更有判别力的红移窗口。
methods: 模拟 LISA 标准汽笛目录
模拟 Einstein Telescope 标准汽笛目录
协动距离及其导数重建
传播完整 GP 协方差和导数交叉协方差
Hubble 参数 H(z)、q(z)、Om(z)、w_total(z)、κ(z) 诊断
逐点边际 Hellinger 距离
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟标准汽笛目录的误差模型和选择函数、GP 核函数与超参数处理、导数重建中协方差传播是否充分，以及 Hellinger 距离被如何解释为模型区分能力。

papers.title: Constraints on Dynamical Dark Energy from Multiple Probes in the Full Dark Energy Survey
papers.abstract: We present results on dark energy evolution, assuming a time-dependent equation of state $w(a)=w_0+w_a(1-a)$, from growth and geometric probes using the full six-year Dark Energy Survey dataset: type Ia supernovae, baryon acoustic oscillations, and weak gravitational lensing and galaxy clustering (3$\times$2pt). The combination yields $w_0=-0.84^{+0.10}_{-0.10}$ and $w_a=-0.44^{+0.60}_{-0.55}$, the tightest constraints ever obtained from a single survey, with $2.2σ$ deviation from a cosmological constant. Adding the DESI DR2 BAO data yields $w_0=-0.84^{+0.06}_{-0.07}$ and $w_a=-0.53^{+0.33}_{-0.28}$, representing the most stringent low-redshift-only test of dynamical dark energy to date, with a $2.3σ$ deviation. In this combination, adding 3$\times$2pt doubles the constraining power. Finally, when combined with primary CMB information, we obtain $w_0=-0.82^{+0.05}_{-0.05}$, $w_a=-0.63^{+0.21}_{-0.18}$, with a $3.0σ$ deviation. We find that including 3$\times$2pt in the previously studied SN + DESI BAO + CMB combination leaves the significance essentially unchanged ($3.2 σ$ to $3.0σ$) while improving the figure of merit by $\sim$10\%. We systematically investigate the impact of leaving out each one of the probes and find that the significance of the deviation from a cosmological constant ranges from 2.3 to 3.2$σ$, with best-fit parameters consistently in the region $w_0 >-1$ and $w_a <0$. Excluding SN from the all data combination yields a $2.6σ$ departure from $Λ$CDM, providing a cross-check independent of supernova photometric calibration. These results support the weak preference for evolving dark energy reported by several recent cosmological analyses. By combining growth and geometric probes from a single survey, this work realizes the multi-probe dark energy program envisioned at the inception of DES.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, including Supplemental Material. v2: version submitted to PRL

analysis.title_zh: 利用完整暗能量巡天的多探针对动态暗能量的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 该文用完整六年 Dark Energy Survey 的 Ia 型超新星、BAO、弱透镜和星系聚类 3×2pt，在 CPL 参数化下约束动态暗能量，并进一步加入 DESI DR2 BAO 与 primary CMB 信息。摘要报告各组合给出对宇宙学常数的约 2.2σ 至 3.0σ 弱偏离，最佳拟合倾向于 w0>-1、wa<0，且 3×2pt 可提升低红移组合的约束力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是直接涉及 CMB 联合约束的暗能量结果：primary CMB 提供早期宇宙锚点，而 DES 与 DESI 的低红移几何和增长探针检验从 CMB 外推到晚期宇宙的 ΛCDM 是否一致。对研究 CMB 的读者而言，关键在于理解 CMB 与低红移探针联合后动态暗能量偏好如何形成，以及它是否反映真实物理、系统误差或数据组合张力。
key_points: 使用完整六年 DES 数据的超新星、BAO、弱透镜和星系聚类 3×2pt 约束 CPL 动态暗能量。
摘要报告单一巡天组合、加入 DESI DR2 BAO、再加入 primary CMB 后均得到对 ΛCDM 的弱偏离。
3×2pt 在低红移组合中显著提升约束力，但在已含 SN+DESI BAO+CMB 的组合中主要改善 figure of merit，对偏离显著性影响很小。
methods: 逐一剔除探针的系统检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 primary CMB 数据的具体选择和似然实现、DES 各探针之间的协方差与系统误差处理、3×2pt 与 BAO/SN/CMB 联合时的参数退化方向，以及报告的 ΛCDM 偏离显著性是否受先验、数据组合和张力处理影响。

papers.title: Unveiling the dark matter nature with reionization relics
papers.abstract: Dark matter constitutes roughly one-fourth of the Universe, yet its physical nature remains unknown. Warm dark matter (WDM), a class of dark matter candidates, has non-negligible velocity dispersion that suppresses the formation of small-scale cosmic structures. Current constraints therefore rely mainly on small-scale probes such as the Lyman-alpha (Ly$α$) forest and Milky Way observations of satellite galaxies and stellar streams. We propose a novel large-scale probe based on long-lived "reionization relics": because the thermal and dynamical evolution of the intergalactic medium depends on the local reionization redshift, patchy reionization imprints additional large-scale fluctuations in Ly$α$ forest opacity and post-reionization HI traced by 21 cm intensity mapping. The strength of these imprints depends on WDM through both small-scale gas evolution and WDM-driven changes in the reionization history. For example, the Ly$α$ (21 cm) power spectrum in 3 keV WDM differs from cold dark matter by ~19% (~19%) at $k=0.05\,{\rm Mpc^{-1}}$ at z=4 (z=5.5) when reionization relics are included. Using Ly$α$ forest with a covariance model designed to mimic the capabilities of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), we forecast a constraint of $m_{\rm WDM}>5.0\,{\rm keV}$ (95%), which improves to $m_{\rm WDM}>7.1\,{\rm keV}$ when combined with 21 cm intensity-mapping observations from the Square Kilometre Array (SKA). The next-generation surveys can further strengthen the current best lower bounds from 9.7 to 39 keV.

analysis.title_zh: 用再电离遗迹揭示暗物质的性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出利用长寿命“再电离遗迹”来约束温暗物质：斑块状再电离会在 Lyα 森林不透明度和后再电离 HI 的 21 cm 强度映射中留下大尺度涨落。摘要报告，在纳入这些遗迹后，3 keV 温暗物质相对冷暗物质可在特定红移和尺度上改变 Lyα 与 21 cm 功率谱，并用 DESI 类 Lyα 与 SKA 21 cm 预测得到更强的温暗物质质量下限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把暗物质微观性质、再电离历史和大尺度结构观测联系起来；虽然不是直接 CMB 分析，但再电离是 CMB 光学深度、kSZ 以及高红移结构形成解释中的核心环节，因此其模型假设会影响 CMB 与 Lyα/21 cm 联合宇宙学推断。
key_points: 提出用再电离遗迹作为温暗物质的大尺度探针。
斑块状再电离会影响 Lyα 森林不透明度和后再电离 HI 的 21 cm 强度映射。
摘要给出基于 DESI 类 Lyα 协方差模型与 SKA 21 cm 组合的温暗物质质量约束预测。
methods: DESI 能力模拟的协方差模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对再电离遗迹的建模假设、WDM 对再电离历史和小尺度气体演化的分解方式，以及 DESI/SKA 预测协方差是否包含关键系统误差和天体物理退化。

papers.title: Unifying Early and Late Dark Energy: Dynamical Requirements and Obstructions
papers.abstract: We investigate whether early- and late-time dark energy could arise from a single scalar field. Adopting a bottom-up perspective, we first identify the sequence of dynamical regimes that any unified scenario must traverse to account for both an early dark energy phase relevant for pre-recombination solutions of the Hubble tension and the late-time acceleration of the Universe. We derive the corresponding requirements on the scalar energy density and equation of state. We then adopt a complementary top-down perspective and translate these requirements into constraints on the phase-space structure of minimally coupled scalar fields with tracking-like dynamics. We show that satisfying all requirements necessitates a potential with three distinct slopes, arranged in a steep-steeper-shallow hierarchy. This conclusion remains unchanged in the presence of conformal couplings to dark matter. These results place strong constraints on attempts to construct unified models of early- and late-time dark energy. We discuss implications for model-building.

analysis.title_zh: 统一早期与晚期暗能量：动力学要求与障碍
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察早期暗能量与晚期暗能量是否可由同一个标量场产生，先从现象学角度列出统一模型必须经历的动力学阶段，再从标量场相空间结构反推势能要求。摘要报告，满足所有要求需要具有三个不同斜率、呈“陡-更陡-浅”层级的势能，即使加入与暗物质的共形耦合也不改变该结论。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 早期暗能量常被用作缓解 Hubble 张力的 CMB 前复合方案，晚期暗能量则控制低红移距离和增长历史；该文为把二者统一到单一场中的模型构建设置了动力学约束，有助于判断哪些扩展 ΛCDM 模型值得进入 CMB 与低红移数据拟合。
key_points: 研究单一标量场能否同时解释早期暗能量和晚期加速。
从动力学阶段需求和相空间结构两条路径推导限制。
摘要称所需势能必须具有三个不同斜率，且暗物质共形耦合不改变这一结论。
methods: 自下而上的动力学阶段分析
标量场能量密度与状态方程需求推导
极小耦合标量场的相空间结构分析
暗物质共形耦合情形讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“陡-更陡-浅”三斜率势能层级的推导是否依赖特定相空间假设，以及这些动力学条件对 CMB 前复合早期暗能量窗口的适用范围。

papers.title: Early- and Late-Time Modifications to $Λ$CDM: Implications for the Hubble Tension
papers.abstract: We investigate an extension of $Λ$CDM in which a fraction of cold Dark Matter (DM) decays into invisible dark radiation (DR) around the radiation-matter equality epoch, together with a non-standard dark energy (DE) equation of state characterized by $w_0$. The decaying DM component modifies the early expansion history and reduces the sound horizon at baryon drag, while the DE alters the expansion rate at the late times. A comprehensive analysis combining \texttt{Planck 2018+ACT DR6+DESI DR2+CMB lensing} datasets has been carried out to explore the viability of this framework in addressing the $H_0$ tension. This model yields a Hubble constant of $H_0 = 69.83 \pm 0.98~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, reducing the discrepancy with SH0ES measurement to ${\sim}2.2σ$ and local distance network measurement (H0DN) to ${\sim}2.9σ$. Further, considering \texttt{SH0ES} and \texttt{Pantheon+}, the inferred value of the Hubble constant becomes $H_0 = 70.20 \pm 0.66~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$. The Bayesian evidence suggests that this framework offers a fit to the relevant cosmological datasets at a statistically similar level as $Λ$CDM. It is observed that correlated early- and late-time modifications to the cosmological expansion history provide a more effective route to reducing the $H_0$ tension than either class of modification alone.

analysis.title_zh: 对 ΛCDM 的早期与晚期修正：对 Hubble 张力的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种扩展 ΛCDM：部分冷暗物质在辐射-物质相等时期附近衰变为不可见暗辐射，同时晚期暗能量由 w0 描述，从而同时改变早期声视界和晚期膨胀率。摘要报告，结合 Planck 2018、ACT DR6、DESI DR2 与 CMB lensing 等数据后，该模型给出较高的 H0 并降低与本地测量的张力，但贝叶斯证据显示其拟合水平与 ΛCDM 统计上相似。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇直接使用 CMB 温度/偏振相关数据、ACT 和 CMB 透镜，并通过改变早期膨胀史影响声视界，是 CMB 约束 H0 张力模型的核心问题；同时它检验早期暗部门物理与晚期暗能量组合是否比单独修改更有效。
key_points: 模型同时引入辐射-物质相等时期附近的部分冷暗物质衰变和非常规暗能量状态方程。
使用 Planck 2018、ACT DR6、DESI DR2、CMB lensing 等数据检验 Hubble 张力。
摘要称该框架可降低与 SH0ES 和 H0DN 的差异，但贝叶斯证据显示其总体拟合与 ΛCDM 统计上相近。
methods: 含暗辐射的衰变暗物质模型
以 w0 表征的暗能量状态方程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对参数先验、数据组合顺序、CMB lensing 与 BAO 对早期衰变暗物质的约束如何打破退化，以及贝叶斯证据“与 ΛCDM 相近”是否足以支持该扩展模型。

papers.title: Constraining the Potential Index $n$ of the Early Dark Energy Model Using Cosmic Birefringence from Planck and ACT
papers.abstract: Cosmic birefringence and the Hubble tension represent compelling challenges to the standard $Λ$CDM model. The early dark energy (EDE) model with potentials $V(φ) \propto [1-\cos(φ/f)]^n$ offer a unified framework to address both anomalies through energy injection near matter-radiation equality and parity-violating Chern--Simons coupling to photons. While previous studies have focused on $n=3$, the dependence of the birefringence signal on the potential index $n$ remains largely unexplored. We perform a comprehensive statistical analysis of axion-like EDE models with $n=2$, $n=3$, and $n=\infty$, using $EB$ cross-polarization data from Planck-$EB$ and ACT-$EB$. The $n=2$ model is severely disadvantaged, displaying extreme coupling values ($gM_{\rm pl} \approx 69.912$ for Planck, $-40.726$ for ACT), large $χ^2_{\rm min}$ (144.52 and 86.93), and $Δχ^2<1$ with many local minials. Conversely, $n=3$ achieves the best fits ($χ^2_{\rm min} = 65.70$ and $48.08$) with consistent couplings ($gM_{\rm pl} = -0.210 \pm 0.024$ and $-0.158 \pm 0.025$) that accurately reproduce observations across all angular scales. We checked that the $n=3$ configuration represents the optimal choice for simultaneously addressing the Hubble tension and cosmic birefringence within a theoretically viable framework.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 Planck 和 ACT 的宇宙双折射约束早期暗能量模型的势指数 n
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察轴子样早期暗能量模型中势函数指数 n 如何影响宇宙双折射信号，使用 Planck-EB 和 ACT-EB 数据比较 n=2、n=3 与 n=∞。摘要报告 n=2 拟合表现很差且耦合取值极端，而 n=3 在两个数据集上给出较低 χ²_min 和较一致的耦合参数，被作者认为是同时解释 Hubble tension 与宇宙双折射的优选情形。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙双折射直接涉及 CMB 偏振 EB/TB 相关和偏振角旋转，是检验宇宙学宇称破缺新物理的重要窗口；若与早期暗能量联系起来，还会影响声学尺度、H0 推断以及 ΛCDM 张力的解释。
key_points: 研究轴子样早期暗能量势指数 n 对宇宙双折射信号的影响。
使用 Planck-EB 与 ACT-EB 偏振交叉数据比较 n=2、n=3、n=∞。
摘要称 n=3 给出最佳拟合，并可同时处理 Hubble tension 与 cosmic birefringence。
methods: 轴子样早期暗能量模型 V(φ) ∝ [1-cos(φ/f)]^n
对 n=2、n=3、n=∞ 的统计分析
χ²_min、Δχ² 与耦合参数 gM_pl 拟合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 EB 数据的系统误差处理、偏振角校准与宇宙双折射信号的退化关系，以及 n=3“最优”结论是否依赖先验、局部极小值处理和 Planck/ACT 数据组合方式。

papers.title: Exploring the Dark Sector: Interacting Radiation in Light of Modern Cosmological Probes
papers.abstract: [abridged] We constrain a phenomenological dark radiation (DR) framework consisting of free-streaming and fluid-like components, providing a model-independent extension of the standard radiation sector. Using Planck CMB data, DESI DR2 BAO measurements, and Pantheon+ and DES Y5 (Dovekie) supernova samples, we derive constraints on additional relativistic degrees of freedom and assess their impact on cosmological tensions. We obtain $N_{\rm fld}<0.66$ (95% C.L.) from CMB data alone, while the combination with BAO yields $N_{\rm fs}=2.93\pm0.23$ and $N_{\rm fld}=0.36^{+0.16}_{-0.21}$ (68% C.L.), consistent with Standard Model expectations for free-streaming radiation. The DR framework significantly alleviates the Hubble tension through an enhanced early-time expansion rate, which reduces the sound horizon scale. The tension with SH0ES is reduced from highly significant in $Λ$CDM to statistically non-significant for CMB+BAO data according to the $\mathcal{T}$-statistic. Bayesian model comparison shows no decisive preference for DR over $Λ$CDM when SH0ES is excluded, with results in the regime of weakly disfavoured. However, including SH0ES data leads to decisive Bayesian evidence in favour of the DR scenario. Overall, DR provides a compelling framework for resolving the Hubble tension. When CMB, BAO, Pantheon$+$ and SH0ES data are considered, we find an increased effective radiation content, $N_{\rm tot}=3.63^{+0.13}_{-0.15}$, with a fraction of free-streaming radiation, $f_{\rm fs}=0.392\pm 0.026$, a reduced sound horizon scale, $r_d = 141.8^{+1.3}_{-1.2}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$, and a higher primordial helium fraction, $Y_{\rm He}=0.2530 \pm 0.0017$, which lies at the level of approximately $\sim 2$-$2.5σ$ above direct determinations from metal-poor H II regions, while remaining broadly consistent with other abundance measurements within current uncertainties.
papers.comment: To be submitted to JCAP, 34 pages, 14 figures

analysis.title_zh: 探索暗部门：现代宇宙学探针视野下的相互作用辐射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用含自由流和流体样成分的现象学暗辐射模型扩展标准辐射部门，并联合 Planck CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、超新星及 SH0ES 数据约束额外相对论自由度。摘要报告该框架可通过提高早期膨胀率、减小声视界来缓解 Hubble tension；但在不含 SH0ES 时贝叶斯比较并不决定性支持暗辐射，加入 SH0ES 后则显示对暗辐射情景的强支持。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 额外辐射成分会改变复合前膨胀史、CMB 声峰结构、阻尼尾和声视界标定，因此直接影响 CMB 推断的 H0、BAO 标尺以及 ΛCDM 张力判断，是 CMB 宇宙学中检验早期宇宙新物理的核心方向。
key_points: 构建含自由流与流体样成分的现象学暗辐射框架。
联合 Planck CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、Pantheon+、DES Y5 与 SH0ES 等数据评估 Hubble tension。
摘要称加入 SH0ES 时暗辐射模型获得决定性贝叶斯证据，但不含 SH0ES 时相对 ΛCDM 无决定性偏好。
methods: DES Y5 Dovekie 超新星样本
暗辐射自由流成分 N_fs 与流体样成分 N_fld 参数化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 N_fs、N_fld、N_tot、Y_He 与 r_d 的先验设定和 BBN/丰度约束处理，尤其要区分包含与不包含 SH0ES 时贝叶斯证据和张力缓解结论的稳健性。

papers.title: Towards precision cosmology with Void x CMB correlations (II): Impact of mock catalogs on the Void x CMB lensing signal
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing by large-scale structure imprints secondary anisotropies on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) that can be exploited to probe cosmology. In particular, cosmic voids produce a characteristic lensing signature detectable through Void x CMB cross-correlations. This signal has been robustly measured in the past but its cosmological constraining power remains limited by the incomplete knowledge of how methodological choices affect its measurement and by its uncertain dependence on cosmological parameters. Using a set of validated Roman mock catalogs, we first quantify how mock construction impacts the measured signal and then forecast the capabilities of Roman, in combination with current and upcoming CMB surveys such as Planck, SO and CMB-S4-like experiments. We analyze the signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) for different void definitions (2D and 3D), stacking approaches (rescaled versus non-rescaled profiles), CMB map filtering schemes and noise levels. In contrast to galaxy and void statistics, we find that the Void x CMB lensing signal is less sensitive to the choice of mock catalog, indicating that future tensions with data are unlikely to stem from mock inaccuracies alone. The highest S/N is achieved for 2D voids with rescaled profiles. We forecast S/N ~13$σ$ (8$σ$) for 2D (3D) Roman voids combined with Planck, increasing to 22$σ$ (13$σ$) for SO and 31$σ$ (18$σ$) for CMB-S4-like surveys. While the cosmological dependence of this observable remains to be quantified, Roman together with next-generation of LSS and CMB surveys opens a path toward the first direct cosmological constraints from Void x CMB lensing.

analysis.title_zh: 迈向利用空洞 × CMB 相关的精密宇宙学（二）：模拟星表对空洞 × CMB 透镜信号的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究大尺度空洞与 CMB 透镜信号的交叉相关，使用 Roman 模拟星表评估 mock 构造和测量选择对 Void x CMB lensing 的影响，并预测与 Planck、SO、CMB-S4-like 实验联合时的探测能力。摘要报告该信号对 mock catalog 选择相对不敏感，2D void 加 rescaled profiles 给出最高信噪比，未来 Roman 与下一代 CMB 巡天有望推动该观测量用于直接宇宙学约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜记录了沿视线大尺度结构的引力势信息，空洞与 CMB 透镜的交叉相关可作为连接低红移结构与早期宇宙背景的独立探针；它对未来 CMB-S4、SO 与 Roman 等巡天联合约束结构增长、几何和潜在张力具有方法学意义。
key_points: 研究 cosmic void 与 CMB 透镜的交叉相关信号。
使用 Roman 模拟星表评估 mock 构造、void 定义、stacking 和 CMB 滤波/噪声对信号的影响。
摘要预测 Roman 与 Planck、SO、CMB-S4-like 联合可获得较高信噪比，但宇宙学参数依赖仍待量化。
methods: 经验证的 Roman mock catalogs
Void x CMB lensing 交叉相关
Planck、SO、CMB-S4-like 噪声水平和巡天组合预测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 void finder/void 定义、profile rescaling、CMB lensing map filtering 与噪声建模如何影响 S/N 预测，并确认 mock catalog 对真实 Roman 选择函数和系统误差的代表性。

papers.title: The impact of evolving dark energy on the Weyl potential measured from the Dark Energy Survey Year 3 data
papers.abstract: Measurements from the Dark Energy Survey (DES) Year 3 data have shown that the Weyl potential -- the sum of the spatial and temporal distortions of the geometry -- evolves more slowly than predicted by General Relativity, assuming a $Λ$CDM background evolution. An evolving dark energy with a phantom crossing, as preferred by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), is expected to decrease the depth of the gravitational potentials through a stronger acceleration than in $Λ$CDM, potentially solving the tension with General Relativity. In this paper, we show that $w_0w_a$CDM models indeed reduce the tension with respect to $Λ$CDM, down to a level of $1.6-2.2σ$, depending on the treatment of CMB lensing. This reduction is not due to an increase in the Weyl potential's uncertainties, but truly to the impact of the evolving background on the theoretical predictions in General Relativity. More data are needed to robustly determine if evolving dark energy fully explains the low value of the Weyl potential at intermediate redshifts, or if modifications of gravity or interactions in the dark sector are needed, which could simultaneously stabilize the phantom crossing indicated by DESI.

analysis.title_zh: 演化暗能量对暗能量巡天第三年数据测得的 Weyl 势的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 DES Year 3 所测 Weyl 势偏低/演化偏慢的问题，检验带幻影跨越的 w0waCDM 演化暗能量背景能否缓解与广义相对论预言的张力。摘要报告称，相比 ΛCDM，w0waCDM 可将张力降至 1.6-2.2σ，且原因是背景演化改变了 GR 下的理论预言，而不是简单扩大了 Weyl 势误差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Weyl 势直接关系到弱引力透镜和 CMB 透镜所探测的时空扰动总和，因此它是连接低红移大尺度结构、CMB 透镜以及引力理论检验的关键量。若演化暗能量能解释 DES 中间红移 Weyl 势偏低，将影响我们如何解读 CMB lensing、低红移结构增长张力以及是否需要修改引力或暗扇区相互作用。
key_points: DES Year 3 数据显示 Weyl 势演化比 ΛCDM+广义相对论预期更慢。
w0waCDM 背景可将相对 ΛCDM 的张力降至 1.6-2.2σ，取决于 CMB 透镜处理。
摘要强调张力降低来自演化背景对 GR 理论预言的影响，而非误差增大。
methods: Dark Energy Survey Year 3 数据
Weyl potential 测量与广义相对论理论预言比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Weyl 势重构与 CMB 透镜处理的具体选择，以及张力从 ΛCDM 降到 1.6-2.2σ 是否对先验、数据组合和非线性建模稳健。

papers.title: Machine Learning Techniques for Astrophysics and Cosmology: Lyman-$α$ forest
papers.abstract: The Lyman-$α$ forest refers to the series of absorption features observed in the spectra of distant quasars that are produced by neutral hydrogen in the intergalactic medium. Observed over a wide range of redshifts with both ground- and space-based facilities, the Lyman-$α$ forest provides a powerful probe of numerous physical processes, including the thermal state of intergalactic gas, the timing and topology of cosmic reionization, the expansion history of the Universe, the growth of cosmic structure, massive neutrinos, and the nature of dark matter. This chapter reviews the transformative impact of machine-learning techniques on Lyman-$α$ forest analyses, particularly in overcoming the computational and methodological limitations of traditional approaches. We discuss a broad range of machine-learning applications, including the automated characterization of individual absorption systems, improved reconstruction of the intrinsic quasar continuum, accelerated emulation of hydrodynamical simulations, and the development of simulation-based analyses, field-level inference methods, and three-dimensional reconstruction techniques for the underlying matter density field. As current and upcoming surveys continue to increase both the volume and precision of Lyman-$α$ forest observations, ML-driven pipelines are becoming an essential component of next-generation astrophysical and cosmological analyses.
papers.comment: Invited chapter for the edited book "Machine Learning Techniques for Astrophysics and Cosmology" (Eds. Cosimo Bambi, Vinay Kashyap, Swarnim Shashank, Naoki Yoshida, Springer Singapore, expected in 2026). Submitted version

analysis.title_zh: 天体物理与宇宙学中的机器学习技术：Lyman-α 森林
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于机器学习在 Lyman-α forest 天体物理与宇宙学分析中应用的综述章节，覆盖吸收系统识别、类星体连续谱重建、流体模拟仿真器、基于模拟的分析、场级推断和三维密度场重建。摘要强调，随着 Lyman-α forest 数据规模和精度提升，机器学习管线正成为下一代分析的重要组成部分。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Lyman-α forest 可约束宇宙膨胀史、结构增长、再电离、暗物质性质和中微子质量，这些都与 CMB 推断的早期宇宙参数形成互补。对 CMB 研究者而言，机器学习改进 Lyman-α 分析可能影响小尺度物质功率谱、再电离历史和与 Planck/未来 CMB 数据联合约束的系统误差预算。
key_points: 综述 Lyman-α forest 在宇宙学和星系际介质研究中的作用。
重点讨论机器学习在连续谱重建、吸收系统识别、流体模拟仿真器和场级推断中的应用。
面向当前和未来大规模 Lyman-α forest 巡天的数据量与精度提升。
methods: 自动表征单个吸收系统
类星体本征连续谱重建
流体动力学模拟的加速仿真器
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应区分哪些机器学习应用已有实测数据验证，哪些仍主要依赖模拟；还应核对连续谱重建和模拟仿真器误差如何传播到宇宙学参数。

papers.title: Signatures of Modified Gravity on Linear Scales in a Dynamical Dark Energy Background
papers.abstract: Cosmological data from the cosmic microwave background (CMB), baryon acoustic oscillations, and Type Ia supernovae suggest that the component driving the accelerated expansion of the Universe may be dynamical at the $\sim 2.5$-$3σ$ CL. The best-fit CPL model produces a level of cosmic structure similar to that of $Λ$CDM, with both models exhibiting mild tension with redshift-space distortion data. In this {\it Letter}, we parametrize possible departures of the effective gravitational coupling from Newton's constant in the late Universe, below a comoving scale $λ_c$, using two redshift bins, $0 \leq z < 1$ and $1 \leq z \leq 3$. We then determine the optimal values of $λ_c$ and the amplitude of these deviations from General Relativity, assuming a background with dynamical dark energy in CPL form. We find that, in order to achieve the required suppression of structure growth at low redshifts while remaining consistent with CMB constraints -- primarily from the late-time ISW effect at low $\ell$ and lensing at high $\ell$ -- we must require modified gravity effects to have a characteristic scale of $λ_c \lesssim 150\,\mathrm{Mpc}$ (95\% CL). This places the relevant scales squarely within the range probed by galaxy surveys. The best-fit value is $λ_c \simeq 40\,\mathrm{Mpc}$, well below the 95\% CL upper limit. Using Planck PR4, DESI DR2, Pantheon+ (or DES-Dovekie) and redshift-space distortions data we confirm that a CPL background with standard gravity is moderately preferred over $Λ$CDM; this preference strengthens to a mildly strong level when modified gravity effects are included. This enhancement leaves the CPL parameters largely unchanged, but shifts them slightly further into the quintom region.

analysis.title_zh: 动力学暗能量背景中线性尺度上的修改引力信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 CPL 动力学暗能量背景下，用两个红移区间和特征共动尺度 λc 参数化晚期有效引力耦合相对牛顿常数的偏离，以解释低红移结构增长抑制并保持与 CMB 约束一致。摘要报告称，结合 Planck PR4、DESI DR2、Pantheon+ 或 DES-Dovekie 以及 RSD 数据，修改引力效应需位于 λc≲150 Mpc 的尺度内，最佳拟合约为 40 Mpc，并使 CPL 相对 ΛCDM 的偏好增强。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接把动力学暗能量、结构增长张力和 CMB 约束联系起来，尤其强调低多极晚期 ISW 与高多极 CMB 透镜对修改引力尺度的限制。对 CMB 宇宙学而言，它提示仅用背景几何数据支持 CPL 还不够，必须同时检查 CMB 各向异性和透镜对晚期引力修改的响应。
key_points: 论文在 CPL 动力学暗能量背景中参数化晚期有效引力耦合偏离。
CMB 约束主要来自低 ℓ 晚期 ISW 效应和高 ℓ 透镜。
摘要报告修改引力特征尺度需 λc ≲ 150 Mpc，最佳拟合约 40 Mpc。
methods: CPL 动力学暗能量背景
晚期有效引力耦合偏离的参数化
特征共动尺度 λc 的优化
CMB 低 ℓ ISW 与高 ℓ lensing 约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对修改引力参数化的物理含义、λc 上限如何由 CMB ISW/透镜和 RSD 共同驱动，以及“mildly strong”偏好对应的统计准则与先验依赖。

papers.title: Blue-tilted Runnings and the JWST Early Galaxy Tension
papers.abstract: The recent James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations reported the unexpectedly large abundance of massive galaxies with stellar masses of $\sim 10^{10}~M_{\odot}$ at high redshifts $z \simeq 6.5 - 9$ compared with the prediction of the standard $Λ$CDM model. As a possible solution to the tension, we consider a blue-tilted spectrum of density perturbations with a positive running. We find that, for $α_s \simeq 0.02$ and $β_s \simeq 0.02$, a joint analysis with CMB observations shows that the tension can be resolved at the 1$σ$ confidence level. Such a blue-tilted spectrum is also plausible from the perspective of primordial black hole formation on much smaller scales in the early Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 蓝倾 running 与 JWST 早期星系张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 JWST 在 z≈6.5-9 发现的约 10^10 M_⊙ 大质量星系丰度偏高问题，提出带正 running 的蓝倾密度扰动谱作为可能解释。摘要报告称，当 α_s≈0.02、β_s≈0.02 时，与 CMB 观测的联合分析可使该张力在 1σ 置信水平内得到缓解，并指出这种谱形也与更小尺度原初黑洞形成的设想有关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接触及原初扰动谱从 CMB 尺度外推到星系形成尺度的问题；若需要较大的正 running 来解释 JWST 早期星系，将反过来检验 CMB 对标量谱指数及其 running 的约束，并影响小尺度功率谱、结构形成和原初黑洞情景。
key_points: 针对 JWST 高红移大质量星系丰度与标准 ΛCDM 预言之间的张力。
提出带正 running 的蓝倾密度扰动谱，并与 CMB 观测联合分析。
摘要称在 α_s≈0.02、β_s≈0.02 时，张力可在 1σ 置信水平内得到解决。
methods: JWST 高红移星系丰度观测
带正 running 的蓝倾密度扰动谱
与原初黑洞形成相关的小尺度谱讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对蓝倾 running 参数与 CMB 标量谱约束、谱畸变或小尺度结构约束是否相容，以及“1σ 解决张力”的统计定义和 JWST 星系质量函数建模假设。

papers.title: Negative neutrino mass or negative dark energy?
papers.abstract: Recent cosmological analyses based on DESI and CMB data have revealed a tension between the inferred sum of neutrino masses and the minimum value allowed by neutrino oscillation experiments, when assuming an underlying $Λ$CDM model of cosmology. In this work, we perform a systematic exploration of alternative dark energy models, including models that can supply a negative dark energy density capable of reproducing the cosmological effects of negative effective neutrino masses. We argue that dark energy models can alleviate the tension by modifying the cosmic expansion rate over a specific redshift range relevant for CMB lensing, while matching BAO distance measurements from DESI at lower redshifts. Among the models considered, we find that a sign-switching cosmological constant model, $Λ_\mathrm{s}$CDM, is uniquely capable of recovering positive neutrino masses by modifying the expansion history in this way. For the combination of DESI DR2 BAO, CMB, and DES-Dovekie supernova data, the constraint on the effective neutrino mass shifts from $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}=-0.075^{+0.039}_{-0.053}$ eV (68%) for $Λ$CDM to $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}=0.055\pm0.050$ eV (68%) for $Λ_\mathrm{s}$CDM, with a 95% lower bound on the dark energy transition redshift, $z_\dagger>2.4$. Although $Λ_\mathrm{s}$CDM does not have the strongest overall statistical support among the models considered, when the $\sum m_{ν,\mathrm{eff}}$ parameter is allowed to vary, our findings point toward a specific sign- and redshift-structured contribution to the late-time expansion history as a viable way to alleviate the neutrino mass tension.

analysis.title_zh: 负中微子质量，还是负暗能量？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 DESI 和 CMB 数据在 ΛCDM 假设下给出的中微子质量和振荡实验下限之间的张力，系统考察替代暗能量模型能否通过改变特定红移范围内的宇宙膨胀来模拟负有效中微子质量效应。摘要报告称，符号切换宇宙学常数模型 Λ_sCDM 能将 DESI DR2 BAO+CMB+DES-Dovekie 超新星组合下的有效中微子质量约束从负值移至正值，并给出暗能量转变红移的下限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜对物质聚集和几何距离敏感，中微子质量约束又与晚期膨胀史存在退化；该论文把 DESI BAO、CMB 和超新星数据中的中微子质量张力重新解释为暗能量红移结构问题，对用 CMB lensing 推断中微子质量和暗能量性质具有直接相关性。
key_points: 研究 DESI 与 CMB 联合分析中有效中微子质量偏负的问题。
系统考察替代暗能量模型，特别是可产生负暗能量密度效应的模型。
摘要称符号切换宇宙学常数 Λ_sCDM 可将有效中微子质量约束移至正值。
methods: 替代暗能量模型系统探索
Λ_sCDM 符号切换宇宙学常数模型
CMB lensing 相关红移范围的膨胀史修改
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对负有效中微子质量与负暗能量效应之间的参数退化如何建立、Λ_sCDM 的转变红移先验和稳定性假设，以及模型比较中为何其总体统计支持并非最强但仍被强调。

papers.title: Probing late-time deviations from $Λ$CDM with a quadratic dark energy expansion
papers.abstract: We investigate the observational viability of a quadratic dark energy expansion (QDEE) model as a phenomenological extension of the standard $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$ cosmological framework. This approach introduces the additional degrees of freedom that permit mild late-time deviations from a constant dark-energy component while preserving the standard early-Universe behavior. We constrain the model using a comprehensive combination of cosmological datasets, including Planck 2018 cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements, Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) Data Release 6 (DR6) and South Pole Telescope (SPT-3G) data, Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Data Release 2 (DR2), and the Pantheon Plus type Ia supernova compilation. Our results show that the QDEE framework shifts the inferred Hubble constant toward higher values relative to $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$, partially alleviating the tension with local measurements while remaining consistent with early-Universe constraints. Bayesian model comparison indicates strong evidence in favor of this framework over standard $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$ across multiple dataset combinations. Posterior predictive checks further demonstrate that the model yields predictions consistent with the observed data within statistical uncertainties.

analysis.title_zh: 用二次暗能量展开探测晚期对 ΛCDM 的偏离
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究二次暗能量展开 QDEE 作为 ΛCDM 的现象学扩展，在保持早期宇宙行为不变的同时允许晚期暗能量偏离常数。作者用 Planck、ACT、SPT-3G、DESI DR2 和 Pantheon Plus 等数据约束模型，摘要称 QDEE 会把推断的 Hubble 常数推向更高值、部分缓解与本地测量的张力，并在多个数据组合中相对 ΛCDM 获得强贝叶斯证据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类晚期暗能量参数化直接影响从 CMB 声学尺度推断 H0 的过程，也会与 CMB 透镜、BAO 距离和超新星距离梯度共同约束晚期膨胀史；因此它与 H0 张力和 CMB 推断参数的模型依赖性密切相关。
key_points: 提出二次暗能量展开作为 ΛCDM 的现象学扩展。
模型保持早期宇宙行为标准，同时允许晚期暗能量轻微偏离常数。
摘要称该模型把 H0 推向较高值，并在多个数据组合中相对 ΛCDM 获得强贝叶斯证据。
methods: Pantheon Plus Ia 型超新星汇编
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 QDEE 参数化的物理含义和先验依赖、强贝叶斯证据来自哪些数据组合，以及提高 H0 的同时是否改变 CMB 声学尺度、透镜幅度或与 BAO/超新星的一致性。

papers.title: Interacting Dark Sector field theory with phantom crossing
papers.abstract: Recent results from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) provide evidence for a dynamical dark-energy component, whose equation of state appears to have recently crossed the phantom divide. In this Letter, we present an interacting dark-energy model, grounded in field theory, that naturally accommodates such a double crossing. In our framework, fermionic dark matter is coupled via a Yukawa interaction to a tachyonic scalar field governed by Born-Infeld dynamics. The phantom crossing arises at the level of the effective dark-energy equation of state, while the underlying scalar-field dynamics remains nonphantom and well bounded. We confront our model with data including BAO from the DESI (DR2) survey, CMB distance priors from Planck 2018, and the latest Type Ia supernovae compilations, obtaining robust constraints across the different data combinations and reconstructing a recent double crossing of the phantom divide. Furthermore, under naturalness assumptions, the model expects an ultralight fermionic dark matter mass of order $1.9\times10^{-3}\,\mathrm{eV}$, suggesting a possible connection with new light particles in the dark sector and motivating future tests with cosmological perturbations.

analysis.title_zh: 具有幻影线穿越的相互作用暗区场论
analysis.summary_zh: 论文针对 DESI 暗能量结果提示的近期幻影线穿越，提出一个费米子暗物质与 Born-Infeld 快子标量场 Yukawa 耦合的相互作用暗区模型。摘要称该模型在底层标量场非幻影且有界的情况下，使有效暗能量状态方程出现近期双重穿越，并用 DESI DR2 BAO、Planck 2018 CMB 距离先验和 Ia 型超新星数据得到约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接使用 Planck 2018 CMB 距离先验与低红移 BAO、超新星联合约束暗能量动力学，因此与 CMB 在背景宇宙学参数约束中的作用相关。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于它是否只改变晚期膨胀史，还是会在扰动层面影响 CMB 透镜、ISW 效应或结构增长；摘要也明确指出未来需用宇宙学扰动检验。
key_points: 提出一个有场论基础的相互作用暗能量模型。
有效暗能量状态方程可发生近期双重幻影线穿越。
使用 DESI DR2 BAO、Planck 2018 CMB 距离先验和 Ia 型超新星数据给出约束。
methods: 费米子暗物质与 Born-Infeld 动力学的快子标量场通过 Yukawa 相互作用耦合
最新 Ia 型超新星汇编
不同数据组合的参数约束与幻影线穿越重构
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对所谓“稳健约束”和“双重穿越”对数据组合、CMB 距离先验而非完整 CMB 似然、以及暗区相互作用参数化的依赖；还应检查超轻费米子质量估计中“自然性假设”的具体内容。

papers.title: Probing String-Theory-Inspired Topologies of the Early Universe through CMB Temperature and Polarization Anisotropies
papers.abstract: TeV string-mass-scale strings have been excluded experimentally at colliders, as their effects have not been observed at the Large Hadron Collider (CERN). On the other hand, higher-scale string theory, with mass scales typically close to the Planck scale, is often regarded as experimentally inaccessible due to the enormous energies required for direct tests, and far beyond the reach of present or foreseeable particle accelerators. Nevertheless, the early Universe may provide an indirect observational window for high-string scale through imprints left on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB). In this work, building on previous studies, we reexamine temperature and polarization angular correlations as probes of the geometry and topology of the pre-inflationary Universe. We focus in particular on two-point correlation functions at large angular scales, where signatures of nontrivial spatial topology may survive as relics of primordial physics. We investigate the observational consequences of toroidal compactification and analyze their impact on the primordial power spectrum of the CMB provided by the Planck satellite. Within the current experimental and theoretical uncertainties, we identify a possible indication closely related to spatial-parity breaking, consistent with the presence of six spatial extra dimensions in the early Universe, compactified at the GUT epoch before the start of inflation. Finally, we extend our framework to B-mode polarization, highlighting its potential as a sensitive probe in forthcoming ground-based and space-borne experiments with unprecedented precision.

analysis.title_zh: 通过 CMB 温度和偏振各向异性探测受弦理论启发的早期宇宙拓扑
analysis.summary_zh: 论文重新考察暴胀前宇宙几何与拓扑是否可通过 CMB 温度和偏振角相关函数探测，特别关注大角尺度二点相关函数和环面紧致化对 Planck CMB 原初功率谱的影响。摘要称在当前实验和理论不确定性内，发现一个与空间宇称破缺密切相关、且可与 GUT 时代紧致化的六个额外空间维相一致的可能迹象，并将框架扩展到 B 模偏振。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是三篇中最直接面向 CMB 的工作：它把 CMB 大角尺度温度、偏振相关和未来 B 模观测作为检验早期宇宙拓扑及高能理论的窗口。若相关信号稳健，将影响对低多极异常、宇称性质、原初功率谱和暴胀前物理的解释。
key_points: 研究早期宇宙非平凡空间拓扑在 CMB 温度和偏振中的印记。
重点分析大角尺度二点相关函数和 Planck CMB 原初功率谱。
摘要称存在与空间宇称破缺相关、可与六个额外空间维紧致化相一致的可能迹象。
methods: CMB 温度和偏振角相关分析
大角尺度二点相关函数
Planck 卫星提供的 CMB 原初功率谱
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对“大角尺度相关函数中的可能迹象”如何定量定义、是否考虑 look-elsewhere 效应和宇宙方差，以及从环面紧致化到“六个额外空间维”和空间宇称破缺的推断链条是否唯一。

papers.title: Inflaton Accretion onto Primordial Black Holes During Reheating
papers.abstract: Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) forming prior to Big Bang Nucleosynthesis evolve during the reheating epoch, an environment dominated by an oscillating inflaton field decaying into a relativistic thermal bath. In this work, we track the complete lifecycle of PBHs within this coupled inflaton-radiation background. Utilizing $α$-attractor E-models, we analytically anchor the reheating initial conditions directly to Cosmic Microwave Background observations. By matching exact scalar field solutions in a Schwarzschild spacetime to the cosmological far-zone, we derive the cycle-averaged mass accretion rate and couple it to the growing radiation bath. We find that this combined accretion induces a highly non-linear enhancement of the final PBH mass. Because the Hawking evaporation timescale scales cubically with mass, PBHs forming near their critical runaway limits experience a massive extension of their lifespans. Surviving deeper into the radiation-dominated era triggers a multi-order-of-magnitude amplification in their emitted Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background (SGWB).

analysis.title_zh: 再加热期间暴胀子向原初黑洞的吸积
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究大爆炸核合成之前形成的原初黑洞在再加热时期的完整演化，其中背景由振荡 inflaton 场及其衰变产生的辐射浴共同组成。摘要称作者用 α-attractor E-models 将再加热初始条件与 CMB 观测相连，并通过标量场解匹配推导吸积率，发现 inflaton 与辐射吸积可显著增强 PBH 终质量、延长寿命并放大其随机引力波背景。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系主要在于用 CMB 观测约束暴胀模型并锚定再加热初始条件，而非直接分析 CMB 各向异性。它对宇宙学读者的重要性在于，若再加热时期吸积显著改变 PBH 质量和寿命，将影响 PBH 暗物质、早期宇宙热史以及伴随随机引力波背景的预测。
key_points: 研究再加热时期原初黑洞在 inflaton-辐射背景中的演化。
用 CMB 观测锚定 α-attractor E-model 的再加热初始条件。
摘要称吸积可非线性增强 PBH 终质量，并放大其随机引力波背景。
methods: 由 CMB 观测锚定再加热初始条件
Schwarzschild 时空中的精确标量场解与宇宙学远区匹配
周期平均质量吸积率推导
耦合 inflaton-辐射背景中的 PBH 生命周期追踪
Hawking 蒸发寿命与随机引力波背景估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对从 CMB 约束到再加热初始条件的映射是否依赖特定 α-attractor 参数选择，以及 Schwarzschild 近区匹配、周期平均吸积率和临界 runaway 极限是否在相关 PBH 质量范围内自洽。

papers.title: CMB lensing imprints of cosmic voids in DESI Legacy Survey DR9 LRGs with photometric redshift calibration
papers.abstract: The lensing imprint of cosmic voids in the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) provides a powerful test of the $Λ$CDM model. However, recent studies report a "lensing-is-low" tension between observations and mock predictions. To investigate this, we measure the stacked CMB lensing signal of 3D cosmic voids identified in the DESI Legacy Survey DR9 Luminous Red Galaxy (LRG) sample, cross-correlated with the Planck 2018 lensing map. We compare our observations to $Λ$CDM templates derived from Buzzard mocks, critically calibrated using over one million DESI spectra to perfectly match the sparseness and photometric redshift error distributions of the observed data. By categorizing voids based on their gravitational potential, we disentangle the signals of void-in-voids and void-in-clouds, achieving two independent record detection significances of $\sim 17σ$. We find full agreement between observations and simulated $Λ$CDM templates across all void populations and redshift bins ($0.35\! <\! z\! <\! 0.95$), measuring an amplitude parameter $A_κ= 1.016 \pm 0.054$ for the full sample. This highlights the necessity of accurate systematic control, effectively resolving the reported lensing tension within this dataset. This proceeding summarizes the results presented in Sartori et al. (2025).
papers.comment: Contribution to the 2026 Cosmology session of the 60th Rencontres de Moriond, 4 pages, 2 figures

analysis.title_zh: 采用光度红移校准的DESI Legacy Survey DR9 LRG中宇宙空洞的CMB透镜印记
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究DESI Legacy Survey DR9 LRG三维宇宙空洞在CMB透镜图中的叠加印记，并与经过DESI光谱校准的Buzzard ΛCDM mock模板比较。摘要报告，在0.35<z<0.95的不同空洞族群和红移bin中观测与ΛCDM模板一致，全样本振幅为A_κ=1.016±0.054，并认为该数据集中的先前透镜偏低张力可由系统误差控制解决。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙空洞的CMB透镜信号直接检验大尺度低密度结构对CMB光子的引力偏折，是ΛCDM结构形成预测的非平凡测试。若“lensing-is-low”张力来自空洞识别、光度红移或mock匹配问题，它会影响用CMB透镜与星系巡天交叉相关做精密宇宙学的可靠性。
key_points: 在DESI Legacy Survey DR9 LRG三维空洞上叠加测量Planck 2018 CMB透镜信号。
用经DESI光谱校准的Buzzard mock构建ΛCDM模板，匹配稀疏性和光度红移误差分布。
摘要称观测与模拟模板在各空洞族群和红移bin中一致，并给出全样本透镜振幅A_κ=1.016±0.054。
methods: DESI Legacy Survey DR9 LRG样本中的三维宇宙空洞
Planck 2018 CMB lensing map互相关/叠加透镜信号
超过一百万DESI光谱用于光度红移校准
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对光度红移误差与样本稀疏性如何用DESI光谱校准到mock中，以及这种校准是否足以解释先前“lensing-is-low”张力；还要检查空洞按引力势分类和振幅A_κ拟合的协方差处理。

papers.title: Prospect of Measuring the Cosmic Dipole by Associating Strongly Lensed Gravitational Waves with Galaxy Surveys
papers.abstract: The cosmic dipole observed in the cosmic microwave background (CMB) is traditionally interpreted as being caused by the observer's motion relative to the background. However, tensions with dipole measurements from radio galaxy counts motivate the need for independent probes. This work investigates the feasibility of using strongly lensed gravitational wave (GW) events to measure the cosmic dipole. Strongly lensed GWs produce multiple time-delayed images, which can be used to infer the distances to both the lens and the source. These distances, associated with the observed redshifts of the lens and the source from galaxy catalogues, encode information about the background cosmology and cosmic dipole effects. By reconstructing a statistical sample of doubly lensed GW events based on the singular isothermal sphere lens model, the cosmic dipole can be estimated jointly with background cosmological parameters. Using realistic simulations for Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer, we forecast that a dipole magnitude $g$ consistent with both the CMB and number count measurement could be detected with 10 years of observation. Furthermore, constraints on $g$ are greatly improved by combining constraints from doubly lensed events with those from triply or quadruply lensed events. In the most optimistic scenario, where we measure the number count dipole magnitude with 10 years of observation, we obtain $g = (2.45^{+1.53}_{-1.28}) \times 10^{-3}$ from the combined constraint, provided that systematic uncertainties are mitigated. Although challenging, strongly lensed GWs offer a novel approach to measuring the cosmic dipole, providing an independent consistency test with different systematics from electromagnetic probes.

analysis.title_zh: 通过将强透镜引力波与星系巡天关联来测量宇宙偶极的前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨能否用强透镜引力波事件测量宇宙偶极，以提供独立于CMB和射电星系数目计数的检验。摘要称，基于SIS透镜模型和Einstein Telescope/Cosmic Explorer的现实模拟，10年观测中双像事件并结合三像或四像事件可改进偶极幅度约束，最乐观情形得到g=(2.45^{+1.53}_{-1.28})×10^{-3}，前提是系统误差得到控制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB偶极通常被解释为观测者相对CMB参考系的运动，但与射电星系数目计数偶极之间的张力促使寻找独立探针。强透镜引力波的系统误差与电磁巡天不同，若可行，可为CMB偶极的运动学解释和大尺度各向同性假设提供交叉检验。
key_points: 提出用强透镜引力波事件与星系红移巡天关联来测量宇宙偶极。
基于SIS透镜模型重建双像强透镜GW统计样本，并与背景宇宙学参数联合估计偶极。
摘要称第三代引力波探测器10年模拟观测有望给出与CMB和数目计数测量相容的偶极约束，但依赖系统误差缓解。
methods: 强透镜引力波多重延迟像
星系目录中的透镜和源红移
双像、三像或四像强透镜事件联合约束
Einstein Telescope与Cosmic Explorer的现实模拟/预报
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对强透镜GW距离反演如何与星系目录红移配对、SIS模型假设对偶极估计的偏差，以及系统误差被“mitigated”时具体包含哪些条件。

papers.title: First detection of the moving lens effect with ACT and DESI LS
papers.abstract: The moving lens effect is a secondary CMB anisotropy induced by the transverse motion of gravitational potentials. We develop a Fourier-space cross-spectrum estimator that retains the scale dependence of the signal, and apply it to the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) DR6 CMB temperature maps and luminous red galaxies from the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys. Using the foreground-reduced ACT NILC map, we find strong evidence for a non-zero amplitude of the cross-correlation $b_{\rm ML} = 1.24 \pm 0.26$ ($4.8σ$) for the extended sample and $0.93 \pm 0.25$ ($3.7σ$) for the main sample, both consistent with the halo-model prediction for the moving lens signal. Our Fourier-based pipeline enforces separation of scales between the reconstructed velocities and the cross-correlation, which we show is essential for foreground mitigation. The residual foreground contamination is expected to be significantly smaller than the signal from both simulations and the multi-frequency analysis presented in this paper. No curl-mode test exceeds $2σ$, and the results are robust across analysis variants. They constitute the first detection of the moving lens effect and unlock access to transverse velocities, a new cosmological probe. When combined with the kinematic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect, this provides a path toward mapping the three-dimensional velocity field of the Universe, opening a new avenue for probing the growth of structure and gravity on large scales.
papers.comment: 20+7 pages, 6 figures, 1 exciting discovery, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 使用ACT和DESI LS首次探测到运动透镜效应
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由引力势横向运动诱导的CMB次级各向异性moving lens effect，并用新的傅里叶空间互功率谱估计量分析ACT DR6温度图与DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys LRG。摘要报告，在前景降低的ACT NILC图中扩展样本和主样本分别得到b_ML=1.24±0.26与0.93±0.25的非零互相关证据，结果与halo model预测一致，并声称构成首次探测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 运动透镜效应是CMB次级各向异性的一种，直接关联大尺度结构的横向速度场；这补充了传统CMB透镜主要测量投影质量分布的能力。若与运动学Sunyaev-Zel'dovich效应结合，它可能帮助重建三维速度场，从而检验结构增长和大尺度引力理论。
key_points: 摘要称利用ACT DR6 CMB温度图和DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys LRG首次探测到moving lens effect。
开发保持尺度依赖的傅里叶空间互功率谱估计量，并强调速度重建与互相关的尺度分离。
使用ACT NILC前景降低图得到非零互相关振幅证据，且与halo-model预测一致。
methods: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys luminous red galaxies
curl-mode检验和分析变体稳健性测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对前景残留评估：尺度分离如何实施、NILC图和多频分析是否排除了tSZ/CIB/尘埃等污染，以及curl-mode和不同分析变体对4.8σ与3.7σ结果的约束力。

papers.title: Recoupled Dark Radiation reconciling CMB and DESI BAO measurements
papers.abstract: Recent DESI BAO measurements, combined with CMB data, reveal a tension within the $Λ$CDM model that leads to a discrepancy between cosmological and laboratory bounds on the summed neutrino mass. We show that a recoupled interacting radiation component can alleviate this cosmological tension, as well as the one with neutrino oscillation experiments. Sterile neutrinos interacting through a light pseudoscalar mediator provide a concrete realization of this scenario. The resulting interacting fluid modifies the CMB phenomenology, lowers the preferred matter density, and improves the consistency between CMB and DESI BAO measurements. Combining CMB with DESI DR2 BAO measurements, we find a $2.7 σ$ preference for a nonzero interacting sterile neutrino component, $\nsp=0.253 \pm 0.094$, corresponding to an improvement $Δχ^2=-8.98$ relative to $Λ$CDM. The model also reduces the tension with the SH0ES determination of the Hubble constant to the $2.4σ$ level.
papers.comment: 4+5 pages, 8 figures, comments are most welcome

analysis.title_zh: 复耦合暗辐射调和 CMB 与 DESI BAO 测量
analysis.summary_zh: 该文讨论 DESI BAO 与 CMB 联合后在 ΛCDM 中出现的张力，以及由此引出的宇宙学与实验室中微子质量限制不一致问题。作者提出复耦合的相互作用辐射成分，并以轻赝标量媒介相互作用的惰性中微子为实现；摘要报告该模型降低偏好的物质密度、改善 CMB 与 DESI BAO 一致性，并在 CMB+DESI DR2 BAO 中给出非零相互作用惰性中微子成分的 2.7σ 偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接针对 CMB 与低红移 BAO 联合约束中的 ΛCDM 张力，并引入会改变 CMB 现象学的相互作用辐射流体。若摘要所述结果稳健，它会影响 CMB 对物质密度、中微子质量和暗辐射自由度的解释，也会改变 CMB 与 DESI、SH0ES 等外部数据的联合分析框架。
key_points: 提出复耦合相互作用辐射以缓解 CMB 与 DESI BAO 在 ΛCDM 下的张力。
以轻赝标量媒介相互作用的惰性中微子作为具体实现。
摘要报告 CMB+DESI DR2 BAO 对非零相互作用惰性中微子成分有 2.7σ 偏好。
methods: 复耦合相互作用辐射模型
轻赝标量媒介的相互作用惰性中微子模型
与 ΛCDM 的 χ² 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对相互作用流体如何改变 CMB 峰结构与阻尼尾、参数退化如何影响 Σmν 与 Ωm 推断，以及 2.7σ 偏好和 Δχ² 改善是否对数据组合、先验和 BAO 处理稳健。

papers.title: Faster CMB lensing with control variates
papers.abstract: We present a new method for fast computation of the realization-dependent bias, a major computational bottleneck in measurements of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) lensing power spectrum. The method accelerates the bias calculation by differencing two correlated estimates: one based on fully realistic masked simulations and the other on isotropic simulations, for which the bias is analytically tractable. We show that our algorithm reduces the total computational cost of a lensing power spectrum measurement by approximately a factor of five for Atacama Cosmology Telescope- or Simons Observatory-like noise levels, or by a factor of three if current anisotropic filtering methods are left unchanged. Owing to its simplicity, the method can be readily implemented in existing CMB lensing analysis pipelines.

analysis.title_zh: 利用控制变量加速 CMB 透镜分析
analysis.summary_zh: 该文提出一种用于快速计算 CMB 透镜功率谱测量中 realization-dependent bias 的方法，因为该偏差计算是主要计算瓶颈。作者通过对两个相关估计量作差来加速计算：一个来自全真实遮罩模拟，另一个来自偏差可解析处理的各向同性模拟；摘要报告该算法可显著降低 ACT 或 Simons Observatory 类分析的总计算成本，并易于并入现有管线。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜功率谱是约束物质聚集、Σmν、暗能量和结构增长的重要观测量，而未来和当前实验的误差预算越来越依赖大量模拟与精确偏差扣除。若该控制变量方法在真实管线中可靠，它能降低 CMB 透镜分析的计算成本，使更精细的系统误差检验和更多数据组合成为可能。
key_points: 目标是加速 CMB 透镜功率谱测量中的 realization-dependent bias 计算。
方法使用控制变量思想，对全真实遮罩模拟估计与各向同性模拟估计作差。
摘要称在 ACT 或 Simons Observatory 类噪声水平下总计算成本可约降为原来的五分之一。
methods: 解析可处理的偏差估计
ACT 或 Simons Observatory 类噪声水平的评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对控制变量估计是否无偏、方差降低来自哪些相关性假设，以及在真实遮罩、各向异性噪声和现有各向异性滤波流程中计算节省是否仍成立。

papers.title: Coupled quintessence with a potential from supergravity exhibits sign-changing interaction
papers.abstract: Quintessence with a potential motivated by supergravity (SUGRA) exhibits several intriguing features. Depending on its initial conditions, it can behave either as dynamical dark energy or effectively as a cosmological constant. Moreover, when quintessence is coupled to dark matter, the effective dark-energy equation of state can cross the phantom divide. In this paper, we test both coupled and uncoupled SUGRA quintessence models using DESI BAO, DES-Dovekie SNIa, and Planck CMB data. We find that current observations strongly favor a coupling between dark energy and dark matter, with the coupling parameter deviating from zero at more than $4σ$. The data also favor the branch of coupled SUGRA quintessence in which the energy transfer between the two dark sectors changes sign, leading to a crossing of the phantom divide by the effective dark-energy equation of state. Interestingly, this coupled SUGRA branch is statistically indistinguishable from dark energy described by the CPL parametrization, with only a very small difference in $χ^2_\mathrm{min}$. Our results suggest that coupled quintessence with a SUGRA potential provides a field-theoretic realization of the evolving dark energy behavior favored by the latest observations.

analysis.title_zh: 具有超引力势的耦合精质呈现变号相互作用
analysis.summary_zh: 该文检验由超引力动机给出的 SUGRA 势精质模型，比较暗能量与暗物质耦合和不耦合情形，并使用 DESI BAO、DES-Dovekie SNIa 与 Planck CMB 数据约束。摘要报告当前观测强烈偏好暗扇区耦合，且偏好能量转移变号、有效暗能量状态方程跨越 phantom divide 的耦合 SUGRA 分支，该分支与 CPL 参数化在统计上难以区分。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把 Planck CMB 与 BAO、Ia 型超新星联合用于检验演化暗能量和暗扇区相互作用。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于这类耦合会改变背景演化和扰动增长，从而影响 CMB 距离尺度、ISW 效应以及与低红移距离探针联合时对 ΛCDM 或 CPL 的解释。
key_points: 研究带 SUGRA 势的精质暗能量，包含与暗物质耦合和不耦合两类模型。
使用 DESI BAO、DES-Dovekie SNIa 与 Planck CMB 数据进行检验。
摘要称当前数据强烈偏好暗能量-暗物质耦合，并偏好能量转移变号的分支。
methods: 耦合与非耦合精质模型比较
与 CPL 参数化的统计比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对耦合参数超过 4σ 偏离零是否受先验、初始条件分支、数据组合或 CPL 参数化选择影响，并检查 Planck CMB 约束在存在暗扇区能量交换时的理论一致性和扰动处理。

papers.title: Isocurvature-Free QCD Axion Dark Matter from Inflaton-Driven Early QCD: the Necessity of Inflationary Plateaus
papers.abstract: A direct coupling between the inflaton and Standard Model gluons can dynamically raise the QCD confinement scale during inflation, making the axion temporarily heavy and suppressing axion isocurvature perturbations. As inflation proceeds, the confinement scale relaxes, the axion becomes light, and late-time de Sitter fluctuations can generate the observed dark matter abundance. We analyze this mechanism without specifying an inflationary potential, instead parametrizing the background by $ε(N) \propto 1/N^p$, where $N$ is the number of $e$-folds before the end of inflation. The single parameter $p$ distinguishes monomial models ($p=1$), standard plateau models ($p=2$), and ultra-flat plateau or hilltop-like models ($p\ge 3$). We analytically show that the mechanism selects plateau-like ($p\ge 2$) inflation: monomial models generically cause the confinement scale to grow too rapidly, while plateau models keep the QCD sector under perturbative control. In the minimal scenario, reheating occurs through the same inflaton-gluon coupling, and viable axion dark matter production is obtained when deconfinement occurs after the CMB window. The early-confinement sector also generically shifts the scalar spectral index to smaller, redder values. Because ultra-flat ($p \ge 3$) models inherently predict overly red spectra, this shift exacerbates their tension with CMB data, leaving $p=2$ plateau models as the phenomenologically viable parameter space (in this parametrization).
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures; updated discussion of $n_s$ shift

analysis.title_zh: 来自暴胀子驱动早期 QCD 的无等曲率 QCD 轴子暗物质：暴胀平台的必要性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究暴胀子与标准模型胶子耦合导致的早期 QCD 禁闭如何压低轴子等曲率扰动并产生轴子暗物质。作者用 ε(N) ∝ 1/N^p 参数化暴胀背景，摘要报告该机制选择平台型暴胀，且在该参数化下 p=2 平台模型是现象学上可行的区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轴子等曲率扰动是 CMB 对高能暴胀和轴子暗物质模型的关键限制之一；该文把 QCD 轴子暗物质产生机制、再加热和标量谱指数变化同 CMB 窗口联系起来，因此直接关系到 CMB 对暴胀模型与粒子暗物质的联合约束。
key_points: 暴胀子与标准模型胶子的直接耦合可在暴胀期动态提高 QCD 禁闭尺度。
作者用 ε(N) ∝ 1/N^p 的背景参数化比较单项式、平台和超平坦平台/山顶型暴胀。
摘要称机制偏好 p=2 平台模型，并会把标量谱指数推向更红。
methods: 不指定具体暴胀势的背景参数化：ε(N) ∝ 1/N^p
暴胀子-标准模型胶子直接耦合机制
与 CMB 标量谱指数约束的现象学比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对早期 QCD 禁闭尺度随 N 演化的解析条件、微扰控制假设、再加热由同一耦合完成的可行性，以及对 n_s 的红移修正是否在 CMB 约束下仍留下足够参数空间。

papers.title: Single field matter bounce with dark energy era: comparison with CMB Planck 2018 data and best fit parameters
papers.abstract: In this work, we perform Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) analyses using the Planck 2018 cosmic microwave background (CMB) datasets, including temperature, polarization, and lensing, in order to compare matter bounce models with observational data. The particular model we considered contains a scalar field with an exponential potential, which behaves as dust in the asymptotic past of the contracting phase, it realizes a quantum bounce, and then behaves as a transient dark energy field at large scales in the expanding phase. The parameter $λ$ appearing in the exponential potential is directly related to the model's scalar spectral index, $n_s$, which is set free in the MCMC analyses, as well as the deepness of the bounce, which controls the amplitude of the power spectrum. We provide constraints on the cosmological parameters and compare the model's performance against the standard inflationary $Λ$CDM scenario. Our results indicate that Planck data alone cannot favor one model with respect to the other, showing that the model we investigate can be a viable alternative to inflation.

analysis.title_zh: 含暗能量时代的单场物质反弹：与 CMB Planck 2018 数据及最佳拟合参数的比较
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck 2018 CMB 温度、偏振和透镜数据，通过 MCMC 约束一个含指数势的单场物质反弹模型，该模型在收缩相远过去近似尘埃、经历量子反弹，并在膨胀相大尺度表现为瞬态暗能量。摘要报告 Planck 数据单独不能在该模型与标准暴胀 ΛCDM 之间给出偏好，因而该模型可作为暴胀的可行替代方案。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 反弹宇宙学是暴胀之外解释原初扰动的候选框架，必须接受 CMB 温度、偏振和透镜数据检验；该文直接将具体物质反弹模型与 Planck 2018 数据比较，对评估 CMB 是否能区分暴胀与替代理论有相关价值。
key_points: 模型为含指数势的单标量场物质反弹宇宙学。
作者使用 Planck 2018 温度、偏振和透镜 CMB 数据进行 MCMC 分析。
摘要称仅用 Planck 数据无法相对标准暴胀 ΛCDM 偏好任一模型。
methods: Planck 2018 CMB 温度、偏振和透镜数据
单标量场指数势物质反弹模型
与标准暴胀 ΛCDM 情景比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其初始扰动谱、反弹深度与功率谱振幅的参数化、n_s 与 λ 的对应关系，以及模型比较中使用的似然、先验和证据/拟合优度指标是否足以支持“Planck alone cannot favor”的表述。

papers.title: UNIONS-3500 Weak Lensing: III. 2D Cosmological Constraints in Configuration Space
papers.abstract: We present the first cosmological constraints from the cosmic shear analysis of the UNIONS-3500 weak lensing galaxy catalogue in configuration space. The Ultraviolet Near Infrared Optical Northern Survey (UNIONS) is the largest and deepest photometric survey of the northern hemisphere to date, with the UNIONS-3500 catalogue using high-quality $r$-band imaging across 3500 deg2 of the sky. We perform a 2D cosmic shear analysis with a single tomographic bin, using the two-point correlation function (2PCF) statistic. Assuming a flat LCDM model, we obtain constraints on the clustering amplitude of S_8 = 0.831^{+0.067}_{-0.078}, which is consistent with constraints from Planck CMB measurements and precedent cosmic shear results within 1sigma. We outline the construction of our cosmological inference pipeline, including the estimation of the source redshift distribution, shear calibration, and covariance matrix, and describe methodologies for the mitigation of systematic effects arising from PSF systematics and B-modes. We demonstrate that our results are robust to variations in analysis choices, including scale cuts, prior ranges, and nonlinear modelling. This paper is part of a coordinated release which collectively demonstrates the maturity and readiness of UNIONS to deliver competitive cosmological results, positioning it as a key stepping stone towards the forthcoming era of Stage IV weak lensing experiments.

analysis.title_zh: UNIONS-3500 弱引力透镜：III. 配置空间中的二维宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文给出 UNIONS-3500 弱透镜星系目录在配置空间的首次 cosmic shear 宇宙学约束，使用单 tomographic bin 的二维二点相关函数并假设平直 ΛCDM。摘要报告得到 S_8 = 0.831^{+0.067}_{-0.078}，与 Planck CMB 测量和既有 cosmic shear 结果在 1σ 内一致，且对多种分析选择稳健。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 弱透镜 cosmic shear 提供低红移结构增长约束，是检验 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 参数和 S_8 张力的重要外部数据；UNIONS 位于北天且面向 Stage IV 弱透镜时代，其结果可作为与 Planck CMB 约束交叉验证的低红移宇宙学测量。
key_points: 给出 UNIONS-3500 弱透镜星系目录的首个配置空间宇宙学约束。
采用单个断层红移 bin 的二维 cosmic shear 二点相关函数分析。
摘要报告 S_8 与 Planck CMB 及既有 cosmic shear 结果在 1σ 内一致。
methods: 3500 deg2 高质量 r 波段成像
二维 cosmic shear 配置空间分析
源红移分布估计、剪切校准、协方差矩阵估计
PSF 系统学和 B-mode 缓解
尺度截断、先验范围和非线性建模稳健性检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对源红移分布、剪切校准、协方差估计、B-mode/PSF 系统学处理和尺度截断选择，因为这些环节决定 S_8 与 Planck CMB 一致性的可信度。

papers.title: The Amplitude-Growth Degeneracy and Implied $A_s$ Diagnostic for Background-Inert Modified Gravity
papers.abstract: We prove that any background-inert perturbative coupling $ λ$ in coincident $ f(Q) $ gravity exhibits a degeneracy with the clustering amplitude $ σ_{80} $, when using compressed CMB distance priors. This degeneracy is, in fact, a direct materialization of a deeper $ A_s-D_0(λ) $ degeneracy between the primordial amplitude $ A_s $ and the present day growth factor $ D_0(λ) $. We outline a consistency check scheme, whose logic extends to any model in which the coupling is background inert, by computing $ A_s $ per posterior sample, needed to reproduce the $ σ_{80} $ preferred by the sampler. We perform our analysis with two dataset pipelines, based on the coupled/decoupled $ fσ_8(z) $ data. To ensure theoretical diversity, we include $ Λ$CDM and the Hybrid model in the $ f(Q) $ framework. Our results illustrate that adding the $ λ_0\sqrt{QQ_0} $ correction to the models inflates $ σ_{80} $ by $ 5\%-8\% $ as compared to its vanilla variant, while the Bayesian evidence disfavors every alternative considered - $Δ\log\mathcal{Z} = -0.5$ to $-2.6$ against $Λ$CDM on the same pipeline. Propagating this inflated $ σ_{80} $ through a per-sample computation of the implied primordial amplitude accounting for both the transfer function and the modified growth factor yields $\ln(10^{10}A_s)$ in $1.5σ-2.6σ$ tension with Planck 2018. Imposing the $ \ln(10^{10}A_s) $ constraint from Planck 2018 as an additional prior removes this inflation, pulling $ σ_{80} $ to the Planck value and $ λ_0 $ to values consistent with $ 0 $, with the implied amplitude recovering to within $ 0.2σ$ of Planck in every case. We find no model-dataset combination preferred over $ Λ$CDM.

analysis.title_zh: 背景惰性修正引力中的振幅-增长退化与隐含 As 诊断
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 coincident f(Q) 引力中背景惰性微扰耦合 λ 与聚团振幅 σ80 的退化，指出其源于 As 与当前增长因子 D0(λ) 的更深层退化。摘要报告称，在两套 fσ8(z) 数据管线和多个 f(Q) 模型中，λ0√(QQ0) 修正会抬高 σ80，但贝叶斯证据不支持这些替代模型；加入 Planck 2018 的 ln(10^10 As) 先验后，σ80 膨胀消失且 λ0 与 0 相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接涉及 CMB 压缩距离先验、Planck 2018 对原初标量振幅 As 的约束，以及低红移增长数据中 σ8/σ80 型张力的解释。对 CMB 宇宙学读者而言，核心价值在于提醒：只用距离先验可能掩盖原初振幅与后期增长的退化，修正引力模型的增长偏好必须与 CMB 推断的 As 做一致性检查。
key_points: 证明背景惰性微扰耦合与聚团振幅 σ80 在压缩 CMB 距离先验下存在退化。
逐后验样本计算 implied As，用作检验 σ80 膨胀是否与 Planck 2018 原初振幅一致。
加入 Planck 的 ln(10^10 As) 先验后，σ80 回到 Planck 值附近，λ0 与 0 相容。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“背景惰性”假设如何进入 CMB 距离先验与增长方程，以及逐样本反推 As 时转移函数、修正增长因子和 σ80 定义是否与 Planck 2018 的 As 约束严格可比。

papers.title: Secondary Gravitational Wave Signatures from 5D Rotating Primordial Black Holes in the Dark Dimension
papers.abstract: We investigate five-dimensional rotating primordial black holes (PBHs) as dark matter candidates within the Dark Dimension (DD) scenario motivated by the Swampland Program. In this framework, a micron-scale extra dimension suppresses Hawking evaporation, allowing PBHs with initial masses \(M \gtrsim 10^{10}\,\mathrm{g}\) to survive to the present epoch. Moreover, the memory burden effect, a quantum-gravitational suppression of the evaporation rate by \(S^{-p}\), significantly prolongs PBH lifetimes and enlarges the allowed parameter space. We compute the evaporation dynamics for rotating 5D PBHs, derive the enhanced lifetime for \(p=2\), and establish the dark matter window \(10^{10}\,\mathrm{g} \lesssim M \lesssim 10^{21}\,\mathrm{g}\). The curvature perturbations responsible for PBH formation also generate a stochastic gravitational wave background through second-order scalar-induced effects. Assuming a log-normal primordial power spectrum with \(σ=1\) and \(f_{\mathrm{PBH}}=1\), we calculate the present-day energy density \(Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}h^2\) across the Dark Dimension window. The predicted signals peak at frequencies from nHz to Hz, within the sensitivity ranges of LISA and DECIGO/BBO, while remaining consistent with current CMB spectral distortion bounds. Fisher forecasts show that future observatories can constrain the PBH mass, dark matter fraction, spectral width, and memory burden exponent with percent-level precision. A detection of the predicted gravitational wave background would provide simultaneous evidence for a micron-sized extra dimension, PBH dark matter, and the memory burden effect, offering a decisive test of quantum gravity and extra-dimensional physics.

analysis.title_zh: 暗维度中五维旋转原初黑洞的次级引力波信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在暗维度框架下研究五维旋转原初黑洞作为暗物质候选，计算其蒸发动力学、memory burden 效应导致的寿命延长，并给出允许的暗物质质量窗口。摘要还基于对数正态原初功率谱和 fPBH=1 计算由 PBH 形成曲率扰动诱导的随机引力波背景，称其峰值频率覆盖 nHz 到 Hz、可被未来探测器检验且满足当前 CMB 谱畸变约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系主要在早期宇宙小尺度曲率扰动及其 CMB 谱畸变约束，而非主 CMB 各向异性。若 PBH 暗物质需要增强的小尺度原初功率谱，CMB 谱畸变和诱导引力波共同提供互补约束，可帮助判断这类非标准早期宇宙模型是否可行。
key_points: 研究暗维度情景中五维旋转 PBH 作为暗物质候选。
PBH 形成所需曲率扰动会通过二阶标量诱导效应产生随机引力波背景。
摘要称预测信号位于 nHz 到 Hz，并与当前 CMB 谱畸变界限相容。
methods: five-dimensional rotating primordial black hole evaporation dynamics
memory burden effect with evaporation suppression S^{-p}
log-normal primordial power spectrum with σ=1
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗维度和 memory burden 对 PBH 寿命的具体假设、log-normal 功率谱与 f_PBH=1 的适用范围，以及“与 CMB 谱畸变界限相容”如何在整个质量窗口内成立。

papers.title: Measuring cosmic bulk flow with kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich velocity reconstruction
papers.abstract: Cosmic bulk flow--the volume-averaged peculiar velocity of matter--serves as a fundamental test of the Cosmological Principle when probed on gigaparsec (Gpc) scales. Historically, however, measurements of cosmic bulk flow have been limited to $R\lesssim 100\ h^{-1}{\rm Mpc}$. We present an application of kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (kSZ) velocity reconstruction to constrain the bulk flow on cosmological scales, over a volume of effective radius $R\sim2000\ h^{-1} {\rm Mpc}$. We use the WISE$\times$SuperCOSMOS and unWISE galaxy catalogs, combined with CMB temperature maps from Planck to reconstruct large-scale velocities in six tomographic bins spanning $0.1\lesssim z \lesssim 1.5$. We place some of the tightest upper limits to date on bulk velocity at $200 \lesssim R\,[h^{-1}{\rm Mpc}]\lesssim 2000$, finding results fully consistent with the $Λ$CDM bulk flow expectation. Our unWISE constraints are in strong tension with the CatWISE quasar number-count dipole measurement if that dipole is due to a coherent bulk flow $\sim 370\ {\rm km\,s^{-1}}$ at $R\sim1000\ h^{-1}{\rm Mpc}$. We also derive constraints on the matter power spectrum at low-$k$ ($k\lesssim10^{-3}\, {\rm Mpc}^{-1}$) with low-$z$ ($z\sim 1$) galaxy samples. Alongside these cosmological constraints, we introduce a novel approach to map the optical depth bias--an inherent astrophysical degeneracy in kSZ velocity reconstruction--across different data combinations. Our work bridges the theoretical gap between bulk flow and kSZ-reconstructed velocities, and expands the horizon of bulk velocity measurements out to Gpc scales.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures (Main); 9 pages, 7 figures (Appendices). Comments welcome!

analysis.title_zh: 用运动学 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 速度重建测量宇宙 bulk flow
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 kSZ 速度重建测量 Gpc 尺度宇宙 bulk flow，将 Planck CMB 温度图与 WISE×SuperCOSMOS、unWISE 星系目录结合，在六个红移层析 bin 中重建大尺度速度。摘要报告称在 200≲R[h^-1 Mpc]≲2000 给出较强上限，结果与 ΛCDM 预期一致，并且 unWISE 约束与把 CatWISE 类星体数密度偶极解释为 R≈1000 h^-1 Mpc 上约 370 km/s 相干 bulk flow 的情形强烈不一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: kSZ 是 CMB 次级各向异性中直接追踪大尺度速度场的工具，因此这项工作把 CMB 温度图与低红移大尺度结构结合，用来检验宇宙学原理和 ΛCDM 在超大尺度上的速度预言。它还触及低 k 物质功率谱、类星体偶极异常和 kSZ 光学深度偏差等 CMB-LSS 联合分析中的关键系统问题。
key_points: 将 kSZ 速度重建用于 Gpc 尺度 bulk flow 测量。
使用 Planck CMB 温度图与 WISE×SuperCOSMOS、unWISE 星系目录，在 0.1≲z≲1.5 的六个层析红移 bin 中重建大尺度速度。
结果与 ΛCDM bulk flow 预期一致，并与将 CatWISE 类星体数密度偶极解释为相干 bulk flow 的说法存在强张力。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 kSZ 速度重建到体速度约束的理论映射、光学深度偏差的处理方式，以及 unWISE 结果与 CatWISE 偶极比较时对选择函数、系统误差和红移分布的假设是否一致。

papers.title: Ultra-light axion constraints from Planck and ACT: the role of nonlinear modelling
papers.abstract: We study how constraints on the abundance of ultralight axions (ULAs) from cosmic microwave background (CMB) data depend on their nonlinear modelling. We focus on the axion mass range $10^{-25} \leq m/\rm{eV} \leq 10^{-23}$, where the axion Jeans scale falls in the quasi-linear regime probed by CMB lensing, making constraints highly sensitive to the choice of nonlinear prescription. We show that the inferred constraints depend significantly on the choice of nonlinear model, which must therefore be treated carefully. Performing Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) analyses with \Planck\, 2018, ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 BAO data, we find naive nonlinear modelling of non-cold matter can produce an artificial preference for a subdominant ULA dark matter component with mass $m \approx 10^{-24}\,$eV. This arises from a lensing-like enhancement of the CMB power spectrum.

analysis.title_zh: 来自 Planck 和 ACT 的超轻轴子约束：非线性建模的作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 CMB 数据对超轻轴子暗物质丰度的约束如何依赖非线性结构形成建模，聚焦质量区间 10^-25 至 10^-23 eV，其中轴子 Jeans 标度进入 CMB 透镜敏感的准线性尺度。摘要报告，使用 Planck 2018、ACT DR6 与 DESI DR2 BAO 的 MCMC 分析发现，非冷物质的朴素非线性建模可能因类似透镜的 CMB 功率谱增强而产生对 m≈10^-24 eV 次主导 ULA 成分的人为偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接关系到用 CMB 温度、偏振及尤其 CMB 透镜来约束暗物质微物理时的理论系统误差。若非线性处方会制造或消除对超轻轴子的偏好，那么 CMB 透镜与 BAO 联合分析中的暗物质约束需要把小尺度建模不确定性作为核心误差源处理。
key_points: 研究超轻轴子丰度约束对非线性建模的依赖。
轴子 Jeans 标度落在 CMB 透镜探测的准线性区间。
朴素非线性处理可能产生次主导 ULA 暗物质成分的人为偏好。
methods: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) 分析
不同非线性模型/非线性 prescription 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对不同非线性 prescription 如何实现、哪些模型被称为“naive”，以及人工偏好是否来自透镜功率谱增强的具体链路和参数退化。

papers.title: New Isocurvature Constraints from JWST UV Luminosity Function
papers.abstract: We constrain uncorrelated primordial isocurvature perturbations using a combination of large- and small-scale cosmological probes, with the small-scale data provided by the ultraviolet luminosity function (UVLF) -- a measure of number density of galaxies as a function of UV brightness. We consider several isocurvature modes, including cold dark matter, baryon, neutrino density, neutrino velocity, and dark radiation perturbations. The isocurvature power spectrum is modeled using two independent parameterizations: a broken power law and a running power law, without fixing the spectral index a priori. Our analysis combines large-scale data from the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB), baryon acoustic oscillations, and Type Ia supernovae with small-scale constraints from UVLF measurements obtained by \textit{HST} and \textit{JWST}. The UVLF probes matter fluctuations over a continuous range of intermediate scales, $k \sim 0.5$--$10~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$ over a wide range of redshift $4\lesssim z \lesssim 13$, providing a direct handle on structure formation in a regime where constraints on the scale dependence of isocurvature perturbations remain comparatively limited. Our result represents the first UVLF-based constraint on model-agnostic isocurvature perturbations carried by various components. We construct $68\%$ and $95\%$ credible envelopes in $k$-space for the allowed isocurvature power and find good agreement between the envelopes for the $95\%$ envelope across a wide range of scales, indicating that our constraints are mostly insensitive to the assumed power-law form.

analysis.title_zh: 来自 JWST 紫外光度函数的新等曲率约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文结合大尺度 CMB、BAO、Ia 型超新星与小尺度 HST/JWST 紫外光度函数，约束多种非相关原初等曲率扰动，并用 broken power law 与 running power law 两种参数化避免预设谱指数。摘要报告其构造了 k 空间中允许等曲率功率的 68% 和 95% 可信包络，且 95% 包络在宽尺度范围内对所选幂律形式大体不敏感。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初等曲率扰动是 CMB 初始条件检验的核心对象，但 CMB 主要约束大尺度；JWST/HST UVLF 将约束延伸到 k≈0.5–10 Mpc^-1 的中小尺度和 z≈4–13 的结构形成时期。它因此为检验早期宇宙、暗物质/中微子/暗辐射扰动的尺度依赖提供了与 CMB 互补的窗口。
key_points: 用 CMB、BAO、Ia 型超新星与 HST/JWST UVLF 联合约束非相关原初等曲率扰动。
考虑 CDM、重子、中微子密度、中微子速度和暗辐射等多种等曲率模式。
摘要称这是首个基于 UVLF 的模型无关多成分等曲率约束。
methods: 68% 和 95% k 空间 credible envelopes
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 UVLF 到物质涨落约束的天体物理建模假设，特别是星系形成、尘埃、选择函数和高红移系统误差如何与等曲率谱形退化。

papers.title: Controlled Penumbral Inflation from Monodromic Valleys
papers.abstract: Realizing controlled, single-clock inflation in string theory is fundamentally obstructed by the backreaction of heavy moduli. We show that in the \emph{penumbra} -- the near-boundary regime of complex-structure moduli space where asymptotic symmetries are partially broken -- this obstruction can be exactly quantified. We derive a covariant control theorem demonstrating that local branch data dictate whether a monodromic valley supports a controlled inflationary plateau, thereby isolating the first controlled penumbral inflationary window. The result turns the penumbra from a geometric regime into a dynamical filter. In the axion-saxion effective theory, a branch-displacing odd term generates a plateau when $Δ\equiv p+2ν-q>0$, while covariant single-clock control further requires $p<2$, or $p=2$ with $12A_pm^2/(dV_0)\gg1$ over the observational window. This splits penumbral valleys into no plateau, uncontrolled plateau, and controlled plateau before global completion is attempted. We identify a minimal analytic family with a closed-form valley and an invariant attractor equation for the full two-field dynamics, providing the first exactly solvable penumbral realization that remains predictive under the next penumbral order. The controlled corridor targets $r\sim10^{-3}$ with the correlated running $α_s\simeq-r/2$ for the $d=q=1$ benchmark, providing a falsifiable target for LiteBIRD/CMB-S4.
papers.comment: 5 pages +7 pages supplementry material , any comments are highly appreciated and welcomed, added discussion

analysis.title_zh: 来自单值化谷的受控半影暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论弦论中重模量反作用对受控单钟暴胀的阻碍，并在复结构模空间近边界的 penumbra 区域给出定量判据，判断 monodromic valley 是否支持受控暴胀平台。摘要报告其得到首个受控 penumbral inflation window，并在 d=q=1 benchmark 下给出 r∼10^-3 且 α_s≈-r/2 的相关预言，作为 LiteBIRD/CMB-S4 的可检验目标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系主要在暴胀可观测量：张量标量比 r 和标量谱指数 running α_s。若模型预言的 r∼10^-3 稳健，它落在未来 LiteBIRD 和 CMB-S4 追踪原初 B 模与暴胀参数的科学目标附近，但摘要层面还不能判断其弦论构造的全局完备性或预言稳健性。
key_points: 提出弦论复结构模空间 penumbra 区域中的受控单钟暴胀判据。
给出单钟控制条件与平台形成条件，并分类 penumbral valleys。
给出 LiteBIRD/CMB-S4 可检验的 r 与 running 目标。
methods: 弦论复结构模空间分析
双场动力学的不变量吸引子方程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“受控”条件在观测窗口内的适用性、从双场动力学到单钟有效描述的推导，以及 r∼10^-3、α_s≈-r/2 是否依赖 d=q=1 benchmark 的特殊选择。

papers.title: Reionization History and Neutrino Mass
papers.abstract: Recent baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) distance measurements, when combined with Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) observations in the $Λ$CDM framework, lead to a preference for negative neutrino masses. We investigate whether this neutrino mass anomaly can be alleviated by a class of astrophysically motivated reionization histories. Using a frequentist analysis, we find that some reionization histories can move the best-fit value of $\sum m_ν$ to a positive value and bring $\sum m_ν\simeq0.06~{\rm eV}$ into the 95\% confidence interval. To separate the effect of the total optical depth from that of the details of the reionization history, we compare a high-$τ$ history with a two-step tanh-like reionization history of the same $τ$. The resulting $Δχ^2(\sum m_ν)$ profiles are nearly identical. This indicates that the effect is mainly driven by the total optical depth, while the details of the reionization history play only a minor role.

analysis.title_zh: 再电离历史与中微子质量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 CMB 与 BAO 在 ΛCDM 框架下出现的负中微子质量偏好，检验天体物理动机的再电离历史能否缓解这一反常。摘要报告称，频率学派分析中某些再电离历史可使 ∑mν 最佳拟合转为正值，并让 ∑mν≈0.06 eV 进入 95% 置信区间；与相同 τ 的两步 tanh 型历史比较显示，主要影响来自总光学深度 τ。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对中微子质量的约束与再电离光学深度 τ 强相关，而 τ 又由大尺度偏振和再电离建模决定。若改变再电离历史可影响 CMB+BAO 对 ∑mν 的偏好，这直接关系到中微子质量反常是否是数据、模型参数化或天体物理假设共同作用的结果。
key_points: BAO 与 CMB 在 ΛCDM 下给出负中微子质量偏好的问题。
某些再电离历史可把 ∑mν 的最佳拟合移到正值，并使约 0.06 eV 落入 95% 置信区间。
摘要称这一效应主要由总光学深度 τ 驱动，再电离历史细节作用较小。
methods: BAO 距离测量与 CMB 观测的联合分析
天体物理动机的再电离历史
高 τ 再电离历史与相同 τ 的两步 tanh 型再电离历史比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：所采用的 CMB/BAO 数据组合、τ 先验或再电离模型参数化如何改变 ∑mν 的似然剖面，以及“细节作用较小”的结论是否依赖特定再电离历史族。

papers.title: Einstein-Cartan pseudoscalaron inflation, reheating and nonthermal leptogenesis
papers.abstract: We study the postinflationary dynamics of an Einstein-Cartan-Holst gravity-motivated inflationary scenario, known as Einstein-Cartan pseudoscalaron inflation, coupled to a type-I seesaw extension of the Standard Model with three heavy right-handed Majorana neutrinos. In particular, we show that nonthermal leptogenesis emerges as a necessary and self-consistent mechanism for generating the observed baryon asymmetry of the Universe, mainly because of the universal coupling of the inflaton to the additional heavy Majorana fermions. The resulting framework provides theoretical predictions that are fully compatible with the latest cosmological constraints from the Cosmic Microwave Background, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations, and Big Bang Nucleosynthesis, as well as with neutrino oscillation experiments, for a wide range of the fundamental Barbero-Immirzi model parameter $γ$, which controls the inflationary and postinflationary phases. In particular, for $γ\sim -1/100$ and a lightest Majorana-neutrino mass of order $10^{13}$ GeV, we find a scalar spectral index $n_s \sim 0.970$, a tensor-to-scalar ratio $r \sim 0.004$, for a number of e-folds before the end of inflation $N_e \lesssim 60$, and a baryon-to-entropy ratio $n_B/s \sim 8.7 \times 10^{-11}$.

analysis.title_zh: Einstein-Cartan 赝标量子暴胀、再加热与非热轻子生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 Einstein-Cartan-Holst 引力启发的 pseudoscalaron 暴胀模型在暴胀后的动力学，并将其耦合到含三个重右手 Majorana 中微子的 I 型 seesaw 扩展。摘要称，由于暴胀子与额外重 Majorana 费米子的普适耦合，非热轻子生成成为产生宇宙重子不对称的必要且自洽机制，并且模型预言可与 CMB、BAO、BBN 和中微子振荡约束相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要在原初扰动约束：标量谱指数和张量标量比是 CMB 检验暴胀模型的核心观测量。它还把暴胀、再加热、重子不对称和重中微子物理放在同一框架中，因此对利用 CMB 约束早期宇宙粒子物理模型的读者有参考价值。
key_points: 研究 Einstein-Cartan pseudoscalaron 暴胀的暴胀后动力学。
模型耦合到含三个重右手 Majorana 中微子的 I 型 seesaw 标准模型扩展。
摘要称非热轻子生成可自洽地产生观测到的宇宙重子不对称，并与 CMB、BAO、BBN 和中微子振荡约束相容。
methods: Einstein-Cartan-Holst 引力动机的 pseudoscalaron 暴胀模型
I 型 seesaw 标准模型扩展
三个重右手 Majorana 中微子
暴胀后动力学与再加热分析
与 CMB、BAO、BBN 及中微子振荡实验约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：暴胀子与重 Majorana 费米子的“普适耦合”如何推出非热轻子生成的必然性，参数 γ 与最轻 Majorana 质量的可行范围是否需要调参，以及给出的 ns、r 和重子不对称是否来自同一组自洽的再加热动力学。
